review_text: I just returned from a short stay with my kids (15 & 21), and we would definitely stay here again. I had originally booked a more expensive hotel in town, but decided to switch to this property to save money and be closer to downtown. I’m happy to say this was the right move, because this charming motel has a lot to offer. The gentleman who checked us in and out was extremely pleasant and helpful, and made us feel welcome and like valued guests. The room was bright, very clean, and comfortable, with a full-size refrigerator and small but attractive bathroom with modern fixtures and a nice assortment of toiletries. The location was super convenient and close to many area attractions, and it was surprisingly quiet in the room at night. The beds were a little firmer than I prefer, but I was still able to get a good night’s sleep. We appreciated the variety of snacks, fruit, and beverages available in the morning, which allowed us to get on with our day and not worry about stopping for breakfast. All in all, we had a very pleasant day and hope to return one day.

review_title: Nice clean motel in a great location
review_text:
I really liked how clean and updated this place was. I could tell the property was kind of old but the owners made some updates to make the place feel modern and cozy. Our room had a loveseat with nice throw pillows and a breakfast counter with two stools for eating at, along with a regular table and chairs. There was also a microwave and mini coffeemaker. I couldn’t believe there was a full size refrigerator. It had everything we needed.  

Our room was pretty big and roomy and we had a nice big king size bed. There was a big screen TV that was nice for winding down at night. The bathroom had bright lighting that was great for getting ready in the morning. 

They had free breakfast snacks and drinks in their lobby in the morning. I really appreciated that. It made it easy to get up and go in the morning as we aren’t big breakfast eaters. The employee at the front desk was very friendly and helpful.

The location was great. It was very close to where all the shops and restaurants were. There also weren’t a lot of rooms so it was a nice small property. There was plenty of parking.

My only complaint is that the lighting in the room was dimmer than what I’d prefer, but that was not a big deal. Everything else was great. I would stay here again if I were ever in the area.

We have stayed here twice in the past two years. Small but very clean rooms, great price and very close to downtown. Many options at the grab and go breakfast. Staff is very nice and never had any issues with booking. Easy location to pull in and out of busy main road.
We will continue to stay here when we visit.

stay here and the positive reviews I see here are not legitimate or if they are it's because the occupant was loaded the whole time. 🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢 Run. We legit walked away from four paid nights with no refund to pay twice as much down the road in order to avoid putting our bags down in the room. I deserve at partial refund minimum. I understand one night also it was a Wednesday night. I would like to talk to a supervisor but I was denied by the clerk

Standard motel. Lukewarm shower both nights but at least the response was quick so hope the visitors after us got hot showers. Very expensive for what it is so avoid weekends.  Not too far from town, about 1/2 hr walk. Minimal breakfast but a good place just 15 minutes walk away.

We actually stayed at this hotel in June 2021. I wrote a previous review and Christine, the owner, provided a lame response. When I first made my reservation and requested a more private room, she wrote me back that she would provide me with a room at the end of the second floor so there shouldn't be anyone going by your room. Unfortunately, I was not able to get that room and was put in a less than basic room. Blinds that were damaged and did not provide privacy, the bathroom was gross, lamp shade looked like someone had punch it out, wall paint was chipped. I am okay with a basic, well-kept, clean room, which is not what I would describe the room I was provided at this hotel. If Christine wants to call this basic, unless you really want less than basic, I would seriously consider a different location.

review_title: Racist incident and child labor used
review_text:
Dear Grand Traverse Motel,

My full name is *REDACTED*, and I have been subjected to what I believe to be a racist incident perpetrated by Penny, a housekeeper. As the only guest of color, this situation has been very distressing to my family and me. I contacted the front desk to lodge a complaint with the owner, and Christine Allie and Clare stated that I could not speak to anybody else but her. I have been very polite, but your establishment has not. 

Since this establishment recently changed owners, senior management has been impossible to contact. Other reviews attest to the same. While understandably, this is not a luxury hotel, a minimum modicum of respect has not been afforded. I firmly believe this merits a management response and due investigation. I want to stress again that I have behaved very politely throughout this ordeal. I have been staying in Room 138.

The other housekeeper, not Penny, is also cleaning the rooms alongside her approximately ten-year-old daughter. This violates Michigan's child labor laws. Moreover, this has also been ignored by Christine Allie.

A BBB complaint has been filed, but we are still waiting for an answer.

My credit card was compromised and charges were made on it in Traverse City when I wasn't even in the city.....I am a Canadian resident.  I made a reservation and gave my credit card information to simply hold a room 7 weeks in advance of my arrival. After 2 days, I decided to cancel my reservation  and unbeknownst to me, the manager had run my credit card for the full amount of the room WITHOUT  my knowledge or consent. A refund was issued BUT within those 2 days, my credit card was used to purchase items and more attempts were made for unsuccessful purchases! I have spent hours trying to rectify this situation and this has been a massive inconvenience to me.  The illegal charges stemmed from this location. This whole situation could have been avoided if the manager had not run my card in the first place.....again .....WITHOUT MY PERMISSION!!!!
management_response: You provided your credit card details to make the reservation, we placed a deposit on the card as was explained when you made the reservation, we refunded the deposit when you cancelled the reservation. We are a PCI compliant location - we do not store any credit card information on site - it goes to a national processor. If we make charges, we send the charge to the processor and they charge the card. I don't know how illegal charges could have "stemmed" from our hotel, that doesn't make any sense.

review_text:
I'm a bit overdue on this, but really felt like I should share our thoughts since I often look at reviews to help make a decision. We came to MI in June for my niece's wedding and planned a road trip up the coast of Lake Michigan to show off my home State to my CA husband. Back in March I had made a reservation at a AirBnB that ended up cancelling on me for no reason a month prior to being in Traverse City. I'm guessing they may have chosen to sell the property. With the late notice, I didn't have lots to choose from. I don't favor the motel type with the walkway that goes in front of the room so I had actually asked if they could accommodate us in a more private location. I was so pleased to receive this response, "I have put you in a room that should work for you. It's at the end on the second floor so there shouldn't be anyone going by your room. Thanks, Christine." Therefore, I was quite surprised when we arrived and there were no rooms that were remotely private available. Our room had a terrible set up, very run down, blinds that wouldn't close completely and the bathroom was digusting! 
I did give them 2 stars because I will say they were gracious with their offerings of to go packaged breakfast items like granola bars, etc. Overall though, I would not recommend this location and felt it was overpriced for what we received.
management_response: Hello Ms. Trinca, we are definitely a motel with walkways that go in front of the rooms. The motel was built in the 1950s and that was the style then. Motels are not for everyone and we're happy to recommend some high end hotels in the area. We offer a simple accommodation close to town and close to the beach. We don't have private apartments, though, we offered you a room at the end of the row of rooms that no one would be walking by, that was the best we were able to suit your request. Our rate when you stayed in the later part of June was $175 for the night when the hotels and resorts were charging $300 to $550. We offer lower rates in a no-frills accommodation, but Traverse City is an expensive town. It sounds like a high end hotel would suit you better than a no-frills motel, please let me know if you need any recommendations.

review_title: A Pleasant Find on  Quick Trip
review_text: A funeral took us to Traverse City for a one-night stay. It was difficult to find a room in the summer that was not pretty pricey. The most reasonably priced room we could find was at the Grand Traverse Motel. A pleasant surprise. It is an older motel that has been recently updated. It is not plush, but our room was large and clean and pleasant. The owner was pleasant and helpful. The only (small) problems we had were not finding the ice. and when we went to leave in the morning, cars were parked on both sides of ours and the spaces were so small that we had to squeeze into the passenger side and crawl over the console to get into the driver's seat.
management_response: Thank you for staying with us, we hope to see you again soon!

review_title: appartamento elegante e centrale, ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo
review_text:
Appartamento completamente e perfettamente accessoriato, completo di tutto: lavatrice, asciugatrice, lavastoviglie, forno a microonde, bollitore, caffettiera, aria condizionata/riscaldamento, doppi servizi e doppia camera da letto, stoviglie, biancheria etc. Bellissima terrazza attrezzata con tavolo e sedie per mangiare con bella vista. Posizione ottima, in quartiere tranquillo, centrale e a due passi da ottimi ristoranti. Molto positivo anche il rapporto qualità/prezzo: L'Aja non è una città economica quanto a strutture ricettive ma questa ha un prezzo decisamente onesto e conveniente rispetto a tutti i servizi offerti.
L'unico piccolo lato negativo è che per accedere all'appartamento bisogna ritirare le chiavi in un altro quartiere il che è piuttosto scomodo: l'ufficio dista un quarto d'ora abbondante di cammino dall'appartamento. La distanza non sarebbe eccessiva, ma con le valigie è faticoso e complicato. Per fortuna alla partenza le chiavi si possono lasciare all'interno dell'appartamento e quindi il problema si presenta solo all'arrivo.

Superb and clean accommodation, close to sights to discover The owners are friendly and great aquatic facilities + a perfect petanque pitch for the whole family Only downside the proximity to the road a little noisy

Chalet très confortable, bien équipé et bien placé pour visiter et se ressourcer.
Environnement très calme mais séjour perturbé par le chien du voisin particulièrement agressif nécessitant notre départ anticipé pour cause d'attaque et de morsure. Chien classé catégorie 2 suite à notre plainte. 
Prix élevé en hors saison.

review_title: Idéal afin de découvrir la Creuse
review_text:
Au plus près de la vaste forêt de Chabrières: nombreuses randonnées et non loin de Guéret et son marché… visites conseillées de châteaux et villages aux alentours.
Les chalets sont récents, confortables et bien équipés (spa, piscines chauffées…) avec une vue superbe.
Ferme sur la propriété avec nombreux animaux.
Propriétaires sur place sympathiques, attentifs et disponibles.
Notre séjour durant deux semaines fût fort agréable.

Séjour parfait. Dans un cadre de verdure ces petits chalets avec de très belles prestations nous ont permis de profiter de la creuse dans des conditions idéales. Les propriétaires sont adorables et d'une flexibilité qui ont rendu le séjour très agréable. Je recommande les yeux fermés. A refaire sans modération.

Une expérience relaxante et un dépaysement total !
Nouveau concept récent mais qui mérite d'être connu surtout en cette période de tension permanente.
Une excellente communication avec le couple de propriétaires avant, pendant et après le séjour !
Un chalet moderne, tout équipé avec vue sur la campagne Creusoise et qui permet une détente +++ !
Un cadre enchanteur à quelques kms de la ville et permettant une multitude d'activités extérieures malgré les restrictions sanitaires.
Un espace privé extérieur avec terrasse apprécié ainsi que le plus de la location, le jacuzzi, utilisable jour comme nuit avec ses multiples options.
Enfin, des espaces intérieurs propres et modernes, frigo et congélateur inclus, plaques chauffantes, évier, lave-vaisselle et de multiples placards de rangements ainsi qu'une belle douche vitrée.
Nous reviendrons avec plaisir et surtout parlerons de cette adresse à des personnes souhaitant se relaxer, visiter ou se détendre tout simplement, merci à l'Ecrin du Breuil pour ce séjour ! :)
Je souhaite aux futurs voyageurs un ressenti aussi excellent que le notre (groupe d'amis) !

Si vous avez des questions, n'hésitez pas !

Ayant découvert entre amis ce site, je voulais vraiment être le premier à en parler ici.
Accueil amical, familial et si sympathique dans un site parfait.
Des habitations de très grand confort, bien équipées et parfaitement intégrées dans un paysage calme et reposant.
Jacuzzi, piscine, barbecue, tout est à votre disposition pour passer un séjour si agréable.
Allez y les yeux fermés... ou plutôt les yeux ouverts tellement c’est beau.

hotel agréable et sans bling bling
l'accueil se passe toujours très bien
les petits déjeuner compris dans le prix de la chambre sont copieux a condition d'aimer les déjeuners Chinois!
étant au 5 em étage je profite d'une petite vue sur les alentours 
le port de Caofeidian est a une dizaine de minutes en voiture

The room was clean and comfortable. Cleaning team is outstanding. Full size fridge was unexpected and helpful. We also appreciated that it was pet friendly. Plenty of space to walk dogs nearby. The building itself is older, but not a problem for us.
management_response: Thank you for your kind review, we love our housekeepers! We're so glad that you had a great stay and hope to see you again soon.

review_text: Stayed at the Grand Traverse Motel for one night in mid October.  Room was a deluxe king.  It was pretty good, clean, and recently renovated.  However there were a few challenges. The blinds don't do a great job of blocking the light so the sun is very visible pretty early.  Could really use some dark curtains.  The bathroom remodel wasn't very good and the window had no screen. Both of those were not huge issues.  The bigger issue was that, while the bed appeared fairly new, it was broken.  The mattress frame collapsed to ~6" on one side when you laid down on it. (slept on by a very averaged sized person) This caused a rather uncomfortable night. Would have mentioned at check out, but the office is closed in the morning.
management_response: We're sorry for your bed issue. The king beds have two twin box springs under it so if one gets pushed off of the frame, the mattress doesn't have anything to sit on. There is someone available 24/7 by calling the front desk. We would have happily come to fix the issue for you.

review_text: I found the Grand Traverse Motel at the last minute for a 1 night stay in Traverse City on our way home to Ohio. The motel far exceeded any expectations we had and our room was even more updated than pictures appear (I unfortunately did not take any of my own, as we were in a bit of a rush upon arrival). The room was spotless and had a very nice flat screen tv, mini fridge, and bathroom. Five minute drive to downtown, where we found open parking to be abundant. Both staff members we communicated with were very friendly and helpful. I imagine the price is hard to beat in such a lovely city.
management_response: Thank you for staying with us and we appreciate your kind review!

review_title: Don't waste $130 dealing with Grand Traverse Motel like it did!
review_text: The Grand Traverse Motel's use of third party sites and the way they hide the fact that your reservation is non-refundable is in my humble and naive opinion sufficient reason for me to warn you to avoid this place when there are so many honest options available. Sleep in your car, on a park bench, but dont let them grab your money like they did mine.
management_response: It sounds like you booked a non-refundable booking on Expedia. We only allow third party bookings through Expedia and its affiliates and Booking.com. Expedia charges 22% on top of our rates and their bookings are non-refundable because, as a small property, we do not have an account manager to work with to change reservations. Expedia very clearly marks the reservations as non-refundable and offers travel insurance in the case that you need to cancel.  Bookings made directly with the property are fully refundable up to 3 days before and we often refund it or offer a credit in less than three days when we are able to rebook the room.

review_text: I stayed at this motel last year during may and the front desk lady was anything but friendly, me and my fiance wanted to stay together for a night so i booked a room, the room was nice but still had strands of hair in the drain and toothpaste in the sink, i woke a late and checked out a little late when i went to return my key the front desk lady said that i would charged for late checkout the price for the night there was supost to be 98$ and she charged me 250 for checking out late. and she was very rude about it. i wouldnt rate this place 1 star honestly. Very Very poor hospitality
management_response:
Hello! Though it's hard to respond regarding a stay nearly a year ago, I do know that I am the only female that would have been at the front desk last May and I've never, personally, charged a late check out fee to any guest. In the rare case we have charged for a late check out, it would have been $10 per hour after noon (with regular checkout at 11am).  Our nightly rate last May was never $98, and I was never made aware of any instance where there was an issue with guest of this sort. If you're sure that it was our motel that you stayed at, please email us and I will pull your reservation record to see what happened. We do have a $250 fee if a guest smokes in a room and we have to do extensive remediation, which we've only charged 4 times in the past 2 years. New Ownership in May, 2018.

If this was not the motel that you stayed at, please remove this review.

review_text:
(our stay august 2019) Motel is well placed. Not far from the lake by feet but it only gives accès to a private hotel beach located on opposite side of the street which means you will have to cross the street surrounded by traffic. Needs a lot of attention to do that.  
If you want to access the lake you’d better drive 5 min on this road in direction of the city. 
This motel is a typical one. 
We rented a room for 3 and get 3 queen beds in our flat. You would expect at least the same number of furnitures to held 3 to 6 persons. This was not the case. For example only 2 chairs while we were 3... only 4 little spoons or 5 forks... same for coffee machine able to do only for 2 persons approx..! The interior is quite old. Not refreshed for a while. Bathroom is just fine. 
But beds were awful. We injured our backs during our 3 nights over-there and slept very badly. 
The person on sites are not really willing to help. Pity. I would not go back.
management_response:
I don't think that you stayed at our motel. We do not have a private hotel beach, none of our rooms have 3 beds, and there aren't forks or other cutlery in the rooms. Also, our beds are all new from June 2019.

We invite you to stay with us sometime and hope that you have a more enjoyable time than where you stayed last August. :)

review_title: Not really happy with my stay here
review_text: First off, the Grand Motel is anything but!  For several reasons, from having to fill out the extra and completely unnecessary paperwork when checking in, to getting the wrong key to my room, and finally receiving a room that reeked of stale smoke.  I also got kind of a creepy vibe from the manager Bob, his natural demeanor is kind of on the dramatic side if you know what I mean.  Note:  they don't even have an ice machine, but what they have instead is a a small cooler (not an ice machine) filled with ice and only available until 10PM at night, next to the front desk. And this is supposed to service the entire motel. How cheap! As far as their breakfast goes, it consists of a small tray filled with granola bars and miniature muffins!  When I saw it in the morning I couldn't believe this itty bitty tray was supposed to feed the entire motel?? Naturally I took a pass on it.  Another thing, this place has bugs, which I took pictures of.  Lastly a couple I met there said they have charged as much as $250 a night to stay there, which IMO is a exorbitant amount to pay for such a substandard motel room. BTW they don't even have grab bars for their bathtub which I found very hard to get into.  The only positive about this motel was the tv had good reception and they stock the room with some nice toiletries from a local company by the name of Great Lakes Bath & Body Shop, but that's about it.  So honestly I'd stay away from this place, and I mean far far away!!

Manager Bob was excellent! Great customer service and very nice. The room was nice and had a brand new AC unit. Our biggest complaint was the bed was way to soft. We didn’t find it comfortable at all but the great customer service made up for it.

We stayed at this little motel right on Front St.  It was clean and perfect for our weekend getaway. The great surprise was the excellent customer service.  Very welcoming and friendly.  I highly recommend this little gem.

review_title: Old style economy hotel that’s close to downtown traverse city
review_text:
I chose this place partly because it’s fairly close to downtown. In fact, I walked downtown from there which is about one mile. So definitely walkable, at least for me.
Rooms are basic but very clean with everything functioning.
The bed was comfy.. AC/heater worked great. I used both during my stay. It also comes with a microwave, a fridge, and TV. Bathroom is old style with a bathtub shower. Water was hot. 
WiFi worked great.. but no room safe if seeking that.
This place is ideal for the solo traveler or a couple  looking for a place with close proximity to downtown. But it’s not fancy. If you are seeking that, look elsewhere. 
Beware that no smoking is allowed in the rooms. You can smoke outside in the parking lot but not in the rooms. They’re also pretty strict on pets. 
They asked me about smoking and pets when I checked in. Not an issue for me. 
I found the staff to be friendly and welcoming. 
I would stay here again.

review_title: Amazing, chilled, comfortable and relaxing stay- Thank you!
review_text: Lovely location, right near national press club etc, and great cafes and restaurants,quiet (sound proofed rooms, and blockout auto blinds sooo good for deep naps), relaxed and chill, perfect place for a recharge and great base for Canberra side quests!! Will be back!
management_response:
Dear Laura P,
Thank you so much for your lovely review!

We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere, our location near great cafes and the National Press Club, and of course — those deep naps thanks to the soundproofing and blockout blinds! It’s great to know the hotel provided the perfect base for your Canberra “side quests” and a bit of well-earned recharge time.

We really appreciate your kind words and can’t wait to welcome you back for your next visit!

Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text: When I walked into the room I was very disappointed. The picture with the bed shows pretty much the entire living space. It felt like staying in a corridor. All the other pictures online of the lounge etc. are of common areas. There is no carpet in the rooms (and no space on the floor anyway), and so the only place to do any exercises was the bed itself which was extremely soft and the pillows very high. Very uncomfortable 2 nights.
management_response:
Dear Juanita M,
Thank you for sharing your honest feedback, and I’m truly sorry to hear that your stay did not meet expectations.

Our rooms are designed with a minimalist, sleep-focused approach, and while many of our guests enjoy the compact layout and signature bedding, I completely understand that it may not have suited your personal needs — especially when it comes to space for movement or exercise. I’m also sorry to hear the bed and pillows weren’t comfortable for you, and that this affected your two-night stay.

You’re right that the images online include both the room layout and our shared guest spaces, like the Library and Lounge, which are available to all guests to work, relax, or unwind. That said, I understand how expectations can differ, and your feedback will help us continue to improve how we present the experience online.

Thank you again for taking the time to share your thoughts. I do hope we’ll have the opportunity to better meet your needs should you consider staying with us again in the future.

Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text: Everything was perfect! I came to stay for work for a week and every day I would come to my room it was always super clean and smell so good therefore I kindly wish to rate 5/5 for the room service staff as well as front desk they were all amazing. I enjoyed my stay especially as a first time visitor to Canberra. Beautiful view from my room and I loved the library on the 5th floor thank you so much to the management and staff of a Little National Hotel
management_response:
Dear Tute N,
Thank you so much for your kind words — we’re absolutely thrilled to hear that your stay with us was such a positive experience!

It’s especially heartening to know that our housekeeping and front desk teams made such a great impression — I’ll be sure to pass along your 5/5 rating to them. They’ll be delighted to know their efforts helped make your week in Canberra feel comfortable and welcoming.

We’re so pleased you enjoyed the views from your room and made the most of our Library space on Level 5 — it’s one of our favourite places in the hotel as well.

Thank you again for choosing Little National for your first visit to Canberra. We hope it’s the first of many, and we’d love to welcome you back again soon.

Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text:
Have stayed several times both in Canberra and Sydney. This hotel is faultless. Everything from booking, to check in and out is easy.
Rooms are beautiful and the beds very confortable. All amenities are state of the art. Staff could not be  more helpful. 11/10  Please feel free to build one in Melbourne too!
management_response:

Thank you so much for your glowing review and for being a loyal guest at both our Canberra and Sydney hotels. It’s wonderful to hear that everything from booking to check-out has been seamless for you, and that you’ve enjoyed our rooms, amenities, and the comfort of our beds.

Your kind words about our team mean a lot, and I’ll be sure to share your feedback with them. We’d love nothing more than to welcome you in Melbourne one day — we’ll keep that suggestion in mind!

We look forward to seeing you again soon.

Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text:
Small is beautiful in every way at the Little National. 
A gem in the nation's capital, and an absolute 'black opal' of a hotel. 
Rare, small & beautiful.
management_response:

We look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

Little National Hotel

Fantastic stay! Love every single detail of this property, especially the co-working space and the lounge. 

The staff was also super friendly. 

Would stay again!

Little National Hotel

review_text: This is an old style motel that seems to have been recently updated with new bedding, towels and flooring.  There are still some old remnants.  Our bathroom sink was looking kind of sad: nicks, scratches, etc.  Also the outside of the place could use some spiffing up.  However, the room was exceptionally clean and the location was great with an easy walk into town.  And honestly, you could not beat the price. Would definitely stay here again.

This is a hidden gem in the area.  Affordable, clean, quiet and close to the Traverse City 1/2 Ironman. Folks at the front desk are always friendly and helpful.  Morning coffee, fruit and pastries are just what you need to get the day started.  Highly recommend!

Our stay was OK. Room was clean but lots of road noise. Small room without much lighting. WiFi was good. Basically a 60s style motel with room door exiting directly outside. Only one small square of soap for both sink and shower. Overpriced like every lodging in Traverse City. Not sure if we’d stay here again.
management_response: Thanks for the feedback! We are a 1950s motel with the second story built in the 1970s. We are a budget choice, near town and near the beach. There should have been 2 bars of handmade cherry almond soap in your bathroom, made here in Traverse City by a master soapmaker. Because it is all natural soap, each bar should last you several days and is restocked in the rooms daily. Our prices are generally one of the lowest in the area, but -yes- Traverse City is more expensive than most of the other small towns in northern Michigan. Our beds are all new within the last year and regularly receive many compliments. Our linens and toiletries are high quality and our housekeepers are amazing. We hope that you'll consider staying with us again on your next trip - and remember - book direct for the best price!

review_text: Hotel manager was very welcoming.  Place was clean. Beds were comfortable.   Price was right.   Location was great, 1 mile walk to down town or can catch the free bus across the street.  What more can you ask for.

We really enjoyed our two night stay - room was clean and comfortable, staff very friendly and gave us ideas of what to do in the area, and an easy walk to downtown.  We especially enjoyed walking to nearby Bryant Park for the sunsets.

We went to Traverse for the day and decided to stay the night. Bob the manager was very welcoming. The room was nicely renovated and clean. Bed was comfortable. Downtown was an easy 10 minute walk from the motel. Breakfast in the morning was nothing fancy, but met our needs before we headed back out on the road.

Hotel is being renovated.  We stayed for three days but were never inconvenienced by the crew.  Our room had already been updated, and it was nice, TV, coffee maker, bed and paint all seemed new.  We had a good rate. We would stay there again.

Great clean Hotel and good location for the price. The staff were very friendly. Excellent Wi-Fi as well, especially if you have to work. A Brisk 15-minute walk and your in downtown. Would definitely stay here again.

I would recommend the motel to anyone looking for a cheaper getaway thats in between downtown, the peninsula, and the beach!

The pool is beautiful and super clean.
Parking at the top and secure.

The location of the village is ideal 3 min from St Anne, beaches and restaurants

We would like to thank you again because you have contributed greatly to making our first time in Guadeloupe unforgettable. We hope to see you again soon.

review_text: My husband and I decided we need to get away from the city for a while. I found this little cottage on the Internet and I knew straightaway it's a place for us. We spent almost 4 days there. The place consists of two floors. The higher floor is an apartment - living room, bedroom, bathroom - big enough for 4 people. The guests have access to the back garden, a roofed terrace and all the useful equipment to organize a barbecue. On the lower floor there's a fully equipped kitchen where you can prepare your meals. The lake is about 150 m away - great when the temperature is high! The cottage is situated on the verge of Puszcza Zielonka Landscape Park so I recommend taking a bike because there are many cycle routes around. The hosts, Ewa and Robert, are really friendly and helpful. It was great to relax at their house. We'll definitely visit them again. :-)

review_title: Worth a look in the budget category
review_text: Internet was very slow and did not afford connection unless outside room. Carla, the office person, was helpful. Bed comfortable. $83.25 on 12 SEP ... check in earlier rather than later to avoid 6pm rush. Could hear domestic in room next door.
management_response: Thank you for staying with us.

review_text: Our visit was about $200.00 a night, which was probably $100.00 too much.  The décor was late 60s.  The beds were old and uncomfortable.  The bathroom sink had missing light bulbs in the sockets (is that safe?)  We had about 7 channels on the TV which included 2 sales channel and nothing else worth watching.  If you do not have a cell phone charges, you will be in big trouble if there is an emergency...no phones.  No ice machines or pop machines except locked up in office.  Office is unattended most of the time we were there.  Don't expect French Milled soup or a beauty bar....Both the water and soap were so hard I thought I would have to chisel it off my skin.  The room was very warm and the window air conditioner looked pretty much in need of cleaning.  The refrigerator made weird noises all night long, and the traffic out front sounds like it is buzzing right past your room.  The place wasn't cruddy, but hardly a $200.00 room, and the outside is more inviting than the inside.  The light fixtures in the bathroom were all rusty.    Someone said great value, then I was robbed.
management_response: Thanks for the review

review_text: Clean, cheap, very nice people! Close to everything in Traverse City so very convenient for business or short vacation. Close to recreation and the bay. We were on a fishing trip and were only five minutes from the boat launch.

review_text: The room was freshly remodeled and clean, actually in better shape than most hotels.  The staff was nice and accommodating and the price was well worth it. Not a big deal because we were gone most of the time.

review_text: Very clean, easy check in, friendly staff.  Motel room is outdated, but comfortable and good location.  Reasonable rate if you're just looking for a place to hang your hat for the night.  Not on our motorcycle this trip, but good place for it - park outside your door.

review_text:
The new owner checked me and gave me a decent rate.  It is an older property but updated and very well maintained.  My room was clean and comfortable.  The air conditioner is a wall unit that was sort of difficult to regulate.  The room had a fridge and microwave.  The ice machine is located in the office which doesn't open till 9 AM.
The new owners are trying VERY hard to accommodate their customers.
management_response: Thank you for staying with us. Please come again .

review_title: Best Stay for the Price in Traverse City
review_text: The location is the best just 8 walking blocks from downtown! Older motel being refurbished by new managers James and Carla who are doing a super nice job! Our room was large with television, table, chairs, refrigerator, microwave, two queen beds, nice clear story windows  plus front windows, a new shower with double shower curtains and lots of towels. The housekeeper has been here 22 years and does a very nice job of preparing the room for guests. Just in back of the motel is State Street with lovely historical homes to see while walking to town including a lovely park. Just a great deal. Just 8 little blocks to the Park Place Hotel to enjoy the Beacon Room 12 stories up and overlooking all of Grand Traverse Bay and the City with fab piano music and great drinks by David. If you are an Elk, visit the Elks Lodge 323 across the street from the Lake with the best Whitefish there is from Crosses in Charlevoix. What a delight!
management_response: So glad you enjoyed yourself. Please come and stay with us again.

review_text: The lobby was clean and fresh. Very friendly management - very clean even with some updates needed. You can tell they are trying, lots of fresh paint and always cleaning. I think they are updating some with new beds, much needed. Tv was old but we didn't care. Free WiFi. We would for sure stay here again.

My biggest complaint: the beds are not all that comfortable.

Loved the owners! Very helpful and accommodating. 

Pricey for what we got, but that's tourist season in a tourist town for you!

Dopo aver studiato per tanti giorni dove alloggiare sull’isola di Guadaloupe la nostra scelta è caduta  su questa struttura che sembrava rispondere a tutti i nostri bisogni.   Il Ti Village Creole si presenta come una serie di bungalow in legno distribuiti tra le palme da cocco su una bellissima collinetta verde dotati di tutti i confort e di una cucina nel portico completa di tutti gli accessori ( microonde, bollitore , macchina del caffè, frigo fornelli a gas, stoviglie, pentole e tutto quello che può necessitare in cucina. Letto comodi,   aria condizionata,  doccia con bella pressione e all’arrivo cesto di frutta, bottiglia di rum locale (squisito) e bottiglia di succo di frutta.  La vera perla è però per noi il proprietario che si è dimostrato di una estrema gentilezza sempre pronto a chiedere se avevamo bisogno di qualcosa o di aiuto. Per noi si è dimostrato un valore aggiunto alla già splendida struttura!  Un’altra cosa importante è che le foto della struttura rappresentano realmente la struttura senza nessuna forma di inganno. Per ultimo è presente una piscina (pulitissima) per chi volesse approfittare di un bagno serale dopo una giornata al mare! Consigliamo questa struttura sia a coppie che a famiglie con bambini.

Nous avons passé une très belle semaine en famille chez Ti Village Créole. Les logements sont très bien équipés et confortables. Le lieu était complet et pourtant très calme 😊 Le propriétaire est agréable et les cadeaux d’arrivée font vraiment plaisir après 12h00 de transport (Rhum, jus de fruits, corbeille de fruits, etc…). Nous conseillons vivement cet endroit 👍🏻

Nous revenons d'avoir passer 3 semaines au ti village créole, nous étions trois couples de frère et soeurs . Le gérant du complexe est très à  l'écoute de ses clients toujours prêt à nous rendre service et à nous conseiller....Nous  serions toujours prêts à  y retourner sans problème et nous le recommandons à tous sans hésiter....

Deluxe accommodation with bedrooms providing all you need for a luxurious stay being:- extraordinarily comfortable king size beds, modern functional bathroom, small table, fridge and coffee tea making facilities. The rooms are ultra modern, deliberately small yet functional because the breakout, work, rest or socialising areas are massive. The living room on one floor and the library on another are internally connected by a spiral staircase. Well stocked with complimentary water, apples, tea and coffee machine. Food and beverages are available for purchase through an honesty system. Great wine selection at very reasonable prices. This hotel is a premium hotel at a budget hotel price and I couldn’t recommend more highly.

review_text: Overall it's a great hotel with nice modern minimal aesthetic, friendly & helpful staff, great amenities (including Byredo, T2, Lindt, Nespresso) and was the best value at the time. For me personally, it's a great hotel for solo travel on a short trip. If I was travelling with my partner, the bed configuration would not suit us (being only open on one side, the other side is against the window) . The Library & lounge upstairs is a nice space to sit, read or chat with easy self serve facility.
management_response:
Dear picturesque08,
Thank you for taking the time to provide such kind feedback about your experience staying with us. It's always great to hear when people dig the cozy minimal aesthetic of the hotel, and I'm so glad that our staff helped you feel at home and at ease. I appreciate you letting us know where your stay felt a little awkward and I'll be sure to discuss this with our management to see where we can improve and grow. All of us here at Little National Hotel look forward to welcoming you back again sometime soon for another comfortable stay!
Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text: I booked the wrong day. They made a free last minute change to our room and gave me a better deal than I originally had. I can only make one suggestion. Our room was way too close to the managers room. Again super friendly. In fact so friendly I felt bad asking to be moved so we just laughed it off. We spent most of our time around and about so it was not a huge deal for us. Clean room and great location. Yes, it is old. Still clean and perfect for a couple night stay.
management_response: Thank you for staying. Please come again.

review_text: Came into Traverse City late and stopped at a couple of other places and felt like I was an inconvenience.  Stopped here and was treated like a guest (imagine that).  They had a little treat bag that they gave to my son and he loved it.  It had a few things in it but the memory card game was the best; we played this the whole rest of the trip!  Our room was clean and big.  The bed passed my 9 year old's bed test.  Over all a great nights rest.  Plus unlike some of the others there weren't a bunch of rowdy people hanging around outside.
management_response: Glad to hear you had a great day. Please come again.

review_text: My husband & I decided last minute to go to TC Were looking for something affordable and close to downtown. Room was clean, quiet, and less than 5 min to downtown.   Staff were super friendly, excellent service was pleasantly surprised .  Great choice if your looking for a small mom & pop place
management_response: Thank you. Great to hear. Please come again.

review_title: Stayed there for Paddle for Pints
review_text: My friend and I were looking for something convenient to downtown TC at a lower prices as we wouldn't be in the room much.  It was great!  We got there early and were able to check in.  The owner could not have been any nicer and more accommodating.  He shared his story about how he and his wife had purchased the motel in June and how they were working to turn it around.  They are in the process of updating.  Our room was clean and more than we could have asked for.  It was great to have a decent size frig, too.  I would stay here again and have already recommended it to some of my friends!
management_response: Thanks for staying. Come again.

review_title: Great Place to spend your time in northern Michigan
review_text: came to traverse city for a three days conference. got what i paid for and more, extended my stay because of the excellent service and awesome location, close to all the main attractions. Super friendly staff, clean rooms and great prices. Recommend it.
management_response: Wonderful. So happy you found the Grand Traverse Motel!  Please come again!

review_text: Grand Traverse motel was great. Very helpful and polite people. Perfect location and very convinient. Walking dictance to the  beach, city, restaurants and parks.Very quiet at night which was perfect for sleeping after a long day by the beach or activities.
management_response: Well we are thrilled you found us. Come see us again!

review_title: Just what I was looking for.
review_text: After a long day of driving driving this quiet little motel was exactly what I needed to wind down and get the rest I needed. Quiet, clean and affordable.  I was really impressed with how the lady in the office  (think it was Carla) was was able to help me with directions. Will definitely stay there again on my next trip to Traverse City.
management_response: Thank you for staying with us. So glad the Grand Traverse Motel was a great fit for you.  Come again!

review_text: In town for business I just needed a bed and shower at a good price, but got so much more I extended my stay. Great location. Near downtown, Bryant Park Beach,  and food. Great price. I paid less than the chain hotels but got more. Great service from the quick check-in to the housekeeping staff. Wonderful lil mom & pop motel that shows the affection & effort that the people involved in daily Operations put into it. A must stay if in the area.
management_response: Thanks for the Kudos! Come back again!

review_title: Great Motel, Great Location and Awesome Hospitality!
review_text: My family and I went to Traverse City recently and stayed at the Grand Traverse Motel. I highly recommend this motel because it is in a location that is in walking distance to the downtown area, the motel was very clean, the motel was affordable and the hospitality given by Carla and James which are the motel staff was exceptional!
management_response: Glad to hear. Come stay with us again.

review_text: I'll start by saying I would come here again!  The new couple that are behind the wheel of this establishment seem very genuine & eager to please & I feel confident that this place will be getting better by the day!  With remodeling & updating happening all the time (my room had a new television but older air conditioner, while my sister's had an older television & new air conditioner), I feel confident that my next stay will show even more updates.  Of course, the coffee pot & mini fridge in each room came in handy & being able to park near your room rather than half a block away was a big plus!  Close to the beach & downtown, you feel ready to explore what Traverse City has to offer.  The rooms were clean, well kept, comfortable & quiet (because they originated in the "older days" they have cement block in their walls which muffle the noises better than newly constructed ones!).  The décor had many delightful little touches that some bigger chain establishments don't bother with.  Since we were there in July, there were flags hung on the balconies & little red, white & blue ribbons & other decorations on each door.  Personal effort is definitely showing up here & again, I will come back when I'm in the area.
management_response: Thank you for staying with us. Come again.

review_text:
Everything about this property is old and dirty. The room smells moldy. The shower had old ceiling tiles in it!?! The shower flooring is soft in several places?!? Seems it was covered up w/cheap materials. Grout is cracked and covered up other old material. TV and everything in the room was old and dirty. TV was streaked with what looked like HK used a dirty rag. Had one small bar of soap and less than a half roll of TP. 
Staffing was less than professional…that’s being kind. It’s a reminder to stay away from anything “Ramada.”
Lovely staff. Spacious rooms and my dog loved it. Clean rooms and quiet. Centrally located to get to South Portland, Old Port and Falmouth

review_title: Met needs of traveler in wheelchair
review_text: Needed handicap accessible room and was very satisfied. Curbless shower and bathroom was big enough for caregiver and guest in wheelchair.

review_title: Ok for the price but non smoking room smelled of smoke
review_text: Good location and the room was very spacious. Lots of room to store bags and a seating area too. Bar was very loud although the staff were friendly. Room was supposed to be non smoking but someone had been smoking in it we had to open the sliding doors to try and get some fresh air in but the room continued to smell fusty of old smoke. It was ok for the night with comfy beds
management_response: Thank you for taking the time to let us know about your stay. Please accept my apologies for the smoke smell in your room. We are a non-smoking hotel and such issues are a rarity. If you had called the front desk, we would have been happy to provide you with another room. We hope that you will give us an opportunity to better serve you in the future.

review_text: Nice visit. Restaurant very loud with music karaoke. Everyone friendly. Clean room easily accessible to highway. Close to harbor and many excursions available at harbor. Many nice restaurants.

Sounds good on paper. The room near top of bed smelled like dog. We had to reclean the bathroom before using the shower etc. Hot tub not maintained properly. Pets in other rooms barked continuously. Could not fully open the safe due to where it is placed. Sliding door was unlocked when we arrived. 1 st. Fl.
management_response: Thank you very much for taking the time to let us know about your experience. We sincerely apologize for the housekeeping and maintenance issues you encountered during your stay. These conditions are not consistent with our standards for quality. We do, indeed, care about your experience and will utilize your comments in our ongoing training and property improvements.

review_text: Friendly desk staff, clean and a good value. Easy parking, and easy to jump off to other points in Portland including the airport- five minute drive.

review_title: Overall good value for Portland area.
review_text: Overall good value for Portland King bed was comfortable.  Shower was great. Location was convenient to downtown and plenty of free parking. Room was basic and clean. The negative. The electric outlets next to beds didn’t work. Pillows were hard and need updating. Hall carpet looked dingy.

Clean and spacious room, the appearance is a bit old but overall everything was very decent. The staff is friendly and the hotel is located on the hwy 95 and close to several restaurants so well located for traveling.

review_title: Relaxing and very hospitable. Great value for the cost. Rooms are clean and spacious. Beds are very comfortable. Great!
review_text: We enjoyed the place. Bed was so comfortable. Stacks is part of the property and a great place to have Breakfast or Lunch. They have an indoor pool and hot tub; and gym. It’s an old hotel; but clean and accommodating. Great free parking and WiFi, too! Great value for the cost.

hotel_name: Le Dimore del Gufo B&B And Apartments Suite
review_title: Refinement and Furnishing enhance the apartment
review_text: Wanting to go to Basilicata, as a first stop I booked in B. and b. The Houses of the Owl in Venosa, where the Latin Poet Horace spent his childhood.                          This B. and b. is composed of two tastefully decorated modern apartments. Ours consisted of a bedroom, a very large bathroom with two sinks and a spacious shower, a living room overlooking a terrace where you could sit and drink a coffee or a drink in peace.      These apartments are located on the third floor with elevator, a stone's throw from the historic center, with several restaurants and trattorias to enjoy Lucanian cuisine

hotel_name: Le Dimore del Gufo B&B And Apartments Suite
review_text:
The structure was equipped with every comfort: spacious, brand new, clean, furnished in a lively and welcoming..... Too bad the total abandonment of guests, the total carelessness of their needs! 
The empty dispensers, and filled only after twenty-four hours, at our insistent request. The towels for the bidet, never received, despite various requests. No one ever went in to clean anything, not even the bathroom, even though the facility was stocked with any cleaning products and tools. Breakfast, never received: on the first day we were told that they did not know it was included and that the next day they would provide it. The second day, I waited until nine and then I called, at which point they answered that for them what was in the structure was breakfast (a bagged croissant and a peach juice, to which I am allergic..., shame that there were two of us, and the aforementioned snack lay there alone since our arrival) the coffee pods (4) once finished, we bought them independently! On the third morning without any news of breakfast, fortunately we left.... The croissant is still there, alone...
The toilet leaks water from the edge with each flush, better move!!!
A real shame, venous and 'just a charm!!!

hotel_name: Le Dimore del Gufo B&B And Apartments Suite
review_text: Beautiful experience. Very cozy and all very new and modern, the place was really nice! We spent only one night but we had all the amenities available. Very kind even in the reception. I would certainly recommend the place to those who ask me and would stay there again!

The room is small but exquisite. The cost relative to the experience was 100%. The lounge and work spaces make up for the small room and are beautifully maintained. Everything about the hotel is outstanding ! The reception staff were lovely, the lovely smell as I walked in was lovely, the price of the wine was lovely. PERFECT STAY!
management_response:
Dear MZcrazyfoodie,
Thank you for taking the time to provide such kind feedback about your stay with us. I'm so glad to hear you had such a lovely stay, and that our shared spaces helped make up for the smaller rooms. It's so great to receive such positive feedback, and we all look forward to welcoming you back again sometime soon for another enjoyable stay!
Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text:
Disappointed in the changing of a once quality short stay experience for not a large price - I was charged $20 for parking overnight (arrived at 10pm) for using the Flexible Rate booking even with a VIP membership attached to a $239 p/n charge.  I wasn't told about this until check-out and potentially would have moved my car to free on street parking to avoid this cost.

No soft drinks available in the in room mini bar and the self service area was closed at 10pm
management_response:
Dear David M,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. I am genuinely sorry to hear that your recent stay did not meet your expectations.

We strive to provide excellent service and value to all our guests, and I understand how the unexpected parking charge at check-out, especially without prior communication, was frustrating. I’ll make sure to review our procedures to ensure that any additional fees, such as parking, are clearly communicated to guests at the time of booking and check-in.

As for the mini bar, I apologize for the inconvenience of not having soft drinks available in your room, and for the self-service area being closed when you needed it. I’ll be sure to review our offerings and hours to improve this aspect of the guest experience moving forward.

Your feedback is very important to us, and I’d love the opportunity to make things right. If you are visiting Canberra again, please reach out to us directly and we will ensure your next stay with us is a comfortable one.

Thank you again for your input, and I hope we’ll have the chance to welcome you back soon.
Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text:
Our experience at this hotel was nothing short of fantastic! From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by a lovely staff member who was exceptionally friendly and helpful. She not only made check-in seamless but also recommended some great activities to explore in Canberra, setting the tone for a wonderful stay.

The room itself was spotless, well appointed, and incredibly comfortable. The beds were, without a doubt, the comfiest I’ve ever slept on in a hotel, pure luxury! Every detail, from the cosy ambiance to the thoughtful amenities, made our stay even more enjoyable.
management_response:
Dear Parmida H,
We appreciate you taking the time to provide such kind and detailed insight into your experience here with us. I'm overjoyed to hear you had such a comfortable stay, and that our staff helped you feel welcome from the moment you arrived. It's great to hear as well that the room itself was to your liking, and that the beds were so comfortable for you! It's always great to hear feedback like yours, and I'm certain I speak for all our staff when I say we look forward to welcoming you back again for another enjoyable visit to Canberra!
Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text: The most comfortable sleep you will ever have, hands down. Intimate feeling rooms, gorgeous window just an overall amazing experience. The hotel smells divine and the staff are always friendly and professional. The hotel maintains a high standard of comfort and cleanliness.
management_response:
Hi Jthedges86,
Thank you for taking the time to provide valuable insight into your experience staying with us. I'm so glad to hear you had a comfortable stay, and that our staff were able to provide excellent service for you. I will be sure to share your kind words with the rest of the team, as feedback like yours helps brighten all our days! We all look forward to welcoming you back again on your next visit to Canberra.
Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text:
Lovely hotel. Largest bed I've seen in a hotel, super comfortable. 
Rooms are small but comfortable and clean. 
Great library area for business people to sit and work comfortably. 
Downside is you have to go across to the Relam hotel for breakfast or dinner and restaurants are quite pricey and food servings are a little small and Ostani is always very loud and crowded.  Chocolates on check-in a nice touch and coffee machine in the library is nice. Even have decaffeinated pods.
management_response:
Hi Annette,
Thank you for taking the time to provide us with detailed insight into your experience staying with us. I'm so glad to hear you had wonderful time staying with us and that shared spaces were a highlight to your stay. Thank you as well for letting us know where things can be improved, and we all look forward to the joy of welcoming you back again sometime soon for another visit!
Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text: The Little National Hotel is truly impressive. Although the rooms are small, the design uses an efficient layout to ensure that every corner is fully utilized, making people feel comfortable and warm. The overall environment is elegant and clean, and both the public areas and the guest rooms reflect meticulous care. Coupled with the convenient location and warm and friendly service, the stay experience is even more impressive. Overall, this is a highly recommended hotel, suitable for both business travel and leisure vacations.
management_response:
Hi Coco N,
Thank you for taking the time to provide such kind and detailed feedback about your experience with us. I'm overjoyed to hear you had a great time staying with us, and that the layout and facilities of the hotel helped you feel comfortable! I'll be sure to share your feedback with our team, as I'm sure they would love to see it, and we all look forward to welcoming you back again on your next visit to Canberra!
Warm regards,
Aidan - Duty Manager
Little National Hotel

review_text: We were here for a work event. The location of the hotel is ok I guess, given that it’s Canberra, which has little to offer in terms of shopping or entertainment. The National Gallery is around a 20 minute walk and the nearest restaurants/shopping are also a 20 minute walk in a different direction. The room is cramped and very poorly designed: the person on one side of the bed has to crawl over the other person to get in and out of bed. The bedside table is made of some material that is very noisy when you set something down on it. The shower leaks all over the floor and there is hardly any space to put your stuff by the sink. You can’t use the stairs in this hotel—I even asked at the front desk and they said no! No outdoor place to sit.
management_response:
Hi MarthaB391

We certainly embrace the little at Little National Hotel and can appreciate this style of accommodation may not suit everyone. It's disappointing to read you felt Canberra has little to offer by way of shopping and entertainment. Perhaps if you do return in the future, we can offer you a locals guide on what to do and where to go to ensure you leave Canberra pleasantly surprised.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text:
This room was booked by a third party and so I had no prior expectations. The rooms are part of a trend towards smaller and more compact layouts, and so may not be for everyone. 

I did like it, as I was solo. The bed is quite comfortable. There is a large bay window at the end of the room with access to the roof, where there are lots of plants and light from the sky above. There are opaque curtains to no one can look in. The effect is very pleasant and restful. 

The common spaces are spectacular and well-appointed, with coffee (free), snacks and drinks. Views of the hills around Canberra. 

Very helpful staff - had to leave early to airport. Bicycles for rent with locks and helmets.
management_response:
Hi Coach Thorge
Thank you for the lovely review of your recent stay, we hope to welcome you back again on a future trip to Canberra.

review_text: Best hotel I have ever had the opportunity to stay in Canberra since 1988: great location, contemporary luxury and professional friendly staff. An easy stroll from Parliament House and centrally located to the restaurant districts of Manuka, Kingston and Griffith. Definitely on my repeat visit list for future business stays.
management_response:
Hi Simon S

We look forward to welcoming you back to the best little hotel in Canberra!

review_text: LOVE the Bed!! It is extremely comfortable and overall it's a very great stay especially with the facilities and drinks that are complimentary to our stay! Staff are really friendly and helpful. Will definitely go back again some time soon :)
management_response:
Hi Aiden K

Thanks for the great review of your stay at LN. We hope to welcome you back again soon.

review_text: Super. endroit très agréable piscine superbe propriétaire sympathique bungalow confortable juste les bruits la nuit et le rideau non épais sinon c’est un super endroit pour passer un super moment en Guadeloupe à côté du centre ville et de la plage

Ti Village créole est une expérience magnifique, un accueil et une qualité irréprochable du début à la fin de notre séjour. 

Logement très accueillant et très propre, localisation idéale sur Sainte Anne. 

Piscine, climatisation et accueil au top.

review_title: Super établissement pour passer des vacances près de la plage de sainte anne
review_text: Établissement calme, propre et sécurisé. La piscine est grande. Les gérants sont aimables et serviables, ils n’ont pas hésité à nous surclasser en bungalow vue mer car l’établissement n’était pas complet, c’est magnifique ! Les bungalows sont bien équipés, propres et confortables. Je recommande cet établissement pour passer des vacances en couple, en famille ou entre amis. Seul petit bémol, la connexion wifi pas très rapide et les bruits d’animaux le matin et le soir (mais on s’y habitue vite).

review_title: J’y retournerais sans hésiter et le conseille sans restriction
review_text: Très bon accueil, bungalows très bien équipés,  les gérants ont été très serviables, nous étions 14 et avons pu organiser les petits dej et les dîners tous ensemble sur les terrasses des bungalows du bas, belle piscine. Un seul bémol, les plages à 1/4 d’heure à pied

nous avons reservés du 13 au 24 mars 2022 au ti village creole , les propriétaires sont accueillants  et sont disponibles , à l arrivée nous avions un panier avec planteur et de quoi prendre le petit dej du lendemain , les bungalow sont fonctionnels, bien equipés  et propres , le village est tranquille , satisfait à 100%  et près à revenir

review_title: Gite bien situé sur les hauteurs de sainte anne
review_text:
Gite très propre, climatisé, bien équipé à 15 minutes du centre ville. 
Accueil agréable et l équipe est très serviable. 
Le Coin piscine est agréable pour une dernière baignade. 
Demander les gîtes sur les hauteurs pour la petite vue mer.

review_title: Très bel endroit pour passer des vacances au top !
review_text: Residence parfaite pour passer un super moment en famille ou entre amis. Les bungalows sont très propres,  fonctionnels et décorés agréablement.  L environnement très joli et sécurisé. Les propriétaires,  Marta et Philippe sont charmants et très a l écoute de leurs hôtes.  Nous recommandons à 100 % cet endroit.

Posto bellissimo, bungalow pulitissimi, Marta è gentilissima e tiene tantissimo a fare stare bene i propri ospiti....vero che non è vicinissimo al centro, ma noi siamo stati una stetimana senza auto senza disagi. Scuramente torneremo!

Tres ravi du petit village creole. Phillipe le gérant a été très à l'écoute et très serviable à su répondre à toutes nos attentes. Au niveau de l'hygiène rien a redire. 
Plage la caravelle a 2 mn en voiture. Je recommande

Réservé dans l’urgence j’étais toutefois attentif aux conditions de logement. Cadre agréable. Propre et propriétaires accueillants. Un peu loin du centre toutefois. Lés bungalows sont propres. Les propriétaires sont attentifs et investis pour le bien être de leurs hôtes. Merci encore à eux.

The young couple that only recently took over operation of this motel are very enthusiastic about the opportunity and seem sincere in their desire to fix this place up.  Our room was clean, the mattresses and bedding appeared to be fairly new, the air conditioner/heater appeared new as did other appliances (coffee maker, frig).  Expensive on a smaller weekend for what you actually get but in line with many basic hotels/motels in the area during summer months.  Nice to support locals and one-off establishments vs big meg-chain hotels.   They will need to finish repairs and renovations to compete a little better and maybe add some type of continential breakfast and a few other amenities but if you are in TC in the summer, a room not directly on the beach should not be viewed as much more then a launching spot for adventures, so for that purchase it is acceptable and has the potential to be much more.
management_response: Thank you for staying with us. Come again.

review_text: A diamond of a place. Close to downtown and minutes from the beach. Surprised by how clean and well kept this 1950's era motel was. Smooth checkin from a helpful very professional but friendly staff. The new management welcomed the chance to make our stay comfortable and memorable.
management_response: Thank you for staying with us. We're glad you appreciated our Motel.

review_text:
I've stayed here a lot over the years, and it is usually pretty good. Now- it is under new ownership, and the new owners are great. By great I mean, very enthusiastic and helpful. My room was clean, and the pillows felt new. The beds are comfy and the bathroom seemed new. I felt very welcomed.

The location is one of the main reasons I stay here. Just about a mile from downtown, and it's an easy walk. The "Little Fleet" is even closer than a mile, and has food trucks and all sorts of beer options. There is a good breakfast place nearby as well. 

The rooms aren't extravagant, but you'll find them clean, again- comfy, and you're set up with coffee, a small fridge, and a television.

It's a good place to stay if you're about to start an adventure- camping somewhere in the area, or on the way to a cabin further up north. It's also a good place to stay if you want an affordable home base as you explore traverse city. 

The price, especially during the week, is right!

I would tell anyone to give this place a try. Like I said, the new owners really care about the place and want it to succeed.
management_response: Thank you for your kind thoughts. Same owner, but under new management. They are doing a nice job. Come again.

review_title: Bare bones rental but you get what you pay for.
review_text: Room ready on arrival. This is an older motel that has had some care taken but needs more remodeling. Room was essentially clean, bathroom good. Carpet looked newer. Bedding bedspread older, faded.  Linen was fresh. Mattress needs replacing due to wear & tear. A/c was working but there was a musty odor in the room ? from the unit or someone had smoked in a non-smoking room. Apt. size fridge and microwave working and clean. TV had 5 channels, two of which were shopping channel. No phone. If you don't need more, it's ok. Do not recommend.
management_response: Sorry you felt that way. Fortunately for us, based on reviews, most people feel otherwise.

review_text: It was a little after 7 p.m. when we arrived in Traverse City and this was about all that was available to us.  It looked nice on the outside but that's where the compliments end.  Our room was fairly clean but it is an old facility and has not been kept up.  Tiny, lumpy pillows; and we were unable to use the shower because the knob fell off in my hand!  Because the office was closed and did not reopen until after 10 a.m. we had to leave before we could complain.  We did return to the motel later in the day to ask for a partial refund but were refused.  This was not a low cost motel either...comparable to other, much nicer motels in town.
management_response: Unfortunately this is not an accurate representation of how this situation played out, and they have decided to leave a hurtful review. Always communicate with the office of a motel. Don't be obnoxious and belligerent. Motels don't want bad reviews, and will do their best to help.  A small mom and pop motel can not afford to give refunds to people who try to manipulate the system, make up phony scenarios, make an obnoxious scene in the office and threaten a bad review. All motels get bad reviews, some of them, deservedly so. But all motels want happy guests, and go to great lengths to make their place the best they can, and treat guests in a manner that encourages a return visit.  Unfortunately, this guest was just trying to get a free room and escalate the situation to an extreme by bullying the staff.

review_text: When I booked this hotel, the reviews on Tripadvisor were generally good.  I didn't need a fancy hotel or lots of extras so I thought this would be a good choice for the price.  The minute we checked in we realized something was not right.  The staff was less than enthusiastic, obviously did not care about the success of this motel, and proceeded to inform us that they are 'under new management'.  Looking back at recent reviews, this now makes sense.  Locks were broken, outlets didn't work, there was no housekeeping done in our room over 3 days!  We had to ask for towels and extra shampoo and ended up leaving a day earlier just because this was so horrible.  Don't stay here.
management_response: Thank you for your thoughts. We will addresses these issues.

review_text: This is an older motel that has been updated (years ago) and is now outdated! It barely has the basics, so don't look for a hair dryer or iron. My wife swears the towel was used. The toilet took 30 minutes (literally) to refill!! Old window shaker AC is noisy, and semi efficient. Sometimes we try and patronize the locals but this was beyond the low side of our comfort level. The price was no bargain. Keep driving or sleep in your car! No-no-no!
management_response: Management did everything possible to accommodate these guests, from extra towels, blankets, pillows, & space heater. They ultimately were asked to leave due to their rudeness & belligerence to the front desk help, and given a full refund. Apparently our motel was way beneath their standards, but many other people like a smaller mom and pop motel, and the testimonials on our website show it, year after year.  Hopefully these people find a better fit to meet their needs in the future.

review_text: Traverse City motel prices are not tourist-friendly.  But for $100 or more per night, we expect decent lodging.  This motel has been upgraded a bit from the 1950s, but not much.  We reserved 2 rooms (2 couples traveling together).  Our rooms were basically clean, but the other couple felt sure that the sheets had not been changed on their bed.  They also found that after housekeeping had been there the second day, their door was left unlocked.  We were not happy with managers/owners locking the office for the night, so there was no management either during the very loud party going on until 4:30 AM, or in the morning for checkout, or other needs. Wifi in the room was a bit spotty. The location is very good. Our bed was comfortable.  However, we would not stay here again, and cannot recommend it.
management_response: Sorry to hear you felt that way. The managers are doing a great job in the few months they have been here. My aunt is the housekeeper with us for 20 years. The staff was absolutely amazing and met all of our needs! 😁 They had a pool, two hot tubs, a gym, resteraunt, and bar. Everything you need is either at the hotel or within walking distance .  Within a mile radius you have multiple stores and restaurants.  Burger King is right across the street but less than a mile they also have Mc Donald's, AppleBees, Chic-Fil-A, and so much more. As far as stores they have Market Basket, Dollar Tree, & others! There's literally too much to list. There's like little shopping centers on each side of the hotel- with so many options! Within 10 minute drive There's also walmart, target, the mall, museum, and more! I was shocked at how close everything was. (My youngest doesn't do well in the car so it was so convenient!!!) review_title: Comfortable Stay with Welcoming Staff at Ramada Plaza, Portland, Maine
review_text:
Hotel Review: Ramada Plaza by Wyndham, Portland, ME

My husband and I stayed at the Ramada Plaza by Wyndham for two nights while visiting family in Portland, and overall, it was a decent experience.

The staff was notably welcoming and accommodating. They informed us that daily cleaning wasn’t standard, but we could request it if needed. We did ask for extra towels and blankets, which were promptly delivered to our room.

Our room had ample space, including a desk and side table with chairs, making it comfortable for our stay. However, we encountered a few issues with the refrigerator—it was missing shelves and a towel was left inside, but the staff quickly fixed it when we called down. It worked adequately, though the freezer wasn’t very cold.

The bathroom was on the smaller side, and I noticed the shower lacked a grab bar, which was a concern for my husband. The toiletries provided were good quality, featuring a small Dove bar and bottles of bath soap, shampoo, and conditioner. However, the bath soap was barely enough for two showers.

In summary, while there were some quirks, the welcoming staff and overall comfort made our stay enjoyable. If you’re looking for an economy option in Portland, this hotel is worth considering.
