They should make the entire premises smoke free and not just "inside the rooms", if I had planned on staying longer or using the balcony at all I would have said something. There were two beds, and I was one person, I could not use the bed closest to the balcony door because I just smelled smoke. I ended up sleeping in the second bed and it wasn't until the morning that I really smelled it again. I was barely in the room during my night there, but I even passed people outside smoking outside their rooms. 

On a different note- it was just a very oddly designed room, in the sense that the light switch was not outside the closet or inside the closet next to the door but in line with the sliding door, so the closet could not fully shut and you spent a good second looking for where the light switch was (pictures)
management_response: Thank you for taking the time to review your stay with us. I am sorry about the smoke smell issues that you experienced, that is normally not an issue as we do not allow smoking in the facility. We will use your suggestions in an effort to further minimize such problems in the future.

review_title: Would YOU stay in a room that looked like this?
review_text: This hotel room was not fully cleaned before we were assigned to stay in it. There was a thick film of dust on numerous surfaces, television, floor lamp, table lamp and bedside table. There was a used bath towel hanging on a hook in the bathroom. There was an odor of marijuana smoke in the common areas.
management_response: Please accept my apologies for the issues you experienced during your stay with us. We will utilize your comments during our ongoing staff training to ensure a better stay for future guests. I hope that you will give us another opportunity to show you our usual level of comfort and hospitality.

review_text: The hotel is dated.  Only provides occasional housekeeping during multi day stays.  Location is hard to get out of if you need to go left.  There are plenty of restaurants close and we used the location to go to Ogunquit and Kennebunk ( ~ 45 and 35 mins respectively).  Pool goes to 8 feet and they have a hot tub.  Price was cheap.  We were on back side, so did not notice traffic noise.  On a road with lots of industrial companies and traffic.  Shower was odd in that there was a spigot with no handle.  Flowers were nicely maintained and the staff was nice.  Did not eat at the restaurant.

review_title: Serviceable but would not recommend or stay again.
review_text: The hotel itself is fine, lovely lobby, nice staff, great guest lounge. We understood upon booking the rooms were compact, also fine, however this is where the passable comments cease. The room was disgustingly dirty - clumps of hair on the floor, in the shower, on the walls, stained and soiled bed sheets, marks and stains all over the walls and tiles (which could easily be cleaned with a basic wipe), dirt and other rubbish between the bed and window. A thorough clean would do this hotel room wonders, it was clear that the cleaning that is done is rushed and not done properly. Wished we brought our shower shoes! The level of hygiene was well below what should be offered in a hotel, let alone a 4 star hotel. Such an easy thing to fix, yet such a crucial element to get right!!! Do better Little National!
management_response:
Dear Emily, Thank you for sharing your recent stay experience and I am sorry to hear it failed to meet your expectations.  This was quite surprising to read as we do have a high housekeeping standard.  I have raised this with our housekeeping supervisor to check your particular room at the time and to get this rectified.  I apologise for this and hope you will have the opportunity to stay with us again.  Please reach out to me directly for any future reservations so I can personally oversee your booking.
Regards - Michelle -

review_text: Great location and excellent value. Simple and modern rooms and bathrooms. I just found the bed too soft and the pillows too high to have a good nights sleep. The bar and library hangout areas are a nice touch to enjoy the sunset plus sparkling water on tap or the self service bar should you so please.
management_response:
Thank you for sharing your recent experience.  Our mattresses are plush by design however we are more than happy to provide lower pillows upon request.  I am pleased that you enjoyed our common areas.  I hope to be able to welcome you back to the hotel in the future.
Regards - Guest Services

review_text: Fantastic facilities. Well located hotel. Superb sleeping experience as the block out makes a huge difference. Will be back every time I visit Canberra. Everything about the hotel works. The library was so useful to have a meeting and also grab a cup of tea. The bonus free movies available, some of them super recent was a very nice addition.
management_response:
Hi Cristina S

Great to read that our little hotel exceeded your expectations. We look forward to welcoming you back.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: The beds are like sleeping on a cloud! I highly recommend the Little National and I always have a fantastic experience when staying. The experience from booking through to checking out is perfectly executed and consistent across Canberra, Sydney and Newcastle.
management_response:
Hi Kimberley

Thanks for the great review of your recent stay at Little National Canberra. It's wonderful to read that you have found a consistently positive experience across all three of our LN hotels. We hope to welcome you back again soon.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: Compact rooms, but very practical and felt quite luxurious. The self-serve bar and library areas were very inviting with a great view. The staff were friendly and helpful. The bed was amazing (although I personally prefer pillows that are a little less fat).
management_response:
Hi 219jmac

Thank you for the lovely feedback. We hope to welcome you back again soon.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_title: Worth driving from Sydney to stay.
review_text: The blackout blinds are exactly that. The beds are like sleeping on clouds and huge. The rooms are very quiet- we didn’t hear a thing all afternoon or night. We love this place and it is our ‘go to’ place when we need to stay in Canberra. Will definitely stay again and again!
management_response:
Hi Malanie W

Thanks for taking the time to review your recent stay. At LN, we truly believe it's the little things that count and hope to welcome you back again soon.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: LN is our home away from home when visiting Canberra, which we frequently do.  I highly recommend it.  LN is modern, efficient and very on trend.  But at the same time welcoming and so so friendly.  The quality of the bed and pillows will ensure you get a good night's rest.  And the room not only has pod coffee, but a teapot!
management_response:
Hi SKOOBIEVOL

Thanks for making LN your home away from home in Canberra. We certainly hope to see you again for another little getaway.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: The room, was very comfortable.  I had difficulty operating the TV, but that wasn't really an issue. In house parking was convenient and it made it easier that the parking area has a vertical clearance of 2.3m, as my car is 2.1m tall.  The breakfast bar next door was also conveniently located, making my departure smooth and breakfast pleasant.
management_response:
Dear Peter

Thanks for reviewing your recent stay. We hope to see you again soon for another little getaway.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: Great boutique hotel in Parliament House precinct.  Very new and very modern with modern and bright decor.  Classy touches and really liked the study/library area.  Room I had was compact, comfortable, and equipped with everything I needed.  Friendly and helpful service.
management_response:
Hi Andrew,
Thank you for your great view.  Yes our location is certainly in a great spot.  All our rooms are  "little" luxury with nothing compromised.  I am pleased you enjoyed your stay.  I hope you will be able to visit again.
Kind regards Michelle - Front Office Manager

review_title: Great Value & beautiful sleep in Canberra
review_text: Excellent - staff AMAZING.  Bed just so comfortable - beautiful linen & towels & bathrobes!  Library amazing.  Couldn't recommend highly enough & this will certainly be my choice of accommodation in Canberra in the future.  Very good value for money.
management_response:
Hi Ang,
Thank you for providing feedback on your recent experience.  Our team at Little National are committed to providing high quality customer service and I am thrilled you noticed.
Please come back and visit again soon.
Regards Michelle - Front Office Manager

review_text:
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans ce beau village créole. Bel accueil, gentillesse et discrétion des propriétaires. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir. Nous avons été manger chez Emy qui est proche de la résidence et nous nous sommes régalés dans cette ambiance familiale! 

Tiffanie & Benoît
management_response: merci pour nous et pour Emy.

review_text:
Nous venons de rentrer de Guadeloupe nous y avons passés un séjour sublime le tit village Créole est très agréable accueille au top avec un petit pot de bienvenue (fruit, rhum, jus de fruit frait, bouteille d'eau) les patrons sont très agréable et à l'écoute.
Les bungalows propres et tout confort!
Nous recommandons vraiment cette établissement qui met direct la tête en vacance vous y serez très bien! 
Jessica et Coralie

review_title: Idéal pour passer une semaine sur Grande Terre
review_text: Accueil chaleureux. Studio confortable et fonctionnel. Tout est mis à disposition par les propriétaires pour passer un bon séjour. Idéalement situé à deux pas du centre de Saint-Anne, et de ses magnifiques plages. Nous recommandons vraiment ce lieu où nous y avons passé un agréable séjour.
management_response:
Merci que vous passiez un agréable séjour chez nous.
Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
Fabienne et Jean savent vous accueillir tout de suite. Merci à eux pour leur acceuil et leur conseil. Nous avions des fruits, du cafe et tout le nécessaire pour un ti punch....quel regal
Nous étions dans le studio qui est très bien pour couple, très bien équipé et très propre. 
La piscine est tres bien et le lieu est idyllique 

Le logement est très bien situé pour visiter tous les lieux de l'est de la Guadeloupe et ste Anne est top pour sortir boire un verre (vivant sans être trop touristique)

Un grand merci à Fabienne et Jean et très bonne continuation 

Les bretons, Angeline et Étienne 

Ps : une mention particulière d'angeline....à quand notre prochaine visite......
management_response:
Bonsoir Angéline et Etienne,
Merci de votre gentil retour, nous sommes ravis de vous avoir reçu au Ti Village Créole.
A très bientôt (n'est-ce pas Angéline!)
Fabienne et Jean

review_text: Nous avons passé 15 jours de rêve à Ti village créole , au calme, dans un écrin de verdure, non loin à pied du centre et des plages. Le logement est simple mais fonctionnel , rien ne manque. Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Fabienne , malgré notre arrivée tardive. Une corbeille de fruit et un nécessaire à ti-punch nous met dans l’ambiance .👌. Tout était parfait , seul petite remarque sur le bruit de la climatisation dans notre chambre  . Nous gardons précieusement l’adresse , peut être pour nos prochaines vacances d’été. Merci à vous . Coup de ❤️Guadeloupe.
management_response:
Heureuse que vous ayez passé un bon séjour et que vous ayez eu le coup de coeur pour notre île.
A bientôt, peut-être.
Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
Le coin plutôt agréable mais je déplore fortement l’accueil réservé aux résidents 
Une visite très rapide des lieux.Pas un sourire sur les les lèvres, ton très sec.
Pas le droit d’offrir même un verre à un ami.
Accès particulièrement difficile pour les personnes âgées et handicapées. J’ai quitté la résidence au bout de deux jours alors réservée pour 15 jours et qu’elle ne fut pas mon étonnement quand j’ai annoncé mon départ des lieux. Aucune question sur les raisons et aucune réaction sur le visage de ces gens désagréables au possible. Plus jamais.
management_response:
Bonjour, 
Vous avez souhaitez réserver un studio (tarif promo pour petit budget) et comme précisé sur le site internet, les studios ne sont pas recommandés pour les personnes âgées, les femmes enceinte ou à des personnes ayant des problèmes de santé.
Les visites ne sont pas autorisées effectivement mais vous nous avez dit l'avoir lu quelques jours avant votre arrivée, d'où mon étonnement sur la question puisque vous en étiez informée..
Pour l'accueil, désolée que cela ne vous ait pas été agréables, nous allons nous améliorer même si nos autres vacanciers en sont satisfaits.
Je souhaite néanmoins que vos vacances se soient bien passées et que vous reviendrez sur notre jolie île.
Fabienne

review_text:
Nous avons passé un magnifique séjour. Nous avions un studio et tout était parfait. Ti village Créole est idéalement situé à Sainte Anne, proche de la plage de Saint anne (nous pouvions nous y rendre à pied) et du marché, proche également de la plage de la caravelle.
Les gérants nous conseil volontiers pour les excursions et les choses à ne pas rater. 
Nous reviendrons sans hésiter.
management_response:
Et nous vous accueillerons avec grand plaisir à nouveau...
Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
Superbe !!! propreté, équipement, accueil, cadre, situation, calme, végétation, !!! que chercher de plus ! les coqs, les poules, les poussins: top! mangoustes en trop : 6 poussins au début et 1 seul à la fin !!!!!!
Rapport qualité-prix au top, gérants au top
On ne demande qu'à revenir !!!!

Nous sommes restés 4 nuits au Ti Village Créole. Nous sommes ravis de notre séjour, le logement très propre, agréable  avec toutes les commodités. Cuisine extérieure sur la terrasse parfaite pour se préparer les repas. Le cadre nous permet d'être dans la végétation, sans vis à vis. 
Parking sécurisé, piscine agréable. Il est  quand même préférable d'avoir une voiture pour aller à Saint Anne même si ce n'est qu'à quelques minutes, mais la marche sous la chaleur ... 
Accueil sympathique malgré notre arrivée tardive.
Nous avons utilisé le service du traiteur " Le Perroquet" avec livraison de plats pour le repas d'arrivé extra et du coup nous avons commandé un soir de plus.
Bref, nous retenons l'adresse si jamais nous devions revenir !

review_title: Très bonne adresse très bien situé C'était Parfait
review_text:
Séjour idéal , tout était parfait. Nous avons passé près de 3 semaines à Ti'Village Créole, dans un magnifique jardin exotique et dans un calme idylique. Le bungalow était d'une propreté irréprochable, très bien agencé, et très bien équipé, dans un décor sobre et de bon goût. Nous avions une vue sur mer lors de la descente à notre bungalow, ce qui était bien agréable. Nous avons appréciez la gentillesse et le dévouement de Fabienne et Jean, qui font en sorte que votre séjour soit le olus agréable possible. Ti'Village Créole est très bien situé, nous allions à pied à la plage de Saint-Anne (la plus belle plage de l’île à notre avis) où vous trouvez tous les commerces et les marchés locaux.
Le mot de la fin : excellente adresse, juste parfait à refaire.
Patreice et Régine
management_response:
A très bientôt avec grand plaisir. 
Fabienne et Jean

review_title: New Managers were very helpful. We'll be back.
review_text: I have stayed here a few times over the years.  I come back because its always clean & the price is right.  Everything in Traverse City is so expensive and this place meets my needs as a traveler who whats something affordable.  I am not one who looks for the amenities of a Marriott or big branded chain hotels.  Comparing to other smaller mom & pop hotels that have been kept up well, this fits the bill for me.  I see other reviews & recognize some frustrations people have had with previous managers but the couple here are new as of Thanksgiving & were very friendly. They gave me extra coffee as well as an extra pillow.  I have spoke to the lady who has done the house keeping for years.  She was very friendly & helpful & my rooms have always been clean.  It seems like some people find something to gripe about everywhere they go.  If this little motel is the type of place you typically stay at, I recommend it.  If you are a fancy hotel person, this may not be what you are looking for.  We are happy with it.

review_title: WHY DIDN'T I CHECK TRIPADVISOR BEFORE STAYING HERE??
review_text: Will not stay there again. We were desperate, tired and they had a room. Cost a little over $75.00 and no discounts because the price was already low?? I should have looked at the room first but hubby and I were so tired. When the desk clerk handed me a real key with a plastic tag my mind said oh no. Anyway, no breakfast and no decaf coffee in room, the beds were old and very uncomfortable, TV was old and only 10 stations including shopping, regular and Weather Channel, WIFI was weak, We asked for a late check out when we checked in and were told sure. The next morning the housekeeper/desk clerk knocked on our door. I told her we were give a late check out and she said "NO WAY" so we packed up and gave the key back and left. I told them I should have looked at  Tripadvisor first and the clerk said those were written about the old manager. I smiled and said that doesn't change the old, outdated rooms and the way we were treated. Will not go back.

review_title: I'd rather sleep in my car
review_text:
I knew from the moment I walked into the office that I shouldn't stay, but I was tired.  
The motel room would have been over-priced at 60 bucks rather than the 165 I was suckered into paying.   Lucky us, we were given the owner's favorite room.  Poor man!  The door didn't close without major jiggling.  The room had that lived in smell and the carpet looked dirty and worn.  The decor was flea market Elvis, and the coffee maker was an appetizing 3 feet from the toilet.  The wifi did not work.
We were very glad to leave in the morning.

After staying 2 nights we found out that room service is not included after coming back to our room and finding the beds unmade and towels still on the floor. We were told that no new towels etc were done unless you stay three nights. There was no signage in the room stating this. They were happy to give us more towels once asked but we had to go back for toilet paper, soap, coffee and anything else that normally is replaced daily. Front office closes at 10 pm and opens later in am, so can't get in for anything during those times.

My wife and I stayed here two years ago in July and the hotel served us well.  Close to downtown, relatively quiet, and affordable.  So, when we went back to TC in september 2014 we went back to the same motel.  we should have walked out from the beginning but sadly didn't.  The male running the desk looked drugged up, was rude, and was filthy.  We asked how much for a room for 2 days he said 168.00 which was ok.  When he charged my credit card it was for 336.00 as he said it was 168.00 a night(!).  We got a refund and started to walk when he agreed to the original price.  The room was semi-clean, carpet disgusting(do not walk barefoot!) and our beds were never made or new towels provided.  Skip this hotel is my recommendation to you.  There are better in TC.

This is an old motel but the beds were comfortable, it was clean, the wifi worked, and the room showed some fairly recent signs of having been updated. Staff was pleasant and check-in was hassle-free, and it was nice having a small fridge and microwave in the room. However, not having a telephone in the room and having only the most bare-bones cable TV channels (No ESPN? Really?) is a bit puzzling considering the price paid for the room (approximately $80). I feel like we probably could have done better elsewhere for the price and the fact it was off-season. It was a decent night's sleep, though, and that's what matters, I guess.

Room was large and Clean. Nice to park at front door to prepare for day trips. Very limited service here and Tv choice not much but that is not why we were there.. TC is an expensive town to stay. We were there on the weekend of Film Festival but for other reasons. There was an upcharge on the rooms- Cant blame them- the town was sold out. We felt very safe and it was a good base for our visit. Set outside and had refreshments with other travelers one night and that was very pleasant. 
  I think these owners are new to the hotel and maybe even the hotel business. Note the pictures are old and the pool was closed. There was a lot of work/painting going on.  I had to be in touch for reservations the old fashion way. Leave a message and they returned my call. 
  We would stay here again if our needs and expectations were the same.

review_title: If you have to stay somewhere on a budget, I suppose there could be worse.
review_text: This was a last minute trip. I needed someplace close to better hotels on an extreme budget. The grand traverse was it. Negatives? No cable TV, barely pulled in one network station, and that was fuzzy. Hot and cold water knobs in the shower were switched. Surprise! No bathroom fan. On the positive side it was the cheapest around. Rooms are relatively clean. Owners seem to be on site and also take care of room cleaning. It's a motel in a tourist city. It's near the beach. You could do worse. Caveat emptor, but on a budget, it will do.

What a great location, close to downtown and the beach.  The price was fair in my opinion.  Those griping about the price in previous reviews need to shop around and see what others are charging...this is Traverse City in the Summer people...prices are going to be higher than some Podunk town!  Yes this is a older motel but my room was very clean, no smell of smoke or any other odors.  Think there was fresh paint throughout the room and looked like bathroom had been redone.  Outside the landscaping was nice and seemed to be well maintained.  My experience of the staff was friendly and helpful with some questions we had about the area.  Love TC and plan to come back again this year and we would choose this place again based off our overall experience.

The guy who checked us in was awful. He was really rude and sarcastic - right from the start. He definitely didn't deserve our business, and I wish we would have just left. I would rather have slept in our car. I was so upset by the way we were treated. The room smelled like vomit - really. The whole experience was so bad. My boyfriend mentioned it to one of the staff the next morning. He's usually a pretty mellow guy, but he wasn't holding back. I would never recommend this place to anyone!

The hotel is very dated and unclean.  The lobby smelled of backed up sewer line. The room had dirt and mold on the floor and shower. The restaurant and bar were closed due to lack of staff. The hallway smelled from marijuana odor. Overall very disappointed based on price.
management_response: On behalf of our entire team, I would like to apologize for failing to meet your expectations. Your satisfaction is important to us and we will be using the feedback you provided to make improvements to ensure we offer an exceptional experience for our guests in the future.

review_text: The wifi was so slow it was not usable. The restaurant/bar was closed. The carpets were dirty. The noise from Route 95 was very loud all night. DON'T GO HERE!
Nice clean hotel. Had the business room which was very roomy. Do need to get rid of carpet with being a pet friendly hotel. Upgrade bathroom towels & toilet tissue.

A rather expensive hotel for what you get. I stayed in part because of the “fitness center” which has to be the worst hotel gym I have ever seen. There are not even dumbbells, and the only strength training equipment is one sad cable machine.

The worst part of the experience: Someone had set the alarm clock in my room to go off at 3am. Not ideal when you’re trying to manage jet lag. I imagine the previous tenant thought this would be funny, and staff unfortunately didn’t notice.

In summary: won’t be back.
management_response: I am sorry that our fitness center did not meet your expectations. Our guests usually find the equipment and room to be more than sufficient for a good workout. There certainly is no excuse for your alarm clock going off at 3am, that shouldn't have happened, and we certainly apologize for not noticing it prior to your arrival.

review_text: They have the best Breakfast place attach to the hotel  Really good Breakfast.  Clean rooms.  Nice people.  Easy in and easy out.

This place needs a serious overhaul!!  The air conditioning is probably the original one when this place was built, probably in the 70’s.  It was soooo loud that every time it kicked in I woke up thinking a truck drove into the room. When we complained, the manager said it was supposed to be that loud, that is what air conditioners sound like.  Well -   TIme to upgrade.  For the price, I expected a nice room, it also needs a facelift.  We had at least 3 huge beetles in the bathroom and the carpet stank.  I did NOT put my suitcase on the floor!    It is clear the moment you walk in , that the place hasn’t been upgraded since it was first built.   Ramada Plaza by Wyndham??? I thought the name alone, through reputation, would be better, but this place was such a disappointment that I’m not sure Ramada is a name I would consider quality/modern or clean at this point. I’ll be avoiding Ramada in the future. The price is ridiculous for what you get.

Overall, this was a good trip to Portland,  Maine, it could've been better.
The hotel was average.   No big issues, but issues nonetheless.   The bed was too soft and the pillows could use an upgrade,  but it was pretty clean and the staff was good.
The best thing was the Stacks restaurant.   The food was wonderful so it was a real bonus.  There was another restaurant there as well, but Stacks had breakfast and lunch!  We went to breakfast every morning and absolutely enjoyed it!
The location was good, the grounds were good.  Adequate parking and again the staff was good.

There is a “cabaret” directly across the street and seems some “employees” stay multiple nights at this hotel. Shady guests in and out, late night in parking lot, saw man stumbling in parking lot and stopped, then walked inside. Would not stay here again. Housekeeper seemed to be a little off as well. Front desk night staff rude.

The bed was comfortable. The air conditioner worked well once we figured it out. The rooms need updating and the bathrooms are deplorable. No ventilation, dirty tub with actual strands of hair dangling on the tile and faucet. When we parked our vehicle in the lot, we noticed a woman and 2 men in the truck beside us smoking some kind of chemical like crack or meth. We overheard the staff talking about a huge party in one of the rooms and those guests had to be evicted. There was a "service" dog who went after an employee too. And during the last night of our trip, at about 1:15am, I looked out the window to see police cars and uniformed officers searching the parking lot and bushes near the rooms with their flashlights. The eventually found the man they were looking for. He was yelling gibberish and kept repeating he was drunk. 

Moral of the story is: You get what you pay for! We won't make that mistake again.

this hotel worked fine for us. It's nothing "special" but it really wasn't bad. Check in and check out experiences were fine. We didn't run into any glitches. There was plenty of parking and being on the ground floor was helpful with our bags. The Wi-Fi was actually quite bad in our room and the TV was smaller that what we've had in other rooms. The bed was comfortable enough and room temperature was fine. There was quite a lot of traffic noise in our room. There didn't seem to be a breakfast inclusive option here. We were instructed that there was a restaurant connected with the property where we could go for breakfast.

Cute little hotel for an overnight stay… big comfy bed, close to the marina and wetlands… did a great walk… compact and cute… the whole Doma precinct was buzzy… would definitely come back to stay again.. the library is a great idea … lovely view out over the mountains
management_response:
HI Kate,
Thank you for taking the time to review.  I agree, our AH Beard beds are amazing.  You can also buy them on our DOMA shop!!
Look forward to seeing you again in the future.
Regards Michelle - Front Office Manager

review_text: Great location. Terrific staff, & rooms. Intimate, yet modern & stylish, with the feel of being 'away & relaxed'. Love staying here and always look forward to returning. The Lounge / library area is an 'oasis' within an oasis. If you know , you know.
management_response:
Hi Todd,
Thank you for your review.  We also embrace the "Little" here at Little National.l  I am pleased you like the concept.  We hope to be able to welcome you back again soon!
Regards Michelle

review_title: Simple, comfy and OMG the bed !!!!
review_text:
Simply loved everything about my stay here, the room is perfect for a business stay, the lounge/ work area is just amazing and functional 

And the staff !!!!! OMG always present and helpfull. 

Walking distance from the main workplaces of Canberra (approx 10-15 mins)

This is now my place for next time in Canberra
management_response:
Dear Guest,
Thank you for your great review.  I am thrilled you enjoyed your stay with us.  I look forward to being able to welcome you back to the hotel in the future.
Regards Michelle

review_title: Compact Comfort with Scenic Lounges at Little National Canberra
review_text:
My two-day stay at Little National Canberra was a bit of a mixed experience. The room was clean and comfortable, but very small. It was manageable for me as a solo traveler, but for two people, it would likely feel cramped. The bed’s position, right next to the window, only allows access from one side, meaning couples might have to climb over each other to get to their side of the bed. The bathroom was similarly small and challenging to navigate if sharing the space.

Despite requesting room cleaning, no service was provided during my stay, which was disappointing. However, the hotel shines in other areas. The top-floor lounge is stunning, offering beautiful views of the city and sunsets—a perfect spot to enjoy a cup of coffee. There’s also a lovely library on the fifth floor with complimentary tea and coffee. It seems like the hotel encourages guests to spend time outside their rooms, as the small spaces could feel claustrophobic during a longer stay.

The front desk staff were friendly and helpful, offering restaurant recommendations and assisting with finding an adapter for my laptop. Overall, it was a good stay, especially for solo travelers or those with meetings nearby. For longer stays or for couples, though, it might feel a bit tight.
management_response:
Dear MJP_India,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We certainly embrace the little at Little National and can appreciate this style of accommodation may not suit everyone. Whilst our rooms are little, the spacious Library and Lounge are perfect spaces to relax or work from. If you like the location but prefer a more traditional hotel room layout, I can highly recommend our sister properties of Hotel Realm, Burbury Hotel and Brassey Hotel.
Regards Michelle - Front Office Manager

review_title: Recommend this hotel highly for your next stay in Canberra!
review_text: LOVED the bedsheets and the room decor, bed and pillows were super comfy and the shower pressure great! Note the windows open, but have NO SCREENS so if you open any mosquitos will get in.  

They expect you to dump your garbage and clean the room, but you ARE going to get charged a 30 Euro cleaning fee NO MATTER WHAT.

They said the towels are changed mid-visit - ours were not. No beach towels provided. TV was tiny, but we weren't interested in TV anyway.

review_title: So absolutely nothing has changed- still a DUMP!
review_text: The only positive comment is that the room was relatively clean. Nothing has been upgraded since the 50's, the towels were threadbare, the blankets- can't even begin to describe. The  window air conditioning unit worked for 10 mins. before blowing a fuse, after which the coolest it ever got was 77. There were two screens in the four windows, one that had several half dollar sized holes in it. The toilet stopped functioning on our second night, discovered it was rigged with a twist tie- obviously the owners knew there was a problem! The refrigerator barely cooled and the controls had been ripped out of the interior. There was a swimming pool covered by a sunken cover filled with pine needles. The office and housekeeping staff were very nice. Wish we had read these reviews prior to booking.

The bathroom could have been cleaner, there was a bar of soap left in the top of the tub surround. The rest of the room was clean.
Air conditioning worked great!
The bed was hard but great pillows.
I had a smoke free room and it really was smoke free.
Reception was very helpful pointed me to a great restaurant.
I will likely stay at another Hotel I like clean bathrooms.

review_title: Great location for the Cherry Fest
review_text:
We attended the Cherry Fest on July 7-8 and needed something close to town.  Closest hotel under $200 for the weekend.  The man at the front desk was friendly and helpful. Our room, #127 was large and clean. There were a few chipped tiles but the room was clean and the air worked great! It is an older hotel so if you are used to newer chains you may be disappointed.  Our stay was fine and would go back during festival time.
 The only problem would be the ice machine since it is in the office so you can't get to it after hours.  Also, the pool was not available. It looked like they might be closing it for good. If you want a pool during your stay be sure to ask when booking.

review_title: Great hotel - we will be back!
review_text: First, I have to say I was a bit nervous with the mixed reviews but I was pleasantly surprised. Yes, the rooms are not brand new. If you really look there are some "blemishes." A small stain, older curtains, grout coming loose, but overall our room was clean and comfortable. It was also half the price of other motels in the area and no extra charge for a room that slept 5. (trust me this is VERY hard to find) The gentleman at the desk (the owner?) was very nice. The pool was not heated, but it was clean and a great way to cool off. Loved that our room had a good size mini fridge, microwave, coffee pot and a well functioning AC unit (all vital). Also the location is great. Short walk to the beach, plenty of restaurants within walking distance and the walk to downtown was also very manageable even with our 3 children. No, this is not a 5 star resort, but it is a clean, comfortable, affordable motel. When we visit TC again we will stay here!

The amenities say "Heated pool"....not really....they have a solar cover thats it.  Maybe by late August it will be heated.  "Free Wi-Fi".....sorta....sure its free...however you can only get a connection outside or right by the window.  Toilet worked for 2 days then you had to jiggle the handle or remove lid and monkey with chain to flush.  Tub...nasty....short shower and your standing in 6 inches of water.  How about we fix the drains??  I agree with smelly...and stains....unacceptable for the price.  Bathroom floor...i agree again....due to the terrible drain we had some water on the floor. I wiped it up...the towel was filthy...no way in 24 hours did that floor get that dirty.  Greg..give it up...stop with the excuses...it is what it is.   Motel/Trash is what i would call it.

review_title: Great overall experience. Love this hotel and enjoyed my stay in Portland.
review_text:

This hotel is located in Scarborough. Just a few min from downtown Maine.

The bed was dirty, the carpet was dirty, there was dog hair in the bed, and dog food on the floor. There was pink mould in the shower. It was nasty. The room smelled so bad we kept having to spray perfume in the room because my 5 year old son would gag every time we came back inside. Awful.
The bed was very uncomfortable.

After spending some vacation time in the Lakes Region in New Hampshire, I went to the Portland area for some different activities. 

I arrived at the Ramada Plaza at mid-afternoon along with a lot of other people checking in.  It was quite a wait.  

After check-in, I went to my room.  The keys did not work.  I went back to the desk.  The desk woman gave me reset keys.  Those didn’t work. She came with me with her master key.  She had a problem, too.  She gave the door a good hard pull closed.  Then, she tried her key again. It worked.  The problem was with the door itself.  She assigned me to a different room.  The keys worked just fine.  I dropped off my suitcase and rested for a couple of minutes.

Next, I checked to make sure that everything worked.  

The room had two beds, a good-sized bench, a table and two chairs, a desk, mini-fridge, coffee/tea maker, hair dryer, bathroom amenities, alarm clock, iron, ironing board, in-room safe and a good-sized 40” or 44” TV. 

There was no desk lamp or light at or near the desk.  The woman at the front desk arranged to have a floor lamp brought to the room while I was out.  When I returned a couple of hours later, the  lamp had been brought in.

The bathroom was compact.  There was a second sink / vanity area in the room near the door and closet.

Overall, it was a comfortable stay.  The room and bathroom were clean. The bed was just right for my liking.  There were no other issues. 

My interactions with staff were very satisfactory.  I didn't have any problems with the three employees I needed to speak with.  My issues were resolved quickly and courteously.

The only drawback here was that this hotel in the Wyndham chain did not serve free breakfast.  This was quite unusual.  

The hotel did have the Stacks Pancake Co. that served breakfast and lunch between 6:00 AM and 2:00 PM.  I did not eat there.  I had other plans to go to IHOP in South Portland.

One more thing on the plus side is that checkout time is before noon, rather than the usual 11:00 AM. 

Based on my experience with the room and staff during my July 2023 stay, my rating is 4.25.  

The only caveat is that standards, staff, and quality of service can change for better or worse over time. 

The reason for the delay in submitting this review was due to a months-long loss of my ability to post photos with my reviews and some health issues.

If you found this review useful, please click the THUMBS UP to indicate HELPFUL.

location and amenities 
It was easy to check in and check out.  The room was clean and heating system is comfortable.
If you decide to stay here, take pictures of the room as you left it. Otherwise you might be falsely accused of trashing the room.

review_title: Comfy, clean rooms at a reasonable price.
review_text: For the price our rooms were great. The location is easy to find just off the exit. Our adult kids enjoyed using the pool and hot tub after we had dinner at the Volcano Bar and Grill, where the food was exceptional. I would recommend the French dip.  We had the bonus of enjoying a local rock band which started at 7:00 and had a fun set list which the older crowd in the bar were dancing to. We hung around after dinner to enjoy the free entertainment. We ate breakfast at Stacks which had everything you could imagine for breakfast combos. It's nice to be able to enjoy a stay without having to travel out to find good food at a reasonable price. We will stay here again when we take a weekend getaway. I shopped around when planning this trip and this was by far the best price I found at a large national chain hotel. We could afford to pay more but why waste the money if you don't need to.

review_text: Nous avons séjourné ici pendant une semaine . La situation est parfaite pour sillonner l île , le cadre est très agréable . Le bungalow était spacieux et bien équipé ( peut être un petit bémol sur la literie ) nous n hésiterons pas à recommander  ce ti village !

Très bel emplacement, pour cette résidence, tout était parfait, le must: tout le nécessaire pour se préparer un Planteur sur la terrasse, le jour de notre arrivée, je recommande sans aucune hésitation, j'y retourne au plus vite !

L'établissement est bien situé, à quelques minutes du centre il offre en apparence une position  calme et reposante.
Malheureusement dès la première nuit, c'est un effroyable vacarme qui surgit lorsque le premier coq lance les hostilités à 4h du matin .. C'est alors que tous les coqs prennent d'assaut le bungalow et se répondent, plus violemment chaque fois, les uns aux autres.
Ceci peut être une bonne façon d'être actif et levé de bonne heure les premiers jours mais après une semaine passée c'est l'épuisement qui domine et la tension dûe au manque de sommeil qui se fait ressentir. 
Même la vieille chaussette qui fait office de matela ne suffit pas à nous revigorer. 
Il est vrai que la gentillesse des propriétaires peut nous faire oublier certains aspects négatifs du lieu mais pour ça il aurait fallu les connaître.. Jean (je le connais seulement de part les autres avis Trip ) n'a pas souhaité se présenter et Fabienne nous a acceuilli d'une façon chronométrée, préférant vite retourner au restaurant où elle dînnait (cela dit, ça peut se comprendre).
C'est donc 9 nuits que nous avons pu tenir tête et tympan à la basse-cour avant de plier bagage prématurément vers un autre établissement paisible et reposant à Deshaie ( bien que Fabienne nous ai mis en garde sur l'omniprésence des coqs, "cela sera partout pareil "selon ses dires ..).
Je ne m'attarderai pas sur le lots de consignes et restrictions qui nous sont martelées dès notre arrivée.
Personnellement je ne comprends pas l'engouement pour ce lieu, il existe des endroits beaucoup plus charmant avec des propriétaires adorables.
Je préciserai que je n'ai pas pour habitude de nuir par une critique à un commerçant gratuitement mais là votre classement est immérité.
Faites quelque chose pour l'isolation phonique (Ou un commerce de poulet rôti)  et pour la literie.
Dernière chose, laissez tomber la rigueur des hôtels sans âme et adopter plutôt la gentillesse des gérants de chambre d'hôtes, c'est bien plus efficace.

Kathryn

review_text: The most memorable parts of the hotel were the beds and the library. Lots of nice touches and it was good to have somewhere other than your room to sit and have a complimentary Nespresso.
management_response: We adore our beds too! There is a great reason they are branded 'Arms of Morpheus' after the God of Sleep.

review_text: Tiny rooms, limited hanging space (can't even hang a towel) and totally not suitable for a business traveler
management_response:
Hi 829glennj

We certainly embrace the little at Little National and can appreciate this style of accommodation may not suit everyone. Thank for giving us a go!

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: I had booked this trip at the start of the year as a birthday surprise for my partner. Hotel was smaller than I expected but room size was fine. Room was quite dusty which surprised us. Bed was super soft and as a result we did not feel like it gave much support plus fitted sheet kept coming up at the corners esp on the inside of the bed. Poor quality sleep due to mattress & pillows.
management_response:
Hi MargaretC2700

Thanks for sharing your feedback. Apologies we were unable to meet your expectations on this occassion. Whilst our mattresses are plush by design, we can appreciate they may not suit everyone's personal preference. 

Your feedback has been shared with our housekeeping team to ensure dust is addressed in all rooms.

I hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back on a future stay to experience a seamless experience indicative of the standard LN is proud to deliver.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: More than just a place to stay Little National offers so much more. Design led rooms and amenities, ambience filled shared spaces and the service you expect for a short stay in the capital. Faultless. PS. Spring is such a great time for a holiday in Canberra. So many places to dine, explore and get out and about in the fresh air.
management_response:
Hi Ieonab25x
Thanks for the great review of your recent little getaway. We hope to welcome you back again soon.
PS. You're absolutely right, Spring is a great time to visit Canberra!

review_text: Clean, modern, centrally located, practical overnight hotel, compact rooms but everything you need for a quick business trip.
management_response:
Hi Hugh B
We agree, LNC has everything you need and nothing you don't We look forward to welcoming you back!
Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: This is a really great hotel. When I travel for work I don't like staying in a big chain where all the rooms look the same. This hotel is really great value - under $200 a night - and has a lot of little touches that make it genuinely comfortable and enjoyable to stay (robes, minibar, Ubereats service, little chocolates, the honour bar, the library with free apples, sparkling water on tap and unlimited hot beverages). Really luxurious! Makes travelling for work really nice.
management_response:
Hi mmagladry

Thanks for the great review of your recent stay. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

review_text: the bed is positioned against the window , only 1 side has access , if you are a couple - one person has to climb over the other to get in and out of bed. there is an upcoming major construction site in front of the hotel which would impact our decision to stay in the next year
management_response:
Hi pdamienp
Thanks for the feedback. We are excited for the construction to come to an end too! We do have a unique room layout and can appreciate this may not suit everyone. 
Thanks for giving us a try and we do hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back again.

review_title: Great location, friendly staff; the bed could be better.
review_text: The location of the hotel is within walking distance of a number of attractions which makes this hotel very appealing if you are in Canberra for an exhibition at the art gallery, want to visit the National Library or go to the Old Parliament House. The hotel also provides very convenient parking for guests. The lounge is great to relax, with coffee etc provided. The room was fine and the bathroom was great. However, we found the bed uncomfortable, especially because it was against the window  so that we could get into bed only from one side. Also, while the window was lovely and large, the blind meant that we could either have no view (with blind down) or be totally exposed (with blind up).  Different curtain/blind would be great. We found all the staff to be very friendly, helpful, and informative.
management_response:
Hi Voyager524984

Thanks for your review of LNC. We can appreciate our unique room layout may not suit everyone but thank you for giving us a try. It's lovely to read that you found our dedicated team of staff to be helpful and informative during your stay. Our team truly love what they do. 

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: Очень удобное расположение, немного не удобно с парковкой. Темнеменее центр города делает этот отель хорошим местом чтобы отсновиться на пару ночей путешествуя в Белоруссию например. Чисто и опрятно. в номере все есть что нужно кроме мыла в ванной, но есть гель. Рядом можно поесть.

Уютный номер с мини-кухней - высокие потолки, светло, окно во двор, поэтому тихо. И действительно самый центр. Старый дом с толстенными стенами. Идеально для семейного отдыха: родители спят внизу, а наверху, на уютных антресолях, могут поместиться двое детей. Есть все необходимое: холодильник, телевизор, кондиционер.

Прекрасно расположены - рядом все достопримечательности и музеи, но от вокзала и автовокзала надо ехать (они на окраине города). 
Расположены на втором и третьем этажах старого дома после ремонта и перепланировки. Немного пришлось поискать рецепшен - приехали рано утром, а большой вывески или указателей во дворе нету.
Очень чисто, номера новые, все необходимое и в номере, и в кухне, и в ванное есть. Мы жили во втором подъезде. Внимательный и отзывчивый персонал быстро решил все наши проблемы, общение с отелем понравилось еще во время бронирования, на вопросы отвечали быстро и без раздражения. Да, еще отличные цены!
Увы, хорошая слышимость, но тут ничего не поделать, это нюансы архитектуры.
Из не совсем приятного - пустой сайт, о наличии камеры хранения пришлось писать отдельно, о возможности раннего заезда спрашивать на рецепшене. Сразу скажу - все есть и возможность оставить вещи, и ранний заезд! 
Очень рекомендую!!!

Плюс - расположение . Достаточно чисто . Высокие потолки . Остальное очень на любителя . Не уютно - холодно . В моём номере ( 14) нет никакого прикроватного освещения. Из заявленных туалетных принадлежностей : гель для душа в пакетике, и шампунь . Все ! Мыло в диспенсере ( из магазина все по 100рублей) явно разбавлено . Для заявленной цены 2500 за ночь , явно не дотягивает . Ощущение как от ночёвки в чистом бомжарнике, оформленном с претензией , материалами купленными на рынке . Больше сюда не поеду.

review_title: Очень удобное расположение, чисто и аккуратно
review_text: Отличное расположение, все рядом, в том числе и магазин 24. Любезный персонал. В комнатах чисто. Есть минимальный набор посуды, кухонная утварь. В принципе, тихо. В ванной комнате так же чисто, есть наборы гель-шампунь, чистые полотенца. Горячая вода течет без проблем. Остались очень довольны выбором. Во дворе можно припарковать ТС.

Хороший отель с нестандартной планировкой спального места (поднято над основным пространством номера). При посещении Смоленска всегда останавливаемся здесь. Чисто, уютно, при небольшом метраже помещения есть все что нужно для отдыха.

Апартаменты удобно расположены в центре, близко находятся достопримечательности и много различных кафешек. В номере чисто, большая душевая, горячая вода без проблем. В ванной фен и принадлежности для душа. Номер был с кроватью на антресоли, спать душно. В номере была микроволновка, обеденные принадлежности. Отличное предложение за такие деньги. Парковка под шлагбаумом, нужно звонить в отель администатору, чтобы въехать - выехать. Рядом несколько супермаркетов. На ресепшн можно купить питьевую воду.

Из минусов: двор с большой лужей.

Начну с плюсов. Это расположение, центр, все достопримечательности в шаговой доступности. Чистое постельное белье, отсутствие посторонних запахов, ночью было тихо, но мне показалось, что кроме нас никого и не было на этаже. Все отремонтировано, но дешево. Мы снимали апартаменты на 4 взрослых. Может я плохо разглядела фотографии на сайте, но когда я вошла, то испытала некий шок. Это единое помещение кухни и гостиной и прихожей и антресоль, на которой каким то чудесным образом запихнули двуспальную кровать. Но спать может только один потому как к этой кровати не подойти, а прыгать можно только рыбкой. Стоя на этой антресоли моя голова упиралась в натяжной потолок, выключатель от бра находится очень неблизко. Но отдельной песней надо спеть рассказ о лестнице, которая ведет на этот чердак, это только для опытных матросов, которые привыкли к таким трапам, нигде не написано, что должно быть ограничение по возрасту и весу, чтоб взбираться по ней! Кровать с какой то доской под спиной и низкая ограничительная конструкция, в общем крайне неприятно. В типа гостиной стоит промятый угловой диван, на котором спать крайне неудобно, т.к. в разобранном виде он не представляет из себя кровать и второму человеку нужно тоже прыгать "рыбкой" . Уважаемая администрация какой это номер на 4 х взрослых? Пришлось брать раскладную кровать. Дверь в эту комнату фанерная, через нее слышно все о чем говорят в комнате и в коридоре. В общем жесть полная!!! Цена 3300 за сутки за такую извините общагу, это лихо! На сайте надо еще поместить фото этих апартаментов со двора.

Очень просторно, места хватит на семью, чисто, есть все необходимое. Полноценная кухня. Два семейных спальных места, возможность разместить дополнительную кровать. Расположение отличное, 10-15 минут до Богоявленского собора, много кафе рядом с отелем. ТВ и интернет.

Рекомендовали мои знакомые с Урала. Они остались очень довольны и нам с мужем понравилось,только не предупредили ,что номер 9 на 3 эт.без лифта((( 65лет,инвалид 2 гр., трудно подниматься после 12 часов прогулок по городу!!! Ну вот такие мы жадные до пеших экскурсий и прогулок по красивейшим и интересным местам вашего замечательного города!!! Влюблены в Смоленск. А так номер просторный с высокими потолками !Телевизор работал хорошо,холодильник маленький ,но нам хватило,электрочайник! Микроволновка работала! Вся необходимая посуда была! Приятно что был ещё и чай с сахаром и соь)))!!! Утюг с гладильной доской стоят в холле !Парковали машину во дворе куда выходили окна номера. Въезд во двор проблематичный ,дороги как всегда в России разбиты((( Отличное место расположение! Приедем ещё! Ждите!

Thank You to the fine staff at Ramada Plaza. I do have my walking wheelchair. They have been always accomodating with the handicap acces room and shower. I habe a wheeling walker. The facility is very active in the morning and is nice to see all the friendly vibes from the staff .Our daughter lives nearby,hence the visits. Her guest room is now the baby nursery coming in June 2024. We'll be back

review_title: One of my go too places to stay
review_text: Love the cost, the overall look and comfort, the indoor pool and hot tub are a plus, the to places to eat onsite are awesome. My nephew wanted to stay in a hotel with a pool for his birthday because he doesn't get to travel much. He was beyond excited that our room had a balcony.

The hotel room needed some work, there was a broken wall in the bathroom. The lobby was very nice compared to the halls and rooms but for the price I wasn’t expecting anything elaborate. 
The tub in our room had jets though which was a happy surprise.
I would say the best part of the stay is the restaurants that are connected to the hotel. It was so convenient and yummy. I don’t recommend the pizza though…..it was BAD.

Wouldn't recommend anyone to stay there to have the experience we did with daytime front desk staff. Jim the 2nd floor house keeper very nice and helpful with our needs for linen or anything from his department
management_response: I understand that you wouldn’t be happy with our front desk staff since they had to track you down for payment and eventually had to ask you to leave as a result of not paying in anything close to a timely manner. When adding nights to your stay at a hotel, it is common practice to pay for your room prior to noon – this was communicated to you on multiple occasions. Had you done so, this situation would not have happened.

review_title: They kicked me and my family out right on my birthday.
review_text: We settled in this hotel with our last money. We spent one night here. But we booked this hotel for a few days.from January 12 to January 15. We were with dogs. Three little chihuahuas. We went to walk them. One guy showed up there and we told him to be careful.  This red dog can bite you. But he didn’t listen, he went straight to the dogs. After our dog slightly bit him, he went to the front desk and complained to them. He also said he wants to see rabies vaccinations. We brought it to him and showed him that everything is fine with our dogs and there are no diseases. He said he didn't want any police and just wanted to make sure of that. He was also drunk, he walked around with a bottle of very strong alcohol. With all this, he said that he would shoot our dogs and me and my husband. He said this was when his dog bit him, and he also said this was in front of the reception staff. The girl who called Alisha said that yes, she heard it. We called the police. When the police arrived, this girl began to tell the other person that she had not heard anything.  And that she only wanted us to get away from each other so that some kind of fight wouldn’t happen. Then I asked to show the video from the surveillance camera.  They said the CCTV camera was not working.  Then they started saying that they were showing without sound.  And that I have no right to request such records from them, I said, Well, the police are in front of you. The police most likely did not want to get involved with this and they simply hushed up the matter. They just said you need to go to your room and pack your things. They also said that they would not refund us the money for the remaining nights. They also congratulated me on my birthday mockingly. I asked to call the general manager.  They said it was his day off and he wouldn't be here until Monday. Despite the fact that this guy was walking around with a bottle of alcohol, he got away with it and we were to blame. Although, we warned him, don’t go near dogs.  Even though the dogs were on a leash, He still approached the dogs and one of them bit him. The hotel staff just threw mud at us. So I want to say that the people working there are very rude and terrible. Please don't go to this hotel, there are many other hotels nearby. No one has ever kicked me out of other hotels and I have never had any problems.  These people just wanted something spicier. Especially They were very happy to congratulate me on my birthday by giving Me such a gift of a kick in the ass.
management_response: This was an entirely avoidable situation on your part. Having control over your dog would have prevented it. Not getting into an argument with the person who was bitten by your dog would have been a good idea that would have kept the situation from escalating the way it did. Finally, throwing things at our staff member was completely unacceptable. As you were made aware of by the police when they removed you, you are no longer allowed on the property and are fortunate that our staff member did not want to press assault charges against you.

review_text: The staff were fantastic. The food was yummy and I would definitely recommend and stay again!!  The location is conveniently located right off the exit and everyone went out of their way for us. Truly a great little gem.

We have stayed at the Ramada many times and are always pleased. The staff are helpful and friendly, and the rooms are spacious and clean. The pool is particularly nice. The hotel is handy to the turnpike and airport.

The huge benefit we appreciated was having a sliding glass door from our room to the grass to allow our dog to relieve himself. Room is clean and roomy. Beds are comfy. Pool is heated. Hot tub was meh. Jets were weak and the water didn’t smell clean.

review_title: Fine for one night. No frills
review_text: Staff was wonderful hearing food for us and allowing us to takeover the small lobby. Beds were comfortable. No breakfast service. No microwaves. Too far from city of Portland for our taste. Need to update and upgrade facility. Add breakfast for better value

The hotel has a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
The room was very quiet.
Stacks, the breakfast and lunch spot, was excellent.
Volcano, the dinner spot, wasn't quite up to the top rating but is getting there.
The kids loved the pool.

Au Ti Village ,tout est parfait:accueil,propreté,conception des gîtes ,emplacement ,etc..
Fabienne et Jean sont des hôtes sympathiques ,toujours à l'écoute de leur clients.
On s'y sent vite comme chez soi ....
management_response:
Merci , nous sommes heureux que vous ayez passé un bon moment au Ti Village Créole,
A bientôt nous l'ésperons sur notre jolie île.
Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
Le cadre, les gérants et l'emplacement, font de ce lieux le cadre parfait pour passer de bonnes vacances, en famille ou entre amis. 
Les bungalows sont très bien conçu, très propres et bien aménagé. Il y règne un calme olympien, et tout est conçu pour limiter au maximum le vis à vis.  De plus les propriétaires, font tout leur possible pour que tout ce déroule au mieux, et offrent de précieux conseil ou aides.
Nous avons passer un excellent séjour en ce lieu que je recommanderai et ou je retournerais avec grand plaisir. cet avi est général, mes parents et mon frère ce sont senti (tout comme moi), chez eux. 
Un grand merci pour ce bon moment.
management_response:
Merci pour vos gentils commentaires, ça nous touche vraiment. 
A bientôt  sur notre île de Guadeloupe.
Fabienne et Jean

review_text: Bungalow stupendo certo la distanza dalla spiaggia è notevole ma con un auto a noleggio in 2 minuti si arriva a sant anne Beach i proprietari sono disponibili e gentili e il contesto e molto gradevole ideale per famiglie e non ci ritornerei sicuramente.
management_response:
Merci beaucoup,
Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
L'accueil de Fabienne et de Jean est très chaleureux; vous pouvez tout leur demander pendant votre séjour, ils feront tout pour vous satisfaire.
Ti Village Créole est une "petite résidence": le calme y est de rigueur. 
Le bungalow que nous avions retenu correspondait en tous points à ce que nous attendions: spacieux pour 4, clim dans les chambres, espace cuisine extérieur en terrasse couverte avec vue sur la forêt, que demander de plus!!!
Fabienne et Jean nous ont indiqué les bonnes adresses (ah, le "Lucullus" !!), et s'occupaient, si besoin, de toutes les réservations (plongée, sorties en mer, Marie-Galante Les Saintes, ...).
Qui plus est, le jour de notre départ, alors que nous aurions du quitter les lieux avant 10 heures comme c'est habituellement la règle, nous avons pu rester une journée complète compte tenu que notre avion était à 19h !
Vraiment, à recommander sans modération.
management_response:
Bonjour,
Merci beaucoup, nous avons été ravis de vous avoir au Ti Village Créole.
A une prochaine fois sur notre jolie île.....
Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
Fabienne et Jean vous accueillent comme s'ils vous connaissaient depuis toujours...
Les bungalows sont très bien conçus... rien n'y manque. Tout est organisé jusqu'au plus petit détail. Des fruits frais, jus de fruits frais, et nécessaire à ti-punch sont même prévus!!!
management_response:
Merci beaucoup, on aime vous recevoir et vous aider à passer un bon séjour. 
A bientôt sur notre île. Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
Nous avons séjourné au ti village créole pour notre voyage de noces, nous recommandons ce lieu. Les propriétaires sont très accueillent et sympathique.
Et surtout de bons conseille pour visité cette magnifique ile. notamment cette superbe journée en mer des caraibes sur le catamaran de Charly et Fafa ( le cyrano).
C'est sur que nous reviendrons.
Stève et Celine
management_response:
Merci et à bientôt avec grand plaisir.
Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
A l'arrivée,les propriétaires nous accueillent gentiment;à noter ,à notre disposition,tout ce qu'il faut pour se faire un ti-punch,et un petit-déjeuner.
Les bungalows sont propres,fonctionnels et la climatisation fonctionne très bien (heureusement,car c'est indispensable).
Situé à un quart d'heure à pied de la plage superbe de st Anne,au calme, et on est en pleine nature dans un un environnement de verdure.
management_response:
Bonjour,
Merci beaucoup, et nous espérons à une prochaine fois sur notre jolie île.
Fabienne et Jean

review_title: Location idéale pour visiter la Guadeloupe
review_text:
Nous avons séjourné à Ti village pendant 15 jours au mois août 2017.
-Accueil parfait
-Endroit très calme et reposant
-Village très bien entretenue et bien situé pour les visites
-Bungalow bien équipé et propre
-Parking sécurisé
-Si prochain séjour en Guadeloupe retour à Ti village sans hésiter !

management_response:

Pas de dégâts au Ti Village, quelques branches cassées seulement nous avons été chanceux. a une prochaine fois, Fabienne et Jean

review_text:
Le meilleur accueil que l'on puisse avoir !

Et le petit bonus, la corbeille de bienvenue avec tout ce qu'il faut pour un ti punch et des fruits bien mûrs.
Nous le recommandons vivement !
management_response:
Merci très gentil commentaire...on adore ça!
Peut-être à une prochaine fois sur notre jolie île.

review_title: Merveilleux séjour au Ti Village Créole
review_text: Nous avons séjourné 2 semaines dans cette résidence. Excellent  séjour. Les propriétaires nous ont réservé un accueil très chaleureux.  Ils sont très sympathiques et dévoués. Le lieu calme et verdoyant.  Les petites maisons propres , bien tenue. La piscine bien appréciable. En fait c'est beaucoup plus beau en vrai que sur les photos. Nous recommandons vraiment cet endroit.
management_response:
Merci pour ce joli message qui nous fait très plaisir,
A bientôt peut-être au Ti Village Créole.
Fabienne et Jean

review_text: Exceptional location between the 11th arrondissement and the Haut Marais, an authentic and charming Paris. Very nice hotel, impeccable cleanliness and warm Welcoming. Great value for money. Lovely interior garden.
management_response:
Cara Lidia,

La ringraziamo di cuore per il suo commento così positivo! Siamo lieti di sapere che ha trovato il nostro hotel perfetto per visitare Parigi, soprattutto grazie alla nostra posizione eccezionale tra l’11° arrondissement e l’Alto Marais. Questo quartiere autentico e vivace permette di scoprire facilmente le bellezze della capitale, con le sue stradine piene di fascino, i negozi, i caffè e la vicinanza immediata ai trasporti pubblici.

Siamo anche molto felici che abbia sottolineato la pulizia impeccabile della struttura, la qualità dell’accoglienza del nostro personale e l’ottimo rapporto qualità/prezzo. Il nostro giardino interno è infatti un luogo molto apprezzato dai nostri ospiti, ideale per gustare la colazione o concedersi un momento di relax in tutta tranquillità, lontano dal trambusto parigino.

Sarà per noi un grande piacere accoglierla nuovamente in occasione di un prossimo soggiorno a Parigi.

Cordiali saluti,
La Direzione

review_title: An unforgettable holiday thanks to a team at the top
review_text:
I had an absolutely perfect stay at this hotel! Everything was excellent from start to finish: the food was varied, delicious and of high quality. The animation was at the top, with a Mood always festive and friendly. The animators were amazing: available, dynamic, funny and always in a good mood, they contributed greatly to make the stay unforgettable.
A big bravo to the whole team, also in Rio and Taha I recommend this hotel with my eyes closed and I will return with great pleasure!
management_response:
Cara Pauline,

Um enorme obrigado pelo seu maravilhoso comentário! Estamos muito felizes que a sua estadia tenha sido absolutamente perfeita, que tenha apreciado a qualidade das nossas refeições, bem como a ambiente festivo e acolhedor proporcionado pela nossa equipe. Rio, Taha e toda a equipa ficarão muito felizes com os seus elogios.

A sua recomendação é muito importante para nós e teremos todo o prazer em recebê-la novamente para uma futura estadia inesquecível.

review_title: Think Again as this Cheaper Hotel was a Poor Choice!
review_text:
I am a travel advisor with 30 plus years experience.  I was quite shocked by the Front Desk of Hotel Alhambra, Paris, when they abruptly cancelled my daughter’s (2) Night Reservation that was fully paid in advance with Booking.com.
This is not about the Cancellation rule - The Front Desk refused to accept the fact that her flight was delayed by (1) day out of CLT.  They were actually ‘rude’ and would not allow any discussion - repeating “No Show”, “Cancelled”.  This is hardly fair!  I called the Front Desk several times prior to check-in time on her day of arrival to say she wanted to keep the Room, however would arrive the next day (paid for).  I did not ask for reimbursement.  I called prior to 3pm and Booking.com states you have until 11:59pm day of arrival - thus, I was totally within the boundary to notify the delay ahead of check-in time.  This did not suit Monsieur!  
The Hotel wants us to go the the Airline—No, they do not pay for unused hotel night.
As all travelers know, the airline re-accommodates next day flight and gives a Hotel Voucher for the night of missed flight (In Charlotte, NC) We have Trip Insurance, however it pays $200 per day for Trip Interruption.  We now pay over $800 for incompetent rudeness.  PS: The Hotel does not care!
management_response:
Dear Madam,

We are truly sorry to read your disappointment and would like to clarify the situation.

Your daughter’s reservation was guaranteed for check-in on June 15, with two nights prepaid. As per standard hotel policy, when a guest does not check in on the first night and no information is received before midnight, the reservation is automatically marked as a no-show, and the room is released the following morning to accommodate new guests.

You contacted our reception only on the morning of June 16, after the room had already been cancelled by the system due to no arrival or prior notice the day before.

Please understand that this is not about lack of care or empathy — but about fair and transparent procedures that apply to all guests. We did not charge more than what was prepaid, and as clearly stated during booking, no-shows are non-refundable, especially during high-demand periods.

Kind regards,
The Management – Hôtel Alhambra

review_text:
Останавливались на ночь. Располагается практически в самом центре в шаговой доступности от основных достопримечательностей. Номера минималистичны по своей наполнености, но довольно чистые и удобные. Есть двухъярусные номера.
Из главных минусов: картонные стены между номерами и соответствующая им нулевая звукоизоляция. Так же для парковки было не особо много места.

Мы останавливались на ночь в апартаментах по адресу Советская, 29. Это отдельно находящаяся квартира, апарт-отель - в доме напротив. При бронировании эта квартира является отдельной опцией. Нам она понравилась. Чисто, просторно. Вполне приличный ремонт. Кухня оборудована достаточно. Высокие потолки. Кондиционера нет. Парковка во дворе, места много. До Соборной горы 700 метров по прямой. Сама улица шумная круглые сутки, движение интенсивное. Для чутко спящих может быть проблемой. Но при этом окна плотно закрываются и глушат звуки.

Останавливалась в этих апартаментах в конце февраля, в Смоленске была по работе, в номере почти не находилась, только зашла принять душ и выспаться.
Туалет и душ – общие на две комнаты. Также в блоке есть небольшая кухня, электрический чайник, в номере – полотенца, телевизор, бельё (которое стелить нужно самостоятельно).
Если вам повезёт с соседями – думаю, впечатление останется более чем положительным: место, в котором расположен отель – это прекрасный исторический центр, окна выходят на старинную пешеходную улицу, в шаговой доступности достопримечательности, рестораны, музеи и кафе.  
Но мне не так повезло – моими соседями были молодые ребята и я слышала буквально КАЖДОЕ слово, сказанное за стеной, слышимость здесь просто дикая.
С другой стороны – напор воды нормальный, милые двухуровневые номера, приятные и вежливые работники отеля.
И шикарное месторасположение.

На вокзале нас с подругой встретила администратор отеля,через десять минут мы уже открыли дверь своего номера -"Аква".Номер с высокими потолками,с окнами,выходящими на пешеходную улицу.На антресолях замечательно удобная кровать,внизу диван.Устроились удобно.Небольшая кухня со всем необходимым для приготовления завтрака(ужина).Чисто и тепло.Соседей не слышно.В следующий приезд будем останавливаться только здесь,очень удобное расположение,доброжелательный персонал.

nous avons passer une douzaine de jours au ti village creole, très sympas, calme la piscine presque pour nous tout seul, machine à laver à dispo, des poules des coqs des oiseaux et un beau jardin tropical autours des bungalows.
la literie est plutôt bonne et la cuisine extérieur est bien équipé.
pour aller à la plage il faut un véhicule car un peu en retrait de st Anne.

Fine hytter med bra standard. Soverom, stue, bad og en veranda med spiseplass og kjøkkenkrok. Hyggelig og hjelpsomt vertskap. Ca 15 min gange til Saint-Anne sentrum med butikker, marked, restauranter og strender. Anbefales! 
Saint-Ann er er fint utgangspunkt for å oppleve Guadeloupe. Vi leide bil og kjørte rundt mesteparten av de 2 øyene. Det er masse flotte strender rundt begge øyene, nasjonalpark med mulighet for fjell/ jungel turer og fossefall og elver og bade i. Man kan padle kajakk og snorkle, besøke rom destillerier og koselige havn og fiskelandsbyer. God mat og drikke, øya har Fransk Creolsk kjøkken. Her er det noe for en hver smak!

We are almost at the end of our week long stay at Ti'Village Creole, and we couldn't be happier. The location--just enough outside of Centre Ville to be quiet and peaceful but a 5 min drive from the beaches, shops and restaurants--is ideal. The cottages have an outdoor kitchen that made every meal we ate in feel special. We were surrounded by gorgeous tropical plants and visited by lovely song birds. It is a magical place, and the hosts are very kind and welcoming--Fabienne speaks excellent English, and is happy to answer questions and give recommendations. If you like quiet, beauty and simple charms, you will LOVE Ti'Village Creole.

N'hésitez pas a leur demander un avis sur vos excursions, les sites a voir, ou manger....ils peuvent meme se charger de gerer vos réservations pour des sorties en bateau ou plongée sous marine...On est a 2 mn en voiture du centre de St Anne ou il y a tous les commerces nécessaires et une plage ( faites 5mn de voiture de plus et allez a la plage de bois jolan qui est bien plus belle et plus calme). Nous avons passé 7 nuits au Ti Village Créole, nous avons été très bien accueilli, les gérants sont très sympa, disponibles et de bons conseils. review_text:
Le site se compose d'une dizaine de bungalows astucieusement disposés pour ne pas occasionner de gêne avec les voisins. Les points forts sont:
- belle piscine
- très propre 
- grande salle de bain
- parking proche des bungalows
- sécurisé (portail télécommandé fermé la nuit)
- bien équipé (cuisine complète, grand frigo, air conditionné, jolie terrasse, moustiquaire aux fenêtres, grand placard)
- excellent accueil (corbeille de fruit, rhum et citron pour le punch, cacao local, gentillesse des proprios)
- WIFI

Il y a un point à améliorer: Si la journée n'est pas très ensoleillée il n'est plus possible de prendre une douche en soirée ou le matin. En effet, l'eau chaude sanitaire est produite écologiquement avec du chauffage solaire. Malheureusement, cette unité qui alimente 2 bungalow est trop petite quand les 2 habitations sont habitées et qu'il y a des passages nuageux.

En conclusion: nous recommandons cette adresse :-)
