review_text: Замечательные апартаменты в самом центре города! Чистые, современные, в 6 номере огромная кухня с большим холодильником. В 7 номере небольшая, но номер более современного стиля. Мебели и интерьер - Икеа. Единственный минус - малюсенькие подушки и на третий этаж пешком (если чемоданы большие - тяжело)

Отличное расположение в центре, основные достопримечательности можно обойти пешком. Буквально за углом начинается пешеходная улица Ленина, с несколькими точками общепита. Проживали на втором этаже в оранжевых апартаментах втроем. Достаточно просторно, чисто, свежий ремонт. При заселении дают карту города, также можно приобрести питьевую воду. Не очень понравилось - очень крутой угол наклона лестницы на антресоль, где находится двухспальная кровать, подниматься очень неудобно и большая нагрузка на колени. На улице площадку перед входом было бы неплохо заасфальтировать, на сегодняшний день там земля - то есть пыль в сухую погоду и грязь в дождик. В остальном, всё хорошо.

Расположение в самом центре города. Ресепшен не круглосуточный, но приезд возможен до половины двенадцатого ночи, что актуально для вечерней "Ласточки" из Москвы. В округе много кафе и магазинов. Вежливый персонал. При выселении можно оставить чемодан у администратора, потом забрать. Неплохой интерьер, чисто.

В самом центре (останавливался в апартаментах "Аква"), 4 мин. ходьбы от центрального парка, переделанная в мини-отель квартира. Тихо, чисто, всего 4 номера. Есть кухня (холодильник, плита, посуда и т.д.), утюг с доской, интернет нормальный. Спал внизу на диване, хотя кровать на 2 этаже - это прикольно:)

Отличные апартаменты в центре Смоленска. Одна большая квартира разделена на 4 квартиры с отдельными входами. Wi-Fi отличный. Подотчетные документы дают! Весь интерьер из Икеи. Цена даже очень соответствует качеству!

Месторасположение идеально: дом на углу пешеходной улицы Ленина и главной артерии города улицы Б. Советская. Утром есть куда сходить на завтрак, много кафе рядом. Данные апартаменты это переделанная квартира и у нас оказался бокс на две комнаты с общей ванной комнатой :-) О чем было тяжело догадаться при бронировании. Гостиница после ремонта, все чистое, приятный запах, администраторы приветливы и дружелюбны.  Стоит отметить, что окна некоторых комнат выходят на шумную улицу и спать с открытым окном тяжело, так же не все гладко с горячей водой, ее надо ждать минут 5-10, а потом она быстро заканчивается. Подъезд с внутренней стороны двора и дорога к нему истинный ужас, провалы земли, ямы. В зимний период даже страшно представить, что с дорогой...

Квартиру нашли быстро, нас было 4 человека, администратор встретила нас очень хорошо, дала карту и ушла, это обычный хостел, все для приготовления еды у нас в квартире было, но хочу отметить два минуса: 1. Если вы на машине, очень тяжело найти дорогу, нам местные помогали во двор заехать; 2. Нет кондиционера, для жаркого лета это очень плохо. А так все замечательно!

Очень хорошее впечатление осталось от апартаментов. Комнаты ухоженные, чистые, удобные .Все необходимое в комнате имеется. Персонал радушный и внимательный. Цена приемлемая. Рядом с апартаментами много магазинов и ресторанов.

Очень удобное расположение для посещения основных достопримечательностей города. Вторым плюсом этого номера является то, что он очень просторный, с высокими потолками. Можно поселиться большой семьей и всем будет хватать места. Мебель, текстиль, интерьер - все просто, но продумано и комфортно. Из минусов:  не удобно подниматься по крутой лестнице на второй ярус, а летом важным фактором может быть отсутствие кондиционера. В целом я бы рекомендовал эти апартаменты для непродолжительного проживания на один, два дня.

Апартаменты оправдывают свое название, расположены действительно в центре, очень удобно для осмотра основных достопримечательностей. В пешей досягаемости  крепостная стена, Успенский собор,  сад им. Глинки, т. е. весь исторический центр города. Апартаменты просторные, с мини кухней. Мебель, текстиль, посуда очень простые, из Икеи, но подобраны в соответствии с интерьером. Насыщенные цвета, высокие потолки, большое количество свободного пространства — все это производит приятное впечатление. В коридоре стоит кулер с питьевой водой, лежат карты города и всевозможные брошюры с информацией о городе. Персонал внимательный и вежливый, ответят на все вопросы. Апартаменты — проект местного турагентства, переделаны из 5-ти комнатной квартиры в старинном доме с толстенными стенами, высокими потолками и маленьким двориком. Рядом, около отеля Смоленск, есть стоянка  -140 руб/сутки. Мы оставляли машину там.  Подъезжать на машине к апартаментам надо со стороны ул. Коммунистической между 5-м и 7-м домами. 
Не очень понравилось то, что на второй ярус апартаментов (спальню) надо подниматься по очень крутой, практически вертикальной, лестнице. Учтите, что кондиционера нет, летом это может быть важно. Пришлось самим застилать все спальные места, это не очень трудно, но уже привыкли, что об этом обычно заботится персонал.  В нашем номере (зеленые апартаменты) шумная принудительная канализация, как только включаешь воду — слышишь довольно громкий гул. Эти недостатки не считаю значительными, в целом они сильно не повлияли на наше проживание. Нам, 2-м взрослым и ребенку, было комфортно. С удовольствием остановимся в этих апартаментах еще раз.

Also , I can see me getting a full refund and allowed to walk away to another hotel (which I wish was the case). All this to say, be warned, room and bathroom did not look clean at all. review_text: This place is on the older side and needs updated.  The outside of the building needs to be cleaned up.  They have a pool and 2 hot tubs.  Kid friendly. They have a restaurant onsite which had karaoke and we got your typical bar food.  They have a breakfast restaurant up front, which is short staffed.  We waited forever to get a cup of coffee and to get s refill .. well you can forget that!  Food was okay. It’s located off a busy street but In a good location to go any direction for touring. We actual found a cock roach crawling on the bathroom floor, which just tells you it’s not so clean, like the published.

review_title: First and last time we stay at a Ramada hotel
review_text:
It was the first time we tried a Ramada hotel, in the context of a family trip to Maine. We were clearly disappointed. 

First, the room had not been properly cleaned after the visit of the previous customers. Their dirty linens and sheets were still lying in the middle of the room, and the beds were not properly folded so that it looked someone already slept in them. Next, the carpet was old and dirty (my six-years-old son cleans his room much better than this), and we even hesitated to go to the front-desk to borrow a vacuum cleaner (there were in particular food remnants from other customers under the beds). Finally, the coffee machine was broken and there was no coffee and tea pads available in the room. 

In total, we have been five times to the front desk to complain about something, which is very annoying for the price we paid. During our stay, we noticed the very young age of the house-keeping staff, which may be the reason for the bad state of our room (this is however not an excuse). On the positive side, we must say that the beds were comfortable, and that we had a good sleep.

In short, we don’t recommend this hotel, and it is very unlikely we will book Ramada ever again.

review_title: Dirty linens, mice at the hallway
review_text: Blood spots on the linens of our beds, remains in dustbins of the bathrooms, mice at the hallway in front of our room, very remote spot long distance to downtown, expensive in August , no breakfast included

We were a group travelling from different parts of New England and meeting in Portland. The  hotel staff were friendly, capable and made sure our rooms were together despite the different arrival times of people in our group. Also, our friends were travelling with their dog. The hotel staff made sure they got a room that was dog friendly, and showed us an entrance to the hotel that gave easy access for dogs. An overall good stay and would visit if in Portland again. Recommended to anyone travelling with a pet!

The hotel was not as pictured on the website. Our room was ordered, chair in the room was stained. Staff seemed uninterested in my assessment at check out. Booked the room for 5 people and there were 2 double beds and the grubby aforementioned chair. We bought an air mattress to accommodate our 5 people, the carpet was unclean and no one really wanted to sleep so close to it on the air mattress.

The rooms are fine - dated but ok. The pool is to be avoided at all costs. No idea when it was last cleaned but it is not good. Rooms smell a bit funny. Check in staff were efficient. Parking was good, location handy to the highway. Probably wouldn’t stay again due to pool cleanliness.

review_title: Pricey but in line with other hotels in the area
review_text: Check in and out was quick. Common areas and room very clean. Recommend trash can be put in the bathroom.Was a great experience after the experience at the hotel across the street, the night before. I couldn't get the room for 2 nights, otherwise I would have stayed at the Ramada for both nights.

Nous y avons passé un excellent séjour en famille dans un cadre Guadeloupéen typique. Nous avons bien profité de la terrasse en passant un maximum de temps dehors avec une température idéale. L'agencement des bungalows est optimisé pour limiter le vis à vis entre voisins. Oui, nous entendons les coqs les poules, les vaches et les petites grenouilles (comme partout en Guadeloupe). A l'instar des cigales en Provence, ceci fait partie du charme de cette belle région.
Le propriétaire est sympathique et pragmatique. Il nous a donné de bons conseils lors de nos excursions.
Nous avons pu rayonné sur toute la Guadeloupe sans problème. Toutefois la circulation est difficile entre le Gosier et St Anne à certaines heures.
Bref, nous vous conseillons cette location.

Apres deux semaines, très déçus par rapport a notre séjour d il y a quelques années.Certes, la vue est toujours aussi belle mais les bungalows manquent d entretien.Pas un rideau de douche ou porte savon, un set de vaisselle qui laisse a désirer (les couteaux pourraient au moins être eguises) un salon de jardin qui mérite un bon coup de lasure et une literie qui a vu passer un bon nombre de voyageurs...des nouveaux transats pour deux bungalows...les autres n y ont pas droit!et j'en passe!Le pere du  proprietaire passe son temps a surveiller les moindres faits et gestes des vacanciers et si vous oublies d eteindre la clim une fois pendant votre absence cest la cata...Bref, on cherchera une autre adresse pour la prochaine fois car de meilleures résidences abondes dans le coin!

Dormir dans des bungalows typiquement guadeloupéein était vraiment bien. 
Le propriétaire  des lieux est très sympathique, accueillant et de bons conseils concernant les différentes activitées à faire sur l'île. 
Le bungalow était très propre,confortables et complet en matériel ce qui permet une indépendance total pour les repas.
Il propose également des services tels que la machine à laver,sèche linge pour un moindre coup ce qui est plutôt pratique quand on y reste plusieurs semaines. 
Le lieu et jolie et plutôt calme. 
Aimant les animaux, je trouve que ceux qui ci balladent font tout le charme au lieu malgré qu'ils soient indépendant de la volonté du propriétaire .
Bref nous avons passé 12 super jours et ce lieu y a énormément contribué.
J'y retournerai sans hésiter et avec beaucoup de plaisir.
Je le conseil fortement !

Nous voici de retour de notre troisième séjour au Ti Village Créole à Sainte Anne.

Nous y sommes resté 3 semaines cette année et tout est toujours aussi bien, piscine bien entretenue (avec nouveaux transats), les bungalows simple, propre et bien équipé. Cuisine extérieur sur la terrasse très agréable.

Les commerces sont accessible à pied ( +/- 20 minutes ), boulangerie, camion (Fruits et légumes) le long de la route face au lagon...

Leader-Price  direction Gosier à 15 minutes en voiture, et celui direction Saint-Francois à 10 minutes.

Restaurant chez Emy à 5 minutes à pied.

Le Ti-Village Créole est le point idéal pour les visites, (Belmangrov, Cascades Carbet, Lézarde...) la location de voiture est donc indispensable !

Peut être une 4eme fois en Guadeloupe ? Nous l'espérons ....  :-)

Les bungalows sont grands neufs et très bien équipés, le nôtre avait deux chambres une belle salle de bain et une terrasse de 200 m2... avec cuisine extérieur et barbecue, certes le complexe est un peu éloigné de la mer, mais cela n'est plus un problème face à la gentillesse des gérants et les bons plans qu'ils vous donnent (langouste grillées sur la plage à tomber pour 25 euros le menu...), excursions pour lesquelles ils s'occupent de tout organiser...
Bref à refaire

review_title: Très bon rapport qualité/prix . environnement typique guadeloupéen
review_text:
Séjour du 17 au 29 Mars 2014. hôtel indiqué par des petits panneaux dans st Anne. accueil  par le propriétaire à notre arrivée avec un panier gourmand. propriétaire discret , toujours présent et de très bon conseil. vue sur la campagne guadeloupéenne. plage à moins de 2km .très bon rapport qualité prix , vous n’êtes pas enfermé dans un immeuble usine à touriste. piscine propre.
pour les poules et coq cela reflète la faune guadeloupéenne, vous pouvez en croiser mais rien de dérangeant.
pour faire écho au précédent avis en effet la pression d'eau de la douche ne vous crèvera pas un œil mais il est bon d'avoir à l'esprit que dernièrement la Guadeloupe a été touché par la sécheresse et qu'il pouvait y avoir des coupures d'eau .coupure d'eau que nous n'avons pas eu à subir suite aux réserves d'eau installées par le propriétaire d'ou les faibles pressions d'eau épisodiques.
Vraiment ravi par notre séjour.
Morgane et Aurélien

Nous avons loué un bungalow du 10 au 17 mai. Acceuil par les proprietaires trés agreable avec des produits locaux qui nous attendaient dans une petite paniére. La terrasse avec cuisine amenagée et le bungalow étaient tres sympa, le couchage de bonne qualité.
En effet il y a quelques animaux de basse court mais ils ne nous ont pas derangés, le coq ne se mettait a chanter qu au petit matin et comme nous nous levions assez tot pour partir en visite ce n etait pas un probléme.
Pour trouver un petit defaut on peut dire que la pression d'eau sous la douche est loin de vous attaquer la peau aprés un mechant coup de soleil . Mais c est bien tout.
Bref ravi par la Guadeloupe et ravi par Ti village créole
Romain et Magali

review_title: Tres bon rapport qualité/prix accueil au top
review_text:
Nous sommes partis en couple durant 10nuits en septembre
tres bon accueil. vincent (le proprietaire) est à l'écoute. Il vous donne de très bon conseil quant à ce qu'il y a à faire en Guadeloupe.
n'hésitez pas à louer une voiture par son biais. voiture apporter rendue au ti'village créole
au tarif battant toute concurrence en basse saison au alentour de 20€ la journée.

Hotel fait pour avoir un pied à terre. 
ideal pour petit budget bon rapport qualité/prix 
si vous vaoyager dans le grand luxe ce n'est pas pour vous!!!!
c'est vraiment simple confortable literie top et propre.

le strict minimum pour passer des vacances pas cher

si vous souhaitez visiter la Guadeloupe emplacement ideal

Nous avions vu quelques avis concernant les bruits de basse cour, en effet, ça a été le cas.
Pas dormis de la nuit pour notre première nuit!!!! toute la nuit les coqs et autres volailles ainsi que les vaches !!!! pas très sympas!!!!
plus quelques petits désagréments, un filet d'eau à la douche, la clim au dessus du lit et bruyante!!! enfin voilà!!!
des le lendemain, nous avons contacté notre tour opérateur et changé d'hôtel !!! car nous n'envisagions pas de ne pas dormir durant notre séjour!!!!
Nous sommes retournés à l hôtel MARIFA ou nous avons séjourné il y a deux ans et là enfin les vacances commençaient!!!

Nous y étions du 17 mars au 1er avril 2013. Bungalow  propre , clair, bien agencé avec air conditionné, cuisine sur la terrasse très agréable.
Endroit calme et paisible. Le chant des coqs ne nous a en aucun cas gêné. Poussins, poules et chats déambulent et si ca peut en déranger certains nous pas du tout :)
Nous avons eu Vincent au début de notre séjour et ensuite son papa. Tous très gentils, agréables, attentionnés et serviables. La petite panière d'accueil, contenant thé, café, fruits et rhum, fut fort appréciée, encore merci ! Le fait qu'il y ai aussi une bouteille de jus de fruits et d'eau fut également fort appréciable à notre arrivée de l'aéroport. De très belles attentions.
La piscine est fort agréable quand on rentre d'excursions.
Proche du marché artisanal de Ste Anne à pied, environ 10 min.
La voiture est en effet nécessaire pour la Guadeloupe. c'était notre deuxième voyage en gwada et nous y retournerons certainement l'an prochain.

The hotel was booked for 5 family members to celebrate my 70th birthday and when my cousin notified the manager that there would be a sixth joining us we were told that would be fine and expected a small surcharge. We assumed that the room would have been made up to accommodate 2 people in single beds. 
When my daughter arrived, exhausted after several days working on a TV documentary with a tight deadline allowing little time for sleep she had taken an early flight and arrived before any of the family.
The manager(owner?) refused to let her leave her bags unless she paid an exorbitant surcharge so my daughter had to trawl the area for another hotel dragging her bags with her. A long and difficult search in high season but she was not going to be forced to pay an unreasonably high fee. She returned later to meet up with the rest of the family and was not allowed up to my room even to use the bathroom!
This manager was rude and surly, a bully!
Reading other reviews I now understand that he lures visitors in with relatively cheap prices but any deviation from the initial booking results in a change of personality which in our case completely spoilt what should have been a joyful occasion.

You called booking.com and they proved me right for the single room.

pay extra for 1 person.

review_title: Best wyndham property in the Portland area
review_text: The facility was clean and staffed with kind/professional representatives. During my week long stay I ran into no problems with the hotel and was helped time and again by the staff with a number of travel related needs

Over all, my room was clean and the staff were friendly. The problem came at night when many guests (judging by the amount of smoke in the air) all started smoking inside their rooms. This is a non-smoking hotel. So much smoke entered my room that I almost had to use my asthma inhaler. I notified the front desk but nothing was done about the problem. I have never seen smoking indoors like this before.

Found a few large black ants roaming the floor of our room (a ground floor room).  High Speed Internet was very weak, slow and non-existant at times.  Our TV cable blanked out a few times.  Room #122.  Other than these items, hotel was acceptable.

This hotel was a symphony in brown (in a bad way). Brown everything. Cheap brown furniture, brown carpet, brown walls, ruby couch. Looked like grandma's hand-me-downs. Matress not firm. Loud AC that droned all night long.

Great location for many attractions, very clean comfortable. Access to two restaurants on the hotel property. Experienced Stacks breakfast restaurant and had a great menu and service as well 👍
The room in general was as expected.

room was expensive and not what we originally signed up for on line.

coffee was watered down in lobby.

She was going to inform housekeeping. 
We will not be staying here again.

review_text: The area around the hotel doesn't appear safe. Hotels is old and worn. Dirty carpet, streaks on doors and elevator. Not worth the money. Had a hair on my pillow and bathtub. People did not appear the friendliest like the bartender at the grille.

Un chouette endroit, bien situé. Les bungalows sont simples mais très agréables avec une terrasse où on apprécie de se poser pour siroter un ti' punch offert par la maison (panier d'accueil).
Les proprio sont très sympas et de bons conseils!
Une bonne douceur de vivre.
Bon y a des coqs mais comme partout en Guadeloupe : c'est la nature!

review_title: Concept famille loin des usines à touristes
review_text:
Nous rentrons de 2 semaines passés au Ti village créole, c'est la seconde fois que nous y séjournons. Idéal en couple ou en famille. Vincent et sa petite famille sont au petits soins pour la clientèle. Site au calme sur les hauteurs de Sainte Anne, idéalement placé, climatisation dans les bungalows. A RECOMMANDER.
Philippe Nathalie d'AMBOISE 37

Bonjour,
Second séjour au Ti Village Créole, Vincent notre hôte toujours prêt a vous rendre service. Nous y avons séjourné 15 nuits début Août. 
Lieu idéal pour découvrir la Guadeloupe, malgré notre 2eme séjour, nous n'avons pas visité une chose identique a l'année dernière.
Les bungalows sont à maximum 10 minutes à pied de la plage et du centre de Sainte Anne.
La piscine très agréable au retour de balade...
La voiture est quasi obligatoire si vous voulez bouger.
Pour ma part je descendais régulièrement à pied pour le pain, fruits, légumes...mais pour visiter la voiture est indispensable.
Bungalow bien équipé, climatisation dans la chambre et dans le séjour.
Télé dans le séjour.
Wifi gratuit juste à coté de la piscine.
Le calme et la simplicité est un des grand atouts de ce lieu.

Nous y retournerons je pense une 3eme fois.......pour découvrir le reste de la Guadeloupe

A l'année prochaine Vincent ;-)

7 nuits passées en famille à 4 fin juillet. Bungalow simple et fonctionnel. Proprio sympa et de bon conseil. Piscine OK. Éviter le bungalow 11 plus bas et plus sombre et sans vue sur la mer. Poules et coqs en liberté en effet mais de toute façon, on se lève tôt pour profiter des heures fraiches !

Hotel bien situé sur les hauteurs de Sainte Anne;
Les chambres "studio" sont simples et quelque peu vieillissantes : le sommier du lit était bricolé (ajout d'une latte de bois) et le matelas hors d'age...
Ceci dit nous nous en sommes accommodés ...Le gros point noir de cet hôtel est le bruit....de LA BASSE COUR !!!
En effet poules et coqs sont en liberté et sont en permanence à quémander de la nourriture et le plus insupportable c'est le cri des coqs dès 4 h 30 du matin !!!!
Alors pensez aux boules Quies !!!
Nous avons également aperçu quelques gros rats qui couraient sur les branches des arbres alentours...mais ceci ne nous a pas tellement gênés.

J'ai été 2 fois il y a 4 ans et je ne regrette aucunement, d'ailleurs j'ai l'intention d' retourner. Le cadre est magnifique dans un petit coin reclus à 10 min de la plage du bourg. Les hotes sont très avenants bref je vous le conseille fortement c'est MAGNIFIQUE

review_title: If you stay in Saint-Anne, stay here
review_text: We stayed in Saint-Anne for our last night here, but wished we could have stayed longer. The bungalows are good. Nothing too special, but for the price you pay its more then can you expect in Guadeloupe. The owner is a nice guy and has good tips & advice. Its not close to the beach, but also not too far away. Overall we had a good experience and wish we could stay longer.

Séjour effectué en avril 2013. 

Bungalow propre, sans chichi et assez spacieux: le notre pouvait accueillir 5 personnes (2 chambres doubles, 2 salles de douche et un lit en mezzanine). Quelques petits rafraichissements seraient à prévoir.

Le cadre est calme et agréable. Le site se situe à quelques minutes de la plage de Sainte Anne. Nous nous y sommes toujours rendus en voiture puisqu'on partait en balade ensuite mais c'est tout à fait réalisable à pied (je pense qu'un quart d'heure de marche suffit).

Accueil très sympathique malgré notre arrivée un peu tardive. Propriétaires très sympas, discrets et de bon conseil tout au long du séjour (1 semaine). 

Nous avons également apprécié les délicates attentions de nos hôtes: une petite bouteille de rhum, jus de fruit et nécessaire du premier petit déjeuner (Lait, café soluble...) nous attendaient à notre arrivée.

Nous y retournerons sans hésiter lors de notre prochain séjour en Guadeloupe.

Bungalow simple, propre, mais certains éléments mériteraient de bénéficier d'un petit rafraichissement. La taille des pièces est plus que confortable, et notre bungalow (n° 6) disposait de 2 climatiseurs: l'un dans la chambre, le second dans le "salon". 

Accueil très sympathique de Vincent, disponible et de bon conseil.

Rapport qualité-prix tout à fait acceptable, et localisation à 10-15 minutes à pieds du centre de St-Anne très agréable.

cela fait 4 fois que j'y retourne, le propriétaire est très accueillant, disponible, les bungalows sont bien équipés peut être les clims a revoir elles se font un peu viellent  mais fonctionne toujours
Très calme piscine très agréable et j'y retourne une fois de plus a pâques et si je vais toujours au même endroit c'est de peur d'être déçus autre part
Je vous le conseille vivement.
christine franck pierre-louis et pauline

review_title: Charming little hotel. Great to explore the city
review_text: Very original small hotel. Lots of charm and style as well as the location compensate for the small weaknesses. Those who value individually designed rooms, good location and French flair are in the right place. Those who value high comfort, top service and maximum cleanliness place rather less emphasis. Not suitable for people with reduced mobility. But I liked that and I would come back.

Beautiful Hotel. Had a room on the top floor with ceiling windows looking into the spires of the local church. Great location, super clean. awesome bed bed and Margo was a great host. Located on a street with several cafes and easy access to Tram system.  Highly recommend.

My room (Sanchez) was gorgeous -- with  three sets of french doors that opened onto a balcony full of star jasmine and a view of the square/church across the street. The location is wonderful, on a quiet street, but very close to lots of shops and restaurants. And the woman running things (wish I had gotten her name) was lovely and so helpful. The only caveat is there is no lift, so not for those who are challenged by winding stairs. Highly recommended, in fact, I can't wait to return.

review_title: Great Rooms and district to stay in to explore Bordeaux
review_text: Had a wonderful stay here with friends for a weekend away in the wonderful city of Bordeaux. The rooms were lovely and had everything we needed and the location was fantastic near lots of great bars and restaurants. Reception helped us to book a half day wine tour.

After you get over the initial shock of the very steep 2 flights of stairs this place is a gem. It is nicely decorated and has everything you need. The bed is comfortable and the appartment very spacious. Great location with bakery below and near by restaurants that are not too touristy. The smell of the bread in the morning was heavenly. The little balcony was great for drinks and for having breakfast on. 
One word of warning if you use a site not direct with the accommodation you could end up like us with no instructions to get in as their emails never made it to us. My only compaint would be that instead of apologising when I rang for help I was told the emails had been sent and I didnt read them. They did not arrive and have similar problems in the past. It all worked out fabulously in the end but was not a great start.

Beautiful superior room in an elegant neighborhood... shame about the cleanliness and management. I found an animal in the bathroom similar to a cockroach. I sent the photo and they told me they couldn't change my room and that it's 'nature' and they couldn't do anything about it. Sin. They ruined a little gem
management_response:

Fin de l'histoire .... quand nous avez une plante grimpante sur la façade d'une maison, NATURELLEMENT, des insectes peuvent entrer quand nous ouvrons les fenêtres :)
De plus, c'est bien dommage de faire de grands sourires lorsque nous en parlons ensemble le lendemain matin pour ensuite se déchainer derrière un clavier sur tripadvisor, ce genre de comportement est vraiment pathétique ... vivement que nous puissions noter nos clients aussi.

review_text: Wonderful location and a beautiful room, in the heart of the old town. The host was incredible and responded immediately to any questions we had, which were many! We loved Bordeaux and will definitely return to Une Chambre when we next visit.

review_title: Perfect location the night before a Bordeaux River cruise
review_text:
What a smart decision to stay here the night before boarding the river cruise ship in Bordeaux— less than a 10 min walk to the docked ship. The room (Seignouret) was roomy and very comfortable; great shower and quality hair dryer are important benchmarks for me. Although breakfast foods are available in the room, I walked just a few yards to a wonderful bakery for a fresh French breakfast and a chance to view Bordeaux local activity in the early morning. I could heap more praise but space doesn’t allow. Margot is the BEST host.

Helpful note: The driver booked by Une Chambre from the airport can only contact you by phone at the arrivals gate — they do not come inside or meet you outside with a name sign. So be certain you can receive phone calls upon arrival (I had a new Orange SIM card but did not send Margot my French number when I installed it that morning). I wasted an hour of the driver’s time because of this. It was easy to grab a taxi though.

review_title: A perfect stay in a wonderful neighborhood.
review_text:
We really enjoyed our stay here.  After a long flight from the US west coast we lugged our suitcases up the steep winding stairs to our room.  Margot had provided excellent instructions to enter the building and to retrieve our room key.  It was perfect to enjoy a delicious dinner right outside the hotel.  We then dragged our jet lagged bodies up to the room for a marvelous sleep.  When we awoke, we opened the windows and smelled the fuel burning from the bakery next door.  We enjoyed two lovely breakfasts there.  We took a local tour to several wine chateaus and fished the Citie du vin.  We booked this tour before a cruise.  We were pleasantly surprised to find our ship docked 2 blocks from the hotel.

There was a problem with the booking service double selling our room one night, but Margot handled things perfectly.  She advised that since we were already staying there, we got to stay.  Although we never actually met anyone from the hotel, our stay was just what we wanted.

review_title: We would like to stay here again in the future!!
review_text:
4 out of 5.  The room is big spacious and clean, showers are warm and strong!! The room temperature is set comfortably and there are sufficient plugs for charging several mobile phones!! 
The patron (Mourad) is polite and so supportive. He attended to our requests nicely and friendly.
Highly recommended!!!

review_text:
we had an extremely unpleasant and unacceptable experience yesterday in Paris, at the Hotel Alhambra. We traveled to Paris in a tour group of 10 people. Among them were elderly people. 
It was not high season; Paris was not crowded. We suspect due to the bed bug infestation. 
We had booked the hotel for the wrong night - fair enough - that was my mistake. When I asked if they could accommodate us on price for rebooking the rooms, we received a categorical no - it was not the hotel's problem if we booked wrong. 

But we could occupy the rooms for two days and we should please cancel the rooms on booking. 
I complied with this.
The next morning they told us we had to vacate the rooms because the booking on booking.com had been cancelled. I pointed out several times that we had already paid for the room, that they had not accommodated us in any way, and that I had only cancelled because the hotel had asked me to do so. They said, if I cancelled the booking, they can't do anything about it - EVEN THEY HAD TOLD ME TO CANCEL IT!

None of my arguments were listened to; we again received a categorical no and had to vacate the rooms. 

We feel cheated. We are being charged 800 euros for rooms that we paid for but were not allowed to occupy. Never again!

review_text:
This hotel has a sleek and modern design, and is situated in a convenient location. The room is spotless, the bed is comfortable. The library and lounge area provided a cozy retreat, great for relaxation and socialising.
However, The room fell short of our expectations in terms of size.
Additionally, complimentary amenities were sparse, with essentials like a toothbrush and bottle of water available only at an additional cost. Besides, more than half of the items listed on the menu were unavailable at the snack bar, prompting us to inform the front desk to avoid being charged for those items. Unfortunately, half of the staff we encountered during our stay were not particularly friendly.

review_text: We booked for two nights and extended our stay for a third night - Staff were very friendly.  We had a dog with us and staff were friendly to him as well.  I also used the pool and hot tub and they were clean and welcoming

April School vacation we planned a one night stay-cation at the Ramada. I should have known better, being that we live less than a few miles away from the Ramada. But, I unfortunately trusted the 3 star rating. We live near the Clarion hotel and we were looking for step up from that hotel.  We were  looking  a simple hotel that felt safe, clean, decent food, and had a pool. The Ramada failed on all fronts! 

The only good thing about this hotel is the exceptionally patient staff behind the front desk. This staff has an incredibly hard job. While trying to perform their jobs, they are constantly monitoring unwelcome guests and guest who have been served far too much alcohol at their bar and restaurant. This creates a unsafe space for hotel employees and guests. 

We were a party of three one adult and two children under the age of 10. My children both expressed feeling unsafe while we were outside of our room. One of many incidents included a very intoxicated man who was a hotel guest at their bar. He came towards us calling my children his children and walked right into a wall, and fell down right in front of them. They have never knowingly seen a drunk person. Now thanks to our stay at the Ramada they have. This was one of many experiences we had that led us to feel unsafe outside of our room.

In our room there was a pubic hair on the ice bucket tray. The rooms are dingy and bathrooms feel very worn in and dirty. We made sure our doors were bolted and secure. The doors felt secure with the exception of the patio door but we were on the 3rd floor. 

We did have dinner at the Seasons restaurant. Skip the food and get dessert. The desserts were really good. The mozzarella sticks we ordered only one actually had cheese in it. The tater tots were freezer burned and you could taste that even though they were smothered in cheese. 

Finally the pool and hot tubs. Algae around the pool platform allows for an extra slippery surface and of course fungus. The hot tubs were very cloudy and felt a layer of slime on our skin after being in them. The pool lining is lifted in many areas and has a ring of dirt around the interior edges. In the early morning we found a non guest using the pool area to bath.

Next time we are looking for a average hotel for a stay-cation that feels safe, clean, decent food and a pool we will choose the Clarion near our house. Or perhaps we will splurge and get a good quality hotel elsewhere in town.
management_response: I would first like to thank you for taking the time to write a review of your stay with us. We are very disappointed that your stay with us was not an enjoyable one. We are always striving to exceed guest expectations and we are very sorry that we failed during your stay. I assure you that we are absolutely better than what your experienced and we do hope that you will give us an opportunity to win back your business in the future. Once again thank you for your review.

review_title: Ramada a nice place to stay
review_text: Hotel was a great all around hotel. Value and clean. Coinvent location with a nice restaurant attached for breakfast. Rooms are quiet and heat AC worked great. Would highly recommend for your next stay in the Portland area

The room was a little dated but had everything we needed. We were on the side facing the highway exit but didn't hear one peep of traffic. Went down to the lounge which had live music (good band) and VERY strong drinks! Love that the checkout isn't until noon. Went to breakfast at the attached restaurant (Stacks) and wasn't very impressed, but that's separate ownership. Would definitely stay here again.

I would never stay here again!! I didn’t book the stay, but was part of a girls trip. The photos online are clearly very old. The bed was lumpy, the staff was not helpful & our room was never cleaned. Also, it’s across the street from a strip club!

Horrible place. I reserved a room for a Technician. He sent me pictures and video of the nasty room. I was told he reported it to staff and nothing was done. Room was non smoking and smelled of smoke and another smell that was stated that it smelled like garbage. Dog barking most of the night above him and the toilet was not secured to the floor.
management_response: Thank you very much for taking the time to let us know about your experience. We sincerely apologize for the odor and cleanliness issues encountered by your technician during his stay. These conditions are not consistent with our standards for quality. We do, indeed, care about your experience and will utilize your comments in our ongoing training and property improvements.

review_text: This was the most disgusting place I have ever stayed. my family will not be back. It started with pubic hairs on the toilet. The room was not properly cleaned. One of the hot tubs did not work and staff did not seem to care about it ever getting fixed.
management_response: Thank you for your stay with us at the Ramada Plaza by Wyndham. We attempt to provide all of our guests with outstanding customer care and a clean, comfortable room. I am sorry that this standard was not met, I have reviewed your comments with our staff in an effort to avoid similar issues in the future. I hope you would be willing to give us a second chance in the future to provide you with the quality service and cleanliness that we strive to provide.

review_title: Filthy - checked in and immediately checked out
review_text:
I can’t understand how this hotel is getting such high reviews. I booked this place for three nights while we waited for our temporary housing to open up in Portland (husband is a travel nurse). After we checked in, I was following my toddler around while she explored the room (as she always does), and I could see that it was not clean. The first thing I noticed was a thick layer of dirt and dead bugs in the sliding door track. I was willing to let it go, I can see why the area might be missed, although it looked as though the door track hadn’t been cleaned in a year. Then I started wiping down the high touch surfaces with a sanitizer wipe (I always do this at hotels), and the fridge handle and door was caked in brown goo which came off on the wipe. Then I saw the crumbs and thick layer of dirt around the mini fridge. So I moved the mini fridge and saw that it was filthy underneath. I also noticed the arms of the chair in the room were crusty.  The final straw was the  condom wrapper and random trash behind the tv stand. The hotel tried to put up a fight at first, but they eventually gave in and let me cancel with a full refund. I would absolutely not recommend anyone stay here. 

Also, the city of Portland is under a mask mandate, but not a single employee was masked and neither were the customers.
management_response: Thank you for your stay and for leaving a candid review about our hotel on TripAdvisor. We value your feedback as this will allow us to identify the areas that may benefit from our additional attention. Rest assured that the cleanliness of our rooms has always been our main priority and it is disheartening to learn that it fell below par during your stay. We will utilize your feedback during our regular training to avoid such issues in the future. I would like to note that our staff has worn masks during all mask mandates and has done our best to have guests do the same - we have handed out boxes and boxes of masks in that effort.

review_text: An older property, but in decent shape. The personal were friendly and helpful.  Our room was clean and plenty of hot water for showers. We were close to the areas we wanted to visit. I can't think of anything else..........................

The room was disgustingly dirty throughout the suite.  I left a personal item behind and when I called to inquire about it, twice, they informed me they had not booked the room out and their staff didn't find my expensive item.  I'm not impressed with this hotel and don't recommend staying there to anyone.
management_response: Please accept my apologies for the issues you experienced during your stay with us. We will utilize your comments during our ongoing staff training to ensure a better stay for future guests. I hope that you will give us another opportunity to show you our usual level of comfort and hospitality.

review_text:
La perfection n'existe pas mais Vincent et son ti'village créole s'en approche. Nous avons passé 3 semaines merveilleuse dans son paradis avec comme seul réveil le cocorico du coq. La piscine est super avec une eau à température extra. 

Le gite est simple mais fonctionnel, il n'y manque rien et si d'aventure il manque quelque chose, Vincent nous le sort de son "chapeau". Il y a tout le confort pour se reposer loin du stress de la métropole et du boulot.

Vincent est un hote parfait, avec toute la gentillesse qui caractérise les antillais et toujours avec le mot pour rire.

En bref, nous recommandons le ti'village créole et promis, Vincent, la prochaine fois, on laissera une roue de roquefort et une côte de boeuf à la place du riz et de la moutarde.

Très agréable séjour du 7 au 14 janvier 2013 emplacement numèro 7 
Accueil très chaleureux malgrès notre arrivé assez tardive.
Le propriétaire des lieux était présent de suite aucune attente pour nous remettre les clefs.
A notre arrivé corbeille de fruit,ananas,banane,citron vert,rhum,sucre,café.
De l'eau dans le frigo qui était la bienvenue ainsi que du lait et du jus du fruit.
Bungalow très bien équipé superbe térasse avec cuisine équipée sur la térasse.
Salle de bain au top,douche,wc super propre.
Dressing niquel,chambre rien à dire.
Je vous conseil cette adresse avec grand plaisir.
Vincent est un mec super qui vous conseille et communique avec vous sans problème.
Il fais bon vivre au ti village créole!!!!
Merci pour tout et nous reviendrons l'année prochaine.
Amicalement 
jim et pam

review_title: Bon gîte pour partir à la découverte de la Guadeloupe
review_text:
Nous avons résidé dans ce gîte pendant 10 nuits au mois d'octobre.
Globalement nous avons été satisfait même si comme le mentionne l'avis précédent des rafraichissements seraient le bienvenu.
Le gite que nous avions comporté une cuisine en terrasse, une pièce à vivre avec clic clac et TV + grand dressing, une chambre indépensante et une salle de bain / WC.
Au niveau de la pièce à vivre, pas grand chose à redire mise à part que nous avons eu un petit souci de clim' puisque celle ci est tombée en panne au milieu du séjour et n'a pas pu être réparée malgré les efforts du proprio. 
Ensuite nous avons essayé une nuit de déplier le clic clac puisque nous avions un lit défectueux et celui ci n'était plus utilisable.
Concernant la chambre, correct avec une clim' mais c'est vrai que la literie vieillit mal...
La salle de bain était propre rien à redire.
La cuisine sur la terrasse comportait tout ce dont nous avions besoin avec liquide vaisselle, sel, poivre, sac poubelle etc...
Enfin très gentille attention du proprio puisqu'à notre arrivée nous avions le frigo avec une brique de lait, de jus de fruit et une bouteille de rhum! sans oublier le petit panier d'accueil pour le premier petit dej.

Nous sommes allés dans ce gite completement hors saison donc la grande majorité des gites n'étaient pas occupés donc très calme.
Nous n'avons pas profité de la piscine donc je n'émettrai pas de critique sur celle ci.
Enfin parking privatif sécurisé.

Concernant la proximité avec le centre de St Anne nous prenions tjrs la voiture puisque nous partions nous balader tous les jours mais je pense qu'il y avait des raccourcis pour y aller rapidement à pied.

Globalement donc je dirai que c'est une adresse correcte avec un proprio dispo et donnant des tuyaux pour visiter la Guadeloupe mais c'est vrai que les lieux mériteraient un petit rafraichissement...

review_title: Bien mais attention à la perte du "triple A"
review_text:
Très bon séjour dans cet hébergement, le personnel est très attentionné, il y a un petit panier garni à l'arrivé (bouteille de rhum, citron vert, thé sucre...). Les logements sont fonctionnels, la cuisine extérieure sur la terrasse est très agréable. La vue de la terrasse est assez quelconque mais cela ne nous a pas ennuyés.

Par contre il semble que les bungalows commencent à accuser quelque peu les traces du temps, sans pour autant que de petits rafraîchissements aient été faits. Par exemple 
- notre literie était épouvantable (sommier en "cuvette", matelas suranné).
- la salle de bain nécessitait clairement un petit coup de frais (peintures abîmées par l'humidité, meuble de salle de bains gonflé par l'eau, bonde de lavabo HS...)
- la piscine mérite un petit coup de Karcher car elle commence un peu à faire "cracra"

Par ailleurs, nous avons été réveillés tous les matins par des coqs qui nous faisaient comprendre que le jour se levait et eux aussi par la même occasion (vers les 5h du matin). L'isolation phonique étant très légère, c'était comme si on avait le coq dans la chambre.

Bref, globalement une bonne adresse mais il est temps que le propriétaire réagisse avant de perdre sa 1ère place sur les logements de St Anne.

J'ai eu la chance d'aller dans cet endroit merveilleux l'an dernier (juin 2011) et je le conseille vivement.
L'acceuil plus que chaleureux, des conseils avisés du patron et une disponibilité à toute epreuve.

Les bungalows sont tres bien situés et l'equipement plus que correct.

La piscine disponible dans le village est bien agréable après les nombreuses visites.

Vraiment si vous avez envie de decouvrir ce pays magnifique, n'allez pas vous perdre dans des hotels ou vous risqueriez d'etre decus, le Ti' village creole est une valeur sure. Pour ma part, si je decide un jour de retourner en Guadeloupe, mon hebergement est tout trouvé.

Bonjour, 

nous revenons du Ti Village Créole à sainte Anne et n'avons pas été décu de notre séjour, les bungalows sont sur les hauteurs de Sainte Anne à 10-15 minutes a pied de la plage et du centre.
Les bungalows sont situés dans un endroit très calme, ils sont bien équipés, et la piscine est très agréable surtout lors d'un retour de visite pour s'y raffraichir.
Une voiture reste quand même presque indispensable pour visiter la Guadeloupe, celui qui ne désire pas louer de voiture il est possible de faire ses courses dans le centre de Sainte Anne, mais pour le retour, ca monte et sous le soleil...dur dur  :-)

Nous y retournerons

This is a great affordable place about a 20 minute walk from the Sainte-Anne beach.  The owners are helpful and gracious.  It's a quiet spot on the top of a hill  surrounded by lush vegetation.  There is also a great view of the sky at night.  

I stayed in a studio room, with an outdoor kitchen that had an electric gate when I wanted to close the space off from the outside.  The place was simple but clean and well kept.

Lizards, frogs, lightning bugs, a few chickens, roosters and chicks, and a two small sweet stray cats added charm to the setting. 

This is a great location for exploring the island.  And, if you don't mind walking you can reserve renting a car for the days you want to spend outside of st. Anne. From st anne beach, you can book boat trips and EXCELLENT scuba trips at Aqua Zen.  You can walk to the st. anne beach which has great snorkeling if you don't mind a careful few minute swim to the off shore reef. You can also walk to the Club Med beach which some people seem to prefer to st. anne.

Overall, the price, hospitality, room, setting and location make this a place I can confidently  recomend.

review_title: Good bungallows close to the main tourist area
review_text:
Location: good, in Ste Anne, which is where most tourists are. You will need a car to get there, but in Guadeloupe you need a car anyway.
Bungallows: big enough, with a room, a bathroom, a small living room and and a kitchen. 

The owner is really friendly and will give you tips.

Abbiamo soggiornato 8 giorni al ti Village Creole e ci siamo trovati molto bene. Il posto è pulito, spazioso ed è situato sulle alture-colline a 10 minuti a piedi dal centro di Sainte Anne. La cucina è esterna e le camere sono spaziose. Il sig. Vincent, il propietario è una persona molto riservata ma allo stesso tempo è disponibile e gentile. Il posto è molto tranquillo, ideale per coppie e famiglie.

Même si les gîtes de Grande terre ne peuvent pas se prévaloir du charme de ceux de Basse-Terre, Ti Village Créole et son sympathique propriétaire représente une très bonne adresse pour découvrir la grande Terre. "Piégés" dans un gîte pitoyables à Anse Bertrand, nous y avons écourté notre séjour et avons appelé Vincent pour une location le soir même, cela s'est fait un 5 minutes. L'accueil était super, le gite sympa dans un jardin tropical, la piscine agréable et l'hôte aux petits soins pour répondre à vos demandes (un saut de glace pour l'apéro le premier soir ;-) ) . Les chambres sont confortables et climatisées (heureusement car nous avons tenté de dormir sans clim le premier soir, l’expérience ayant duré une heure). La cuisine est suffisamment équipée et fonctionnelle.

Adresse a conseiller

review_title: PROBABLY ONE OF THE BEST PLACES TO STAY IN BORDEAUX
review_text: We booked in for three nights in Sanchez on the first floor overlooking the impressive Eglise Saint Louis in the lovely Chartrons district. Our room was quiet, spacious, beautifully furnished, and extremely comfortable. Some smells from the excellent bakery below waft up in the morning but this was not a problem. The apartments are a short walk from the river front, and the Jardin Public, and are well served by tram stops, a short distance away, which we travelled on regularly using our good value Bordeaux City Passes. The Chartrons neighbourhood has a village-like feel to it with a good range of cafes and restaurants close by including the excellent Chez Dupont bistro itself. Booking ahead seems most essential, and indeed we did several months in advance. Overall we had an excellent stay. Thoroughly recommended.

Quel bon moment passé chez vous… l’hôtel est magnifique, très propre, un service au top au delà de mes expériences! Cet hôtel est idéalement situé à côté de la magnifique église des chartrons, dans la plus belle rue de bordeaux, celle des antiquaires belle est calme. Merci aussi à Margot pour son accueil et sa réactivité. Je recommande a 100%.

Very great location and rooms so well decorated, I litteraly fell in love with this hotel ! The beds are so confortable and the neighboroud is one of the best place in Bordeaux. Plus, it's very near to the Garonne's docks ! 
I come in Bordeaux very often and this is always the hotel I choose to stay !
Margot is very professional and always keen to help and welcome you like a princess, thank you very much ! 
Highly recommended :)

Hébergement original et tout confort en plein centre de Bordeaux. De la réservation au départ de la chambre nous avons apprécié le professionnalisme et la gentillesse de Margot.
Nous sommes venus en voiture et le parking de la Cité Mondiale est à 2 minutes. Nous ne sommes restés que 2 jours et tout se fait à pied. 
Nous recommandons et n’hésiterons pas à y retourner.
management_response:
Chère Christelle

Je vous remercie pour votre agréable retour et suis ravie que vous ayez apprécié ce moment passé chez nous.

A bientôt

Margot

review_text:
I thought this would be a little hotel above the eponymous restaurant, but apparently they own several nearby apartments in the Chartrons district. This is really an Airbnb:  you email the manager with your arrival time, and there is a code for the door and a lockbox for the room key. We had a good-sized, well-furnished room, and bathroom was fine.
Only (minor) downside was limited, rather impractical, storage space and a suboptimal ‘continental breakfast’ consisting of self-made coffee, bottle of orange juice, and small, commercial, cellophane wrapped cakes. There is, however, a delicious bakery next door.

Venus en couple, une chambre chez Dupont est idéalement placé au cœur des chartrons. Chambre spacieuse, atypique et décorée avec goût. Excellent accueil, personnel arrangeant et à votre disposition. Rien à dire, nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir !

Cool room, Salmide.
Great location. 
Nice roof windows showing the church towers.
Waking up to the smell of the bakery below was special.
Helpful and flexible service.
Highly recommended.

Thank you Pierre Jean.

C’est une adresse exceptionnelle. J’ai été touché par l’accueil avec des personnes remplis de bon sentiment, de gentillesse et de bienveillance. 
La chambre était une véritable merveille et l’emplacement de 1 er choix . 
Je recommande vivement

On m'a recommandé ce superbe hotel. Un accueil parfait, un confort, une tranquillité, un superbe emplacement, de bons conseils, une propreté, une originalité. Tout est reuni pour de bonnes vacances. Allez y !

review_title: No es un un hotel al uso.
review_text:
La valoración que tiene de su ubicación no debería superar el 8, son 20min-media hora al centro (catedral, plaza del parlamento) andando. No se trata de un hotel, son habitaciones que estan muy bein pero con un servicio tipo airbnb, sin recepción, etc.
Eso si, buena atención e interes por parte de su responsable. Recominedo aparcar en un parking cercano al hotel, a nosotros nos rompieron el cristal del coche y nos robaron la primera noche.

Hotel est tres bien situe, pas loin de centre, a cote de la place de Republique  alors pas mal de resto! et  les chambres sont tres propres, accueil fantastique, et important : les petits dejeuners sont parfait!

review_text: Located very good, nice and very friendly staff. Rooms are fine; we had a view on the Tour Eiffel from our room in 5th floor. Did not like the coffee much and wardrobe space is tiny but that’s not much to complain…

review_text:
We've booked and paid for 2 nights at Hotel Alhambra. I called to let them know that we'd be arriving only for the second night. We weren't asking for a refund, just that they keep our room for the second night. We were told that if we didn't check in on the first night we would be considered a no-show and our booking cancelled, despite calling to let them know.
As consumers we have rights  and i will try to pursue this further once our circumstances allow, but for now at least I can warn others of their frightful attitude towards paying 'guests'.
management_response:

You booked a room with booking.com with spcail condition no refundable, no cancellation, no modification , and you had a discount for 30%.

You called  the hotel , the next day to inform us that you arrive late the second night.

You phoned to booking.com and said that you can not come in the hotel because , it was a no show without reason.

review_title: The perfect hotel if you want to be not a guest but a cash machine!
review_text:
The perfect hotel if you want to be not a guest but a cash machine!

I can’t evaluate the accomodation because my trip failed up.
If they take care of room’s cleaning and services with the same severity they use in understanding customers, it’s for sure a great hotel!

Five stars in courtesy!

Lo sciopero è stato peraltro in Italia e non in Francia.

Ti abbiamo offerto un accordo per rifiutare l'ingresso.

Non hai nemmeno dormito nel nostro albergo e osi massacrarci valutandoci severamente

Saluti

ricezione

review_text:
Cet hôtel est génial ! Il est facile d'accès ainsi que pas très loin de tout si vous vous déplacez via le métro. De plus, les personnes à l'accueil sont super sympathique et bienveillantes, elle se sont également très bien occupées de nous autant que de nos bagages, on y a été très bien accueillies. J'ai vraiment apprécié discuter avec le personnel de cet hôtel.
Je suis venue à l'occasion d'un concert prenant place au Bataclan (qui se sitie à 5 minutes à pied de l'hôtel), si un autre concert à lieu dans cette salle, je reviendrai dans cet hôtel à coup sûr !

Au plaisir de vous revoir très prochainement avec ou sans un concert au Bataclan

review_text: Stayed here as a couple for 3 nights. Rooms are clean and fairly modern, and although small, they were absolutely fine for 3 nights. The breakfast buffet was 15 euros per person. We ate breakfast once at the hotel and found it good value for money considering what you will pay for breakfast in the cafes, etc around Paris. Good location surrounded by plenty of bars and cafes and also less than a 2 minute walk to the Oberkampf Metro station. Staff friendly and helpful. Thank you

review_text: Si je revenais à Paris je réserverai de nouveau dans ce même hôtel, très bien placé, très propre et avec un excellent rapport qualité prix. En plein centre ville, notre chambre était ultra calme et c’était parfait! L’un des deux hôtes est très gentil

review_text: Loved our stay at Little National. The location is lovely and convenient, with plenty of secure parking. The staff were friendly and very welcoming and our room was comfortable and peaceful. There are also a number of great eating option just minutes from the Hotel.

review_title: Never fails to meet my expectations
review_text:
Little National is my “go to” when I need a “Staycation” and some R&R. It gives me the opportunity to enjoy a peaceful time in a relaxing environment with everything I need right there. It is located in such a lovely area of Canberra, close to the lake, parks and great restaurants. 
Staff are friendly and helpful.

review_text:
Overall very impressed. 
Our only criticism would be the mattress quality, way too soft for comfort. That aside, I would definitely recommend.
The staff were friendly and accommodating. 
Very conveniently located, only a short walk to Parliament House.

review_title: Great spot, contemporary decor and amazing staff - helpful, friendly and interested in customer service.
review_text: Good location, luxurious bedding and fittings, parking available but everything in ACT seems accessible. They have a low impact customer service style that is available and discreet. The lounge was good to spread out in and have a drink outside your room while doing some work. The neighbouring DOMA hotels offer facilities you can use which was excellent. Better for single travellers but highly recommended either way.
management_response:

review_text: I contacted the property after seeing several reviews about the beds, they are soft which is my preference. I immediately booked after finding this out, and was not disappointed. I easily fell asleep each night of my stay. I hardly heard any noise during my stay, ear plugs were not needed. The blackout curtain was the best I have had in a hotel. One day around noon I closed the curtain without turning on a light, thankfully I had my cell phone so I could use the flashlight. Once closed it was pitch black!
management_response:
Hi wm0ran

Thank you for the great little review. We hope to welcome you back again soon for another memorable stay with is at LN.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: This hotel is in a great location for a Canberra stay. This is my second time staying here and this time the bed was way too soft for me and not good support for my back. On the weekend the attached coffee shop is closed which is a shame if you do not wish to venture further for a coffee or breakfast
management_response:
Hi M8186Ujenny!
Thank you for taking the time to leave a little review of your recent stay. Whilst Ritual is closed on the weekend, a short stroll away is Maple + Clove, a wholefoods cafe. Alternatively, a little further away is neighbouring Kingston and Manuka; full of cafes and restaurants. 
We look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

review_text: Great location, wonderful staff...would appreciate an in-house restaurant..near by restaurant very expensive. Overall, great rooms and peaceful environment. Nearby great scenary places to visit. Walking distance to other interesting places
management_response:
Hi desofosa
Thank you for your review and we hope to see you again soon. On a future trip, make sure you check out Med, our newest addition to the precinct tabling Eastern Meditteranean cuisine at a great price. 
Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text:
This should have been a four or five star review but ...
- the slope of the bathroom floor channelled shower water out of the shower and into the bathroom creating a safety hazard with mopping required
- I was not given a car par exit pass on checkout and had to reverse back down a very tight exit lane to get one
- I was told parking was included but a parking charge appeared on my account
- there was only one clothes hanger
Apart from the problem with the slope of the floor these seem to be staff training issues.
They sent me a survey at the start of my stay but didnt respond to the issues I raised in that.
management_response:
Hi Ian,
Thank you for your feedback.
I am so sorry about the upset experience that you went through. The issues had been addressed to our maintenance team and our higher management team, we will follow it up.
Thank you again for your stay, hope to welcome you back again soon.
Regards,
Guest Services

review_text: this is a quiet and convenient hotel, not far from Parliament house. I found the minimalist design, quite relaxing period I was there over the weekend which was a good thing period there is a lot of construction going on adjacent to the hotel and I don’t know how quiet it would be during weekday business hours.  but after hours I expect it would be fine.

Regards,
Guest Services

review_text: I stayed 3 nights while attending a conference at Realm Hotel. Great value, very friendly and helpful staff & loved the huge window in my room. I did some work in the library - beautiful space with lots of private spaces, free apples, other food & kitchen.
management_response:
Dear Sarah,

Thank you for your lovely review. The huge window is really one of greatest ideas of our room, and the library is a great choice when you want to take a break from your room!

Thank you once again for choosing to stay with us and we look forward to welcome you back very soon. 

Kind regards, 
Little National Hotel Canberra

review_title: Nice, clean and inexpensive overnight stop for couples travelling in the region
review_text: We were taking a car trip up the coast of Maine, primary emphasis on Bar Harbor and Acadia National Park. We did not want to miss out on Portland all together so planned 2 nights at this location. This worked out well for us. There were many nicer properties at much higher rates on the wharf in Portland or downtown. This property suited us very well for the 2 night stopover and permitted us to have  a full day of tours and eating in the more famous parts of Portland. I am glad we planned it this way. This property worked out very well as it was clean and comfortable. Good location with easy access to downtown.
management_response: Thank you for taking the time to review your stay with us. We are happy to hear that we helped to make your visit to Portland an enjoyable one - we hope to welcome you again!

review_text: This hotel was adequate, but not more than that.  Wi-Fi too weak to be usable.  No daily cleaning.  Close to restaurants and retail stores (Stacks restaurant is fabulous for breakfast).  Easy access to interstate.
management_response: I am sorry that we didn't make your stay a more memorable one. While our typical housekeeping service is currently limited to every third day, we are happy to provide service daily upon request. We are also happy to provide extra amenities at any time. I hope that you will give us the opportunity to provide you with a better stay in the future.

review_title: No shuttle service to Portland airport
review_text: It cost me $30 to get a cab and the cab only accepted cash to get to the hotel and even more to get to the rental car location. Had to wait for a cab. Only one place to eat for dinner in hotel and menu was limited but food was good and plentiful. I do not think I would ever recommend this hotel due to lack of shuttle service.
management_response: Yes, unfortunately we have discontinued our shuttle service as of January 1, 2021. While it was difficult, we made the decision that it was a service that could not be continued in the manner that we have done it in the past considering the current issues with staffing. We still provide extended parking (up to 21 days) for guests who want to leave their vehicle and arrange for their transportation to and from the airport. We appreciate your past business and hope that you will consider us again for any future visits to the Portland area.

review_title: Nice Stay in Portland with Dog
review_text: We stayed one night at the Portland Ramada with our dog and had a nice stay.  The room and bathroom were clean and spacious and the bed was comfortable.  The location is very convenient close to the highway.  Staff were friendly at check in.  The restaurant on site was mostly closed but we were able to get some drinks at the bar  Overall, a nice stay for one night.  I would stay here again if visiting the area, especially with a dog.
management_response: Thank you for taking the time to review your stay with us. We hope to see you again in the future!

review_text: The hotel is old and run down.  I needs a renovation.  Worse than that, it's difficult to get extras if you need them.  Besides myself, there were several people I ran into who were unable to get the basics like coffee packets for the makers in their rooms.  There was one person I saw asking the front desk clerk for some toothpaste because they had forgot to pack theirs.  Like the coffee packets, they were told that there was none to be had.  Since there is a restaurant in the hotel, they do not serve any kind of breakfast for people who would just like something quick before they go out the doors in the morning.  The mattress in the room was uncomfortable and was in need of replacing.  One thing I didn't mention in my review to the hotel directly was that my room door looked as though it had been forcibly entered into.  It was a little unsettling.
management_response:
On behalf of our entire team, I would like to apologize for failing to meet your expectations. Your satisfaction is important to us and we will be using the feedback you provided to make improvements to ensure we offer an exceptional experience for our guests in the future. We regularly upgrade the rooms and property to ensure that our guests have a comfortable and enjoyable time.

Not to make excuses, but with the current supply chain issues, we have had many items that we normally supply free of charge that we are unable to get from not only our regular supplier, but from any supplier.

I hope that you will consider staying with us again so that we can have another chance to provide you with a superior experience.

review_text:
Had driven 8 hours.  Was soaking wet from a sudden cloudburst , so skipped eating downtown Portland because hotel had restaurant. 
Unfortunately,  it was Labor day so restaurant closed.
People at front desk were pleasant. 

The major problem is that when, i decided to take a shower,  , it was dirty. 
The tub floor was not clean. 
There was hair in the side of shower .
The mirror in the bathroom had hair on it.

Obviously,  no tip for housekeeper.
management_response:
Thank you for your stay and for leaving a candid review about our hotel on TripAdvisor. We value your feedback as this will allow us to identify the areas that may benefit from our additional attention. Rest assured that the cleanliness of our rooms has always been our main priority and it is disheartening to learn that it fell below par during your stay. We will utilize your feedback during our regular training to avoid such issues in the future.

Again, thank you for your feedback and I hope that you will give us the opportunity to show you our usual high standards.

review_text:
The room was dirty : the overall smell was bad and the sheets were dirty. It’s like the room have not been cleaned since the previous customer.
The price was not worth the stay.
Good distance to the airport and free parking on site.
management_response: Thank you for your stay with us at the Ramada Plaza by Wyndham. We attempt to provide all of our guests with outstanding customer care and a clean, comfortable room. I apologize that this standard was not met, and I only hope you would be willing to give us a second chance in the future to provide you with the quality service and cleanliness that we strive to provide.

review_text:
I wasn't going to stay at this hotel. I had car trouble and it was the closest to the car shop. Boy were we in for a good surprise. It was close to downtown, several restaurants, and the highway. 

I was met by a great receptionist (I think that's the title). The room was a bit small. It was clean and for the price point, it was great. Admittedly, $143.84 was a bit high but seemed to be within the local pricing.

I will go back to this place whether it is for speaking engagements or for vacations.
management_response: Thank you for letting us know about your stay! I am glad that we were able to turn a difficult situation with your car into a better time. Hopefully we can welcome you again in the future.

review_text: The hotel is very outdated and even though it seemed clean it was not a relaxed atmosphere.  We could literally hear the peeing through our bed headboard and the tv on each side of us.  It was like staying in a motel 6 with price tag of "Hilton' in my opinion.  Will never do a Ramada again.  Was very disappointed.
