On behalf of our entire team, I would like to apologize for failing to meet your expectations. Your satisfaction is important to us and we will be using the feedback you provided to make improvements to ensure we offer an exceptional experience for our guests in the future.

I hope that you will consider staying with us again so that we can have another chance to provide you with a superior experience.

review_text: Convenient location right off the highway but the rooms were quiet. Reasonable price. "Stacks" restaurant has an awesome, good quality selection for breakfast, also at a reasonable price. Easy15 min drive to Portland.
management_response: I am glad that you enjoyed your stay and will share your comments with our staff. We hope to welcome you again in the future!

review_text:
Ti'Village Creole est un hotel trés agréable dans un trés belle entourage. Le Gite est bien équipé, air conditionné dans la chambre et le salon. La cuisine trés fonctionel et propre. Si vous cherchez la tranquilitée, Ti' Village est le bon endroit. Vincent le propiétaire est trés charmant et serviable. Il est tout le temps disponible pour vous informer ou vous aidez en cas de pepin. La plage de la Caravelle est à 5mn en voiture ainsi que le village de Sainte Anne.
Un voyage de noce inoubliable. Nous reviendrons. Nous conseillons vivement cet hotel.
Raúl et Linda

accueil très sympa,hébergement dans le respect de chacun,bungalow bien isolé,clim:dans la chambre,dans le salon Piscine controlèe avec affichage de la qualité de l'eau,(très satisfaisant )internet gratuit,parking sécurisé,le responsable à l'écoute de tous, a la limite remplace l'office du touristes.Propreté rien à dire,jardin avec beaucoup de Colibri qui vont de fleurs en fleurs,environnement agréable,nous avons beaucoup voyagé,et TI Village Créole,est très bon  rapport qualité prix . Dans la cuisine une casserole défectueuse changée sur le champs pour une neuve.j'y retournerais.

Before going to Ti'Village Creole, we were a bit stressed reading the other review....but when we arrived, we were really happy to  discover a nice, quiet and great baby's place (free chicks, small frogs, snails and the kind dog's owner "Salsa") .
The owner is friendly, bungalows are pleasant and 2 minutes by car to downtown.
We stayed 2 weeks and actually, I would recommend Ti'Village Creole.

Je suis partie en Guadeloupe avec mon mari en Mars 2010,c'est un voyage qu'on voulait faire depuis quelques temps et qu'on attendait avec impatience. A notre arrivée là-bas, on était très contents mais qu'une hate après 8h de vol , c'était de rentrer au studio qu'on avait loué, via une agence de voyage, au ti village créole. Arrivés sur place, nous avons été très déçus malgré un agréable accueil. Le logement était rafistolé dans certains endroits, et il y avait surtout un gros manque de propreté ( trou dans les murs, joints de salle de bain noirs, fond de douche noir, fuite au robinet des toilettes) . De plus, le studio donnait sur le jardin, qui lui aussi manquait vraiment d'entretien, on se serait crut dans la jungle!!! pas une seule fleur en vue ni même un bel arbre, juste des bananiers complètement grillés!! Très décevant quand on voit le prix d'une location sur une ile comme la Guadeloupe.

Superbe endroit les chambres sont magnifiques et bien tenues. Décorées avec originalité et goût. Très au calme mais idéalement situé dans le quartier des Chartrons. Belle découverte. 
Le patron est très sympa l organisation très bien nous arrivions après 20h tout nous a clairement été indiqué par sms et mail. 
Adresse à retenir pour y revenir, nous avons également aimé la ville de Bordeaux c était une découverte et nous avons été agréablement surpris de la sympathie des gens. 
A refaire

un posticino da favola centrale che di più non si può, ben servito dai mezzi, arredato in maniera simpatica con ogni stanza diversa. Consiglio le stanze delle mansarde per la vista della cattedrale dal lucernaio che già questa vale la bellezza della stanza. Buon servizio, macchina caffè e tea in camera e stanza rifatta ogni giorno. Un B&B di lusso. Prezzi nella media.

Great location and nice accommodation. Pierre was very helpful prior and during visit.
The restaurant was great (will review separately) and the location was really convenient, short walk to city centre and close to some nice bars and restaurants.

review_title: Wonderful stay at this comfortable, well located, great place
review_text:
I highly recommend. The communications with the host were very good. He was gracious and helpful when we met, and flexible with times (I arrived early and he had my room ready for me, I could have left my luggage with him if necessary). The instructions he gave me for entering the apartment were 100%. 
The apartment is lovely (Kergomard). Great value for money. The design is modern but classic, very aesthetic, large and airy. It's located in a beautiful but quiet part of the old area, close to varied eating places and a boulangerie right downstairs. The views from the windows are beautiful. There's plenty of space, all the facilities including good and continuous wifi and a well equipped kitchenette. The apartment was clean and the facilities in very good shape. Lots of lights for nighttime, and electric blinds to shut out the sunshine if sleeping late. 
The only minus, and a minor one: the very strong smell of burned bread or baking from the boulangerie. It's not a bad smell...The smell was strongest in the passageway leading to the apartment. In the apartment I did open up a window a few times to air out the smell, which helped a lot.

review_title: Grandes chambres de caractère, quartier des Chartrons
review_text:
Première visite à Bordeaux, nous avons loué 2 chambres un peu au hasard (avec TripAdvisor, quand même !) et nous avons vraiment été enchantés : chambre Salmide au 3ème étage et Ferbos au 1er étage, toutes deux grandes et avec une déco sympa et originale. Le petit plus avec les explications sur le nom des personnalités, en lien avec la ville. Le quartier est lui aussi très agréable, tout proche du centre lui-même (10 minutes à pied de la place des Quinconces). Il y a largement de quoi petit-déjeuner aux alentours, à quelques minutes à pied. 
Accueil sympathique, on peut échanger par email ou sms, ou bien se rencontrer au bureau dans la même rue.
Bref, rien à redire, sauf si vous ne supportez pas l'odeur de pain frais : les chambres sont au dessus d'une bonne boulangerie ! A noter également, escaliers assez raides, si vous n'êtes pas alertes ou très chargés, choisissez une chambre au 1er et non au 3ème. Sinon, meilleure vue au 3ème.
Ce n'est pas donné non plus, mais cela vaut le coût.

Hotel bien situé, bien desservi par les trams, dans un quartier calme, cossu et néanmoins vivant, la chambre Salmide est parfaite  : cosy, grande, (presque une suite), décorée avec goût, literie confort, tout est bien pensé, vue sur le clocher de l'église par le velux... (Seul souci si personnes à mobilité réduite : au 3è étage sans ascenseur)

review_title: Great Hotel in a great location.
review_text: Une Chambre Chez du Pont is a delightful stylish establishment in a very cool part of central Bordeaux.  The rooms are really amazing and the hospitality shown to people staying there by the hosts is excellent. We felt spoilt staying here and would definetly stay again. Plus the Restaurants downstairs serve extraordinarily good food. Couldn't be better. I highly recommend this Private Hotel to anyone wanting an authentic, tasteful Bordeaux experience.

Excellent séjour dans un quartier extrêmement sympathique proche de toutes commodités. La chambre est grande, propre et très bien décorée avec des meubles anciens mélangés à des touches plus actuelles. C’est très agréable pour les yeux. J’ai mangé également au restaurant situé 40 mètres plus loin et là encore, ce fut excellent à tout point de vue !
Tout était parfaitement bien organisé avec le propriétaire qui m’a communiqué par mail l’ensemble des détails pratiques et les codes pour récupérer les clés.
La seule petite critique serait que je n’ai jamais traité avec une personne de physique durant ce séjour. Une personne à qui vous pourriez serrer la pince pour le remercier de la qualité de ces établissements.

review_title: Art-Art-filled Room in the Heart of Chartrons
review_text: You could not ask for a more convenient location in this charming district. Above a boulangerie, across from a beautiful church and close to affiliated Chez Dupont and Bistro Dupont, our room in this B&B was quiet yet close to the active riverfront and late night spots.

Una piccola chicca nel quartiere dell’antiquarito di Bordeaux... camere arredate con gusto, ampie, pulizia top.. posizione fantastica a 10 minuti a piedi dal centro, la vista dalla mia camera a dir poco stupenda!!! Consigliatissimo.. ci tornerò sicuramente 🔝🔝🔝

Nous avons passé une nuit dans cet hôtel de très bonne qualité. Accueil très agréable et cordial avec ce qu’il faut d’humour. Les chambres sont très belles. Hôtel propre. Petit déjeuner buffet de bonne tenue.  
A 2 pas du métro Oberkampf. Très bien placé au cœur de Paris. 
Je recommande
management_response:
Bonjour,
Nous vous remercions d'avoir choisi notre établissement ainsi que pour votre commentaire sympathique.
Nous sommes ravis que vous ayez apprécié votre séjour à l’hôtel.
Nous espérons vous accueillir de nouveau à l'occasion de votre prochain séjour à paris.
Cordialement
la direction

review_text: Ottimo hotel al centro di Parigi. A cinque minuti a piedi da Place de la République. Il personale è stato gentile e accogliente. Le camere sono adeguate allo standard di Parigi. La colazione è ottima. Assolutamente da consigliare per un soggiorno a Parigi

review_title: DISSAPOINTING! and still one more night to go!!!!
review_text:
It is my job  to book travel for my colleagues when they are working onsite all around the world.  What a disappointment to hear that although 'clean', the manager is very rude!!  The hotel lock the doors so if your coming back late at night it's nearly impossible to get in (its a hotel so being able to get in and out is paramount) but its equally not that safe as this morning one of my colleagues couldn't even get out to go for a walk!! The manager had locked everyone in whilst he went somewhere! 

After working all night onsite, with a 'do not disturb sign' on the door the cleaner tried to enter my colleagues room twice even though she was also told not to bother!!!

There are 5 of my colleagues staying in 5 rooms so a great deal of money is being paid and I don't expect my colleagues to be treated like this! 

Do better Hotel Alhambra, be nice!

Esse hotel é bem localizado. Endereço do lado do metrô. Dali nos deslocamos pra paris toda ! Andando você chega no marrais, notre dame

review_text:
Well this was a very pleasant trip down memory lane.  During a recent business trip to Paris I stopped at this hotel which I first stopped at as a 12 year old on a school trip back in 1989.  

Room clean and comfortable.  Staff very pleasant.  

I’ll be stopping there again on subsequent return visits.

review_text: Little National Hotel is a great option for an easy, quiet stay. Walking distance from the busy Hotel Realm Precinct, LNH provides a slower pace with the Library and Lounge open for guests. Rooms are simple and comfortable providing all the amenities you need for a short stay.
management_response:

Thank you once again for choosing to stay with us and we look forward to welcome you back very soon. 

Kind regards, 
Little National Hotel Canberra

review_title: An excellent hotel in a great location
review_text: The two of us stayed for three nights. The rooms while relatively small are well designed and very comfortable. The only downside is the limited wardrobe space but the relative cost, location, cleanliness and amenities more than make up for that. We would absolutely stay there again and have recommended the LN Hotel to our friends and family.
management_response:
Hi Herbitude
Thank you for the great review of your recent stay. We certainly embrace the little at Little National and look forward to welcoming you back in the near future for another little getaway!

review_text: We really loved our stay at little National. First of all the rooms aren’t as small as you think they are. They were a great size for my husband, our baby and myself. The bed is amazingly comfy so much that we almost didn’t want to leave the room to venture around. Friendly and helpful staff which is always great when you have an infant with you. the lounge area honour system was convenient for quick snacks when you just don’t feel like going anywhere ! And just a beautiful little hotel with great facilities. Will definitely return.
management_response:
Hi Cheydrey

Thank you for the great review of your recent stay. We adore our 'Arms of Morpheus' beds too! We look forward to welcoming hte three of you back again soon.

Warm regards
Kathryn

review_text: I had a wonderful one-night stay at Little National Hotel Canberra over the weekend. The service was exceptional, and the price was very reasonable. What a pleasant surprise to receive complimentary drinks upon check-in! The room was excellent, and the convenience of free on-site parking was a bonus. I particularly enjoyed the cozy breakout lounge. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I would highly recommend this hotel for a stay in Canberra.

Nous avons passé un super séjour dans les chambres chez dupont, la chambre salmide est magnifique, la décoration unique. De plus l’accueil et la disponibilité d’Alexandre nous ont permis de profiter au maximum de la ville.

Enfin le restaurant chez dupont est une expérience tout aussi agréable, nourriture de qualité et personnel accueillant nous offre un bon moment.

review_title: Highly recommend - excellent in every way
review_text: We had a great stay at Chez Dupont. Pierre Jean was extremely welcoming and helpful both before and during our stay, and we felt like we'd hit the jackpot with regards location - Chartons is an absolutely charming part of Bordeaux and within easy walking distance of the city centre. The room was comfortable and clean. We'd definitely return.

review_title: Great location, stunning room, perfect B&B,
review_text:
Bordeaux rose to our TOP3 city destinations in Europe. Especially the Chartrones district where we lived proved to be excellent. 

Best of all, our chosen B&B Une Chambre Chez Dupont proved to be the best in the area. We chose the room SEIGNOURET, which turned out to be the best apartment in the hotel. Beautifully urban French views of the main street Rue Notre Dame, but without the noise or harassment. 

The service was excellent and the recommended breakfast bar was perfect. Air conditioning worked perfectly, which was important because it was over +30 outdoors. 

Chambre Chez Dupont was a great discovery. Five stars for location, service and spacious room.

review_title: IN THE HEART OF THE CITY
review_text:
I stayed at the 'Albert Pitres' apartment on a recent trip to the beautiful and typically French city of Bordeaux.
What a wonderful place to be based, with bars, restaurants, shops and the tram station all within a five minute walk.
The apartment itself is very specious and conformable, with a quirky and unique style you won't come across anywhere else. 
Located in a small, quite street, which is ideal, its very peaceful and safe at night.
My one and only criticism has to be the very steep and winding, castle like stone stair case, which is very difficult to climb, especially with your luggage in tow.

Super accueil, tres amical! 
La suite est tres classieuse et decoree avec beaucoup de gout!
La location est parfaite, juste a cote de bars tres sympa!
La cuisine du restaurant est savoureuse et bien franchouillarde comme on l aime! 
Une experience inoubliable que je recommande.

review_title: Stylish, comfortable, in a pleasant part of town

Really helpful staff, full of advice. They helped us with taxis and went out their way to look after our bikes. 

Bed was comfortable. Room was warm. Small kitchenette. 

Some good bars/bistros nearby. Worth a visit.

review_text:

Nous avons apprécié la literie excellente, le contact facile avec le propriétaire par mail ou sms, et les très bonnes adresses sur Bordeaux ou dans la région.

I came back after go after coffee to 2 more for a total of 4 creepy crawly roach type bugs. The room had an odor of animal pee and there was water on the bathroom floor from a leaky toilet. For over $200 a night the room was definitely subpar.  We have always gone to this hotel due to its great convenience but they have definitely taken a nosedive in their cleanliness and room quality. Not sure if we will stay again.

review_text: For the price I paid (300+) per night, I expected better than peeling wall paper in the bathroom due to no exhaust fan there, dirty corners in the bathroom, unpainted door frame on the bottom in the bathroom, filthy coffee maker. Found a pair of earrings on the carpet so obviously it had not been vacuumed. And the smoking area was right outside of the lobby so we were greeted by cigarette smell.

review_title: So Poorly Run it Should be Shut Down
review_text:
My husband and I spent a couple of nights at this Ramada for a family wedding in the area.  While not the newest or nicest looking hotel in Portland, our first night went fine.  Upon check-in, we specifically asked about smoking in rooms, and were informed that smoking in hotel rooms is illegal in Maine- however, the front desk worker who checked us in said that there is usually "nothing the hotel can do" other than put the guest who smokes on a list of people who are never allowed to rent again.  As guest, that did little to comfort me- while putting such a  guest on a list helps the hotel, what does it do for the other guests who have to deal with the smoke created by someone else?  We should have know right then that what she said would foreshadow our second night.  

When we got back from our wedding on the second night, our entire floor reeked of marijuana smoke.  When we called the front desk, the person we spoke with seemed unconcerned, insisting that someone was probably on their balcony and the smell was coming back into the hotel (and our room) through the AC vents- as though that is any better!  They would not investigate, or contact either of the 2 rooms where the smell was strongest (and happened to be next door to us).  When we decided to go down to talk to the manager on duty in person, we also noticed ants crawling all over the outside of the elevator on our floor (which, while unrelated, is just disgusting).  Upon speaking with the overnight front desk manager, she again reiterated that they could not "bother" anyone on a hunch that the smoking was coming from their room.  Ignore that what they were doing (smoking anything in a hotel room in Maine) is considered illegal, and was making me ill.  I would never contemplate staying at this poorly run location again, and truly think Ramada should consider taking action against local management for utter ineptitude.

Stayed here after a late flight into Portland. It was fine for the night and the staff was accommodating when we asked for additional towels and pillows. Simple to check in and out and served our purpose.

The room wasn't clean, there was trash on the floor and dust on all the surfaces. The bathtub was nice but the jets clearly hadn't been cleaned in a long time. Everything smelled like cigarettes, if you're a smoker this is the place for you. Everyone smokes on the balconies and it unfortunately carries inside. The bed was really comfortable but the sheets didn't fit the bed so we were constantly adjusting them. Overall not worth the money we paid to stay there.

I am disappointed we spent the money but I suppose it was reasonable considering the prices were outrageous everywhere else for 4th of July. I probably wouldn't go back unless it had a significant renovation.

The beds were very comfortable so if all you were using the hotel for was that good night sleep, this is the place. It was a good landing place after staying active in town and out to Peak's Island for the day.

review_text:

We stayed for 3 nights and the quality of housekeeping was one of the lowest I’ve seen, even at this price point. After 3 nights I had to call and ask why sheets were never changed, to which I was simply told they were not changed during a guests stay (that’s their basic policy) and that I’d need to ask for this service. As there is no card to place on the bed, it seems this means you need to call. 

Furthermore. We used the coffee pods one morning (2 normal capsules) and after this this replaced the 2 we used with 2 more decaf making all 4 decaf. Totally useless for the following three days. 

Overall, poor housekeeping, tiny room did not offset the cheaper price (220 AUD/night). For me, next time, I’d probably pay a little more and get a full service hotel. But for the solo business or backpacker traveller, for one or two nights, this could be your place.

review_text:
This is a hostel at a hotel price, without even the benefit of a shared kitchen.
Tiny, bare room. Yes, hotel rooms in Europe are generally much smaller than those in the U.S. And yes, Paris hotel rooms seem even tinier than the average European room, but at this place the room was so small that we had to move the one tiny chair in order to reach the other side of the two twin beds pushed together in our "twin standard" room." I'm a small person, but the path around the bed was about 18" wide, so there is no way you can get by a chair sticking out from under a desk into that pathway. Even with the chair put in the one available corner, I walked into the chipped particle board desk more than once.
The AC did not go below 19 C, though i,t was nearly 80 F (~27 C) in Paris for 3 of the days we were there. When we asked the front desk about lowering the temp, he said they turn off the AC in France in October. Of course that's not true- a subsequent hotel had the AC available during our stay in November. The front desk told us to just open the window for air, which we did. But the sound of metal carts being pushed over stone walkways at 7 am, the leaf blower that started ~7:30 a.m. on Saturday morning, and the dance studio next door that left its windows open while the class clapped, yelled, and played the same song over and over for hours until 10pm, made it kind of hard to sleep with the window open.
Aside the from the tiny room, most of the front desk staff, and especially the owner, were terrible.  This place insists that guests leave their key card at the front desk when leaving the property. That means waiting for the front desk staff to be available every time you come back. And it also means dealing with their mistakes, as we had to do.  On our second day there, the front desk gave me a key card to someone else's room, which I did not discover until I'd already climbed the 3 floors to our room.  When it didn't work, I noticed the card case had a first floor room number on it. So I could have just entered that room at will. Of course I did not, and returned it to the front desk, but how many times do they make this mistake and jeopardize one's personal property? To make matters worse, after going back down to return the card, I was given our key card, only to climb the stairs again and find our card no longer worked. I went back down to the desk, (at this point having climbed and descended a total of 12 flights of stairs), and the guy initially acted like I must not know how to use the key card. When I suggested he go up and try the card himself, he finally took the time to try the card in some machine he had, and discovered that, in fact, the card no longer worked. No apology from the front desk guy, just some lame excuse that the key cards reset after 3 months (?!).  
And yes, I could have taken the elevator, but it was usually in use and took much longer than taking the stairs.
The icing on the cake was the owner:  he was rude and obnoxious. When we checked in, he couldn't be bothered to get off his personal call.  He was annoyed that we were wearing masks and kept saying he didn't understand us, so we had to take them off to speak with him, though one of the desk staff was later sneezing and sniffling at the desk without even covering his mouth.  
One morning I tried to leave the hotel but found I could not get out because the front door was locked and there was nobody at the desk.  I found a staff person downstairs, but she said she didn't know how to open the door. She asked another staff person who said the owner wasn't available and I'd have to wait to get out.  I asked for another door, and was told there wasn't any.  At that point I was pretty upset, as I had plans and I felt like a prisoner.  The sfaff found the owner, and he showed up in the lobby a few minutes later and started yelling at me that he had some kind of guest situation he had to deal with, and that he can do what he wants because it was his hotel.  I cannot imagine what would happen in the event of a fire or other emergency. How can nobody else in the hotel know how to open the (allegedly) only exit in the building? After that experience, I now believe the reviewers that mention the owner locked them in the building while trying to get them to pay more money.
The garden, while nice to look at, was not available for use in the morning unless you purchased their  breakfast, which I discovered when I tried to go outside with my coffee (whcih I did purchase from them).  I was told I had to wait until the breakfast was over.  
The place gets two starts because it is centrally located and it was relatively clean, but there are literally dozens of other hotels in the same area, and multiple on the same block. 
There is simply no justification for staying in this place.
management_response:

We need to answer about your feed back.

You made a booking with booking.com, and with special booking conditions : nomodification date, no refundable, no cancellation.

You wanted to arrive 2 days after the check in date, and you do not come in the hotel.

review_title: Pessimo! Una truffa coperta da booking
review_text: Ho prenotato per 4 giorni 2 camere al costo di 2327 € con prenotazione cancellabile sino al 17/10, data alla quale mi hanno addebitato l’intero soggiorno. Il 19/10 ho ricevuto un messaggio dalla compagnia aerea di cancellazione del volo di giorno 21 per sciopero nazionale. Dieci minuti dopo ho scritto all’albergo per avvisare che mio malgrado sarei arrivata un giorno dopo. Non pretendevo alcun rimborso. Con stupore il manager dell’albergo mi ha risposto: ‘non è un problema mio! Non sono una compagnia aerea. O arrivi il 21 entro le 23.30 oppure non hai più le camere per mancata presentazione. Mi attengo alle regole’. Gli ho scritto in ogni modo cercando di convincerlo e spiegando che non perdeva nulla. Al contrario stava lasciando 6 persone per strada. Non ha voluto sentire ragione, nemmeno quando Booking.com ha spiega che la mia non era mancata presentazione visto che stavo avvisando 48h prima. Il suo principio va contro tutte le regole del hotellerie. Purtroppo Booking.com ha dovuto aspettare che lui il 21 ci applicasse la penale e poi ci ha riprogetto. All’ultimo minuto ci hanno riprogetto in un posto isolato e poco collegato.  Ci ha rovinato la vacanza. Sconsiglio vivamente. Al primo ostacolo non siete tutelati. Manager testardo e irragionevole. Ho allegato una minima parte della corrispondenza. Nb. Lui ha rimesso le camere in vendita!
management_response:
Signore,

Vogliamo rispondere ai tuoi commenti.

review_text:
A lovely hotel in a very nice neighbourhood. Very close to the metro with quick links around the city. We had a lovely welcome by Hacen, who was friendly and helpful. Our room was beautiful. Although small it was perfect for our stay with everything we needed. The room and bathroom was very clean and tastefully decorated. We had a street view balcony which was lovely for pictures.
The bed was so comfortable, I had the best nights sleep. The shower was amazing too!
Breakfast was in the basement with access to the beautiful garden area- unfortunately we picked a busy time to arrive for breakfast and so we had to sit inside.
Breakfast was very good with a variety of options.
All staff were very friendly and helpful.
I wish we could have stayed longer, we will definitely return . Thank you for a short but lovely stay.

review_text: Air conditioning was life-saving and not weak like we expected; double bed was huge and not meagre as we expected; staff seemed to like us in spite of our terrible French.  And the breakfast was great even though we thought it would be better to eat at a cafe at those prices.

review_title: A lovely apartment in the center of Bordeaux
review_text: Chez DuPont was the first stop on our three week trip to celebrate our anniversary. What a great way to start a vacation. Our room (the Kergomard suite) was spacious, beautifully decorated, full of natural light and very comfortable. The smells from the Boulangerie below were a wonderful way to wake up and perfect for breakfast with the coffee and tea provided. The location - within easy walking distance of the river and the old city of Bordeaux can’t be beat. Pierre Jean was a gracious and helpful host and was able make a last minute reservation for a wine tour. We give Une Chambre Chez DuPont our highest recommendation!

Hemos estado en esta ciudad y nos hemos alojado en las habitaciones Chez Dupon, muy bien decorados, con gusto y con clase.
Muy centricos, pudimos ir a todos los lugares a pie. Si hay algo a indicar, el tener  demasiada calefaccion y calor por la noche, pero creo que es un tema menor.
Repetiremos cuando volvamos a Burdeos.

This was our first visit to Bordeaux and we spent 4 nights in the Albert Pitres suite at the top of the stairs (not an easy climb with all the luggage!!).  The location is several blocks from a large parking garage, so that is very convenient.  The neighborhood is quiet at night, and down the street is a small Carrefour so we could buy breakfast items like yogurt and fruit.  We arrived on a Sat and the staff had neglected to replenish the coffee/tea basket, so we bought coffee pods at the store, no big inconvenience.  The staff also only left one roll of toilet tissue, so we had to buy a whole package of that since the rooms are not done on Sunday.  We did not see Pierre Jean until Monday.  So I think the one negative impression we had was that he could do a little more to connect with guests in a more personal manner -- leave a welcome note or something!  Couldn't an assistant be available for certain hours when he is not on the premises?

The bed was very comfortable, plenty of storage in bath and bedroom, nice, very modern fixtures.  Small table for eating had horribly uncomfortable metal chairs that collapsed when we tried to stand up .. The A/C worked very well, thankfully because it was hot in early Sept.

The location was wonderful.  We love walking and only took the tram a couple of times, preferring to walk into the center of the city.  We loved Bordeaux and would definitely like to return.  What the city lacks in historical or cultural attractions, it makes up for in many ways --  small city accessibility with beautiful architecture, terrific restaurants with a great variety of ethnic food,  fun shopping and people watching -- a slice of real French city life with the vibrancy of a university town.  Also fun to take day trips to St Emilion and Arcachon!!

We stayed here in the room Seignouret, first floor so not too many stairs to climb, lovely comfy bed, best shower ever, tea, coffee water, biscuits + orange juice provided. Staff were lovely, friendly and helpful.
near the tram stop so very handy and great café and bakery for breakfast nearby. 
We stayed 2 weekends both sides of a week spent elsewhere and much enjoyed our visit to Bordeaux. the Bistro was great for dinner on both Sturdays.
only slight criticism is that, as the room is not "done" on sundays maybye a bit more milk and oranje juice for the weekend would be a good idea!

Nous venons de passer 4 nuits dans ce charmant établissement. Notre chambre était très agréable et spacieuse. La deco très originale et tout était d un très grand confort. Les chambres "chez Dupont" sont très bien situées: à deux pas des quais, le tram vers le centre ville ou vers la cité du vine sont seulement deux minutes à pied. Mais la meilleure façon de découvrir une ville est la marche ( ce que nous avons fait !).faites aussi un petit détour dans le restaurant "chez Dupont " vous ne serez pas déçu: tout y est excellent et le service impeccable. Nous recommandons cette adresse les yeux fermés. Notre séjour était très très réussi. Bravo à toute l équipe

Stayed in the Sanchez room. So good. Large studio style suite. Modern, clean, quiet and styled to perfection. The location is not the usual tourist shopping eating area however a quick walk got us to all we needed. Will be staying here again when back in Bordeaux. Thank you for an amazing stay.

2 nuits dans une des chambres de Dupont.
Décor soignée, qualité des matériaux et quartier charmant.
Vrai coup de cœur. Plus souple qu'un hôtel et rien à envier à une grosse structure.
Le mini bar à discrétion est appréciable le matin.

Great location for the amazing room (Stephen) we got in Bordeaux. Pierre-Jean was helpful in recommending sites and tours around the area. Our room was on the top floor and we had a skylight with the wonderful view of the church tower. Walking distance from the city center and heritage sites, as well as close to the tram station. Couldn't have wanted for a better place to stay.

Stayed at this lovely little place in the Chartrons district of Bordeaux. 

The room (Placide) is exquisitely decorated, well appointed with a very nice shower room, air con and in a relatively quiet part of Chartrons. Piere Jean could not be more helpful or accommodating - what a lovely guy.

The hotel is not far from a square with an abundance of restaurants and a lively nightlife atmosphere. The local food is amazing at Chez Boulon - try the Oysters or whatever the seafood special is (it was white Tuna Steak when we went)! or take a stroll along the river to Makila Kafe and have the Entrecote of Beef with a cold beer. Mind-Blowing.....

Bordeaux is a beautiful city to visit and only 90 minutes flight from Gatwick. Lovely people, most of whom speak excellent English. Culture, Amazing Architecture and History.An Absolutely superb weekend! 

We'll be back!

hotel_name: Chalet Le Alpi - Azzurro Club Vacanze
review_text: A disappointment, arrived at the hotel and highly dirty room, as if it had not been cleaned, phone not working (or rather works a minute and that's it.) Definitely not warm water and little Warm thing not very pleasant after a day of skiing. Communiquéd everything immediately and promised to remedy it immediately but... badly the answer: (the water is boiling and the phone works, we had the room cleaned up!) to which we check and the problem is the same as before ... we do not blame the poor cleaning lady who is one and rightly can not do the job for many .. but rather the poor organization of the owners or managers of the chalet. Sauna and pool all inclusive... too bad there was a thing working. Let's say that 130 euros per night per person is too much for what is offered. Definitely a bad experience not to be repeated. We strongly recommend either hiring someone and keeping cleaner or lowering prices, because that is not a good way to welcome people at all.

hotel_name: Chalet Le Alpi - Azzurro Club Vacanze
review_text:
500€ or so for 2 nights , you expect a place that has quite high requirements and instead it sucks . bathroom with 2 fingers of dust , hair in the shower, just zero hygiene ...phone that does not work , care that on a 3 star you expect basic , with what it costs per night (130€ per night per person ! ) . 

The location of the facility nothing to say , but the management makes water on all sides . 

You wake up on a Saturday morning to the music of the reception at most and find it difficult to speak. It's okay to be young and everything, but there is respect for those who pay and want a little relaxation these days. 

Second day ( Saturday ) we try the SPA included in the price : terrible experience - swimming pool with cold water and bottom not cleaned for months (if it's okay ) , unlivable spa and follows the Turkish bath , what else can we say ?! Ah yes , spent 74€ for 2 cheap costumes for not having benefited from anything . Total disappointment. 

In addition , discounts that have not been said to rent skis and take advantage of dedicated equipment discovering them later by pure chance 

Too bad because the place can be top and has potential, but if run like this, I don't know how long it can last.

I strongly advise against it, if you want to throw away 500€ for 2 days, this is the place for you!

 Vi aspettiamo con piacere per un altro soggiorno all'insegna del relax e del divertimento. A presto

review_text: We had a great experience with the front desk and cleaning staff. All were very polite and accommodating. Our room was clean and comfortable. The area in the lobby was very home like and a comfortable place to sit. My check in and check out were very easy! I wish the pool was open later so we could actually use it but we’d definitely stay here again!

review_title: Must have been a bad night
review_text:
I should have run as I was waiting in the lobby to check-in when the front desk clerk went to the evening manager and said, " room ### is asking for clean towels. The ones left in their room are dirty". Those guests check-in that afternoon, the clerk shared with me.
 
Given the benefit of the doubt, and needed a hotel room close to the hospital as my daughter was having an early morning procedure. I looked over 25+ other hotels in the area. I chose this hotel because of the reviews. I was incredibly disappointed, to say the least. 

Our room was disgusting.

No pillowcases or comforters. 
The shower was clean, and the mirror but hair on the toilet and sink looked as it was never wiped out.
All the light switches were filthy. The one by the bed had a dark brown substance on it. Bugs dead on the bathroom walls.  Overall looked as the room never had a good time down either, coffee maker, a layer of filth, and almost all the services. 

Thankfully, the beds were clean.....to my eye. We just needed a place to rest our heads. For the amount of money I paid to stay in a Ramada, I expected more. The facility overall was extremely outdated, which doesn't bother me if the facility is CLEAN!!!!

The ladies at the desk were overwhelmed, and I did feel awful with the seriousness of events that were happening. However, besides handing me pillowcases, that was how the situation was handled.

I was hesitant about booking this hotel but I am so happy that everything turned our great. The two ladies at the front desk are so nice and helpful at any hour of the day. The building is clearly dated but walking into my room I was pleasantly surprised. The room was extremely clean, no weird smell and THE BEDDD... oh my god the bed is amazingly comfortable ! Very happy with my stay :)

We came to Maine to visit my daughter and her family and the Ramada was pretty close to their home.  We enjoyed our stay here, however, there was a lot of people that looked homeless hanging around in the hotel.  We were a little disappointed about the restaurant not being open for breakfast.  The beds were comfortable and plenty of space in the room.

Marijuana smell thru out the inside hallways and stairwell's room was outdated and carpet was old and stained would not recommending staying there no maid service had to dump and replace my own trash had to ask for towels toilet items

My dog is welcome and seems to relax as much as we do.  We come to Portland twice a year and stay no where else but here. Staff is super friends and the seasons grill has great specials. Will definitely be back.

Rooms was nice, clean !  Would stay there again! Great location right off the highway and near our daughter. Near shopping center.(  Why does a trip advisor review have to be a minimum of 200 characters?)

Dirty hotel and smelled of smoke. The floors were very dirty. The room smelled of smoke and marijuana. It is a Wyndham Ramada and I thought it was better. There was pot smoking in the parking lot. They did allow me to cancel
management_response:
Thank you for taking the time to post a review of your recent visit to our hotel. 

On behalf of our entire team, I would like to apologize for failing to exceed your expectations. Your satisfaction is important to us and we will be using the feedback you provided to make improvements to ensure we offer an exceptional experience for our guests in the future. We are a non-smoking hotel for all of the indoor areas and smoke smell is normally not an issue, I am sorry that was not the case for your stay.

I hope that you will consider staying with us again so that we can have another chance to provide you with a superior experience.

review_text: We booked this hotel after another hotel cancelled us. The price was amazing for booking the day of. The staff was very friendly and the room was very clean. We got a hotel for my son to swim on his birthday. Was an amazing stay. Will be back for sure.

I have stayed here for several years using it as a park and ride to the Portland Jetport and parking my car.  This last trip I purchased the park and ride and was told upon arrival that it no longer exists.  They were able to let me park the car there still for the trip and got a cab one way, leaving me to find a ride back to their hotel when I return from my flight. I also wasn't impressed I had to ride share from the hotel to the airport in the cab with another couple during Covid-19.

Good value hotel with excellent common areas for relaxing and working. The log fires were great. I stayed here with two teenage kids on the way to the Snowy to break up the trip and save some money - Jindabyne is a rort. It was a very short walk to Parliament House too.
management_response:

review_title: Great for a single business traveller, but not for everyone
review_text:
My room was exactly as large as needed for one person and no more, so couples would need to bring a sense of humour and families can seek accommodation elsewhere.  The number of power/USB ports was adequate, the Wi-Fi was reasonably fast, and the bed could have been firmer but was not too soft.

The bathroom was mostly well-designed, but they opted for a square sink which is clearly difficult to clean in the corners - there was some aged yellow gunk in each - but it was serviceable and I had no intention of drinking out of it.  The various soaps/shampoos/etc were of good quality and pleasantly scented.

I liked the rainhead/handheld shower options - the pressure was a bit low but that's probably part of their 5* environmental rating.

The two large communal spaces, offering complimentary coffee, tea and hot chocolate (all of a decent quality), are a good idea for parties of multiple travellers who want to spend time together or for individual travellers to read/work in a larger venue than their room with more comfortable chairs (at the tradeoff cost of being public to all other guests).

I plan to stay here again next time work takes me to this part of Canberra.
management_response:

Please come back and visit us again when you are in town.

review_title: Hotel Alhambra was everything we asked for and more
review_text:
This hotel is in Le Marais which is a great area for those wishing to be outside the busy tourist area but close enough to visit tourist attractions daily on their trip. The hotel is VERY close to the Oberkampf metro stop, making accesibility to all areas of the city easy. As for the hotel itself, we booked a single Queen room and while the rooms are small, they are also thoughtfully organized, clean, and well kept. After all, we did not come to Paris to move about our rooms. We had rooms up the spiral staircase with a view of the courtyard. It was lovely. The hotel offers a very generous complimentary breakfast and staff were warm  helpful,  and offered up many dining suggestions which were delicious and reasonably priced. 
I would absolutely  book this hotel again or recommend it to any body looking for a true Parisien experience.

review_title: Great hotel in a great neighborhood
review_text:
Great hotel in an even better part of town. 

The rooms are small, but we didn't come to Paris to stay in the room. Regardless of their size, they are brand new, nicely furnished with pristine bathrooms, and the bed was nice and firm. 

The staff were very helpful on multiple occasions. 

The courtyard is beautiful with nice tables for an evening drink before bed. 

The best part of this hotel is the breakfast. I can't say enough about how delicious it was. The choices were great with everything from eggs and bacon, to cold cuts and cheese (including brie and camembert), smoked salmon, and the delicious pastries you'd expect in France. We also made good use of the coffee machine which had several options. 

I would stay again! Merci!

review_title: Best hotel in this area for a fair price
review_text:
I was here in march 2020 and I loved it here. That's the reason for coming back in 2022. Just next to Metro Oberkampf from where you can visit the entire city easily.
The Hotel is clean, very good shower, witch I like very much. The streets are noisy but in the rooms is a noisyless airco! So you can just keep the window closed.
An elevator brings you to the floor you prefer. 
Breakfast can be eaten at the garden witch is also a very pleasant stay at daytime. In or out of the sun. Very special in the middle of Paris at this class. 
I always love to have my breakfast in a local café so I cannot rate it.
The owner and his wife and all the other workers at the hotel are very cooperative when you have a question.
Why dot I tell you all of this??
I wanted to be my secret place in Paris but at the end I decided to share... ;)

We will be glad to advise you on your future visits when you visit us again!
The reception team

review_text:

The staff were friendly and helpful. I would stay at this hotel again and I would recommend to others.

review_text: Wow! What a great place to stay in the quaint French neighborhood.  Many restaurants within walking distance. Pastry shop across the street. Try the restaurant attached to the apartment.  Great prices and tasty food. Apartment roomy with great shower. The only drawback is no lift. It was a three flight climb up to the room. Beautiful scenery and very clean. Pierre Jean wonderful to book wine trip for us. Private driver through the wine country.  Easy walking distance to all sights. Easy to use public transportation system.  If you want to stay away from the crowds but still have the feel of a french neighborhood this is the place.

review_title: Local colour, terrific location, walk to riverboat
review_text: High ratings in Lonely Planet and TripAdvisor sent us to this delightful spot in the Chartrons district of Bordeaux. We were not disappointed! Rue Notre Dame is a lively street through the district. Our room was newly outfitted in an old house beside a highly favoured bakery and across the street from the lovely St Pierre church, and another bakery that was also our breakfast stop. From our sidewalk table we saw locals walking and biking to work, stopping at the next-door flower shop, and browsing antiques across the street. Pierre-Jean was very helpful, and we enjoyed a wonderful dinner at the restaurant for our special anniversary. The quay for our CroisiEurope river cruise was an easy 10-minute walk away, and the centre of Bordeaux can be reached in 5 minutes on the very efficient tram service. A perfect 3 days in Bordeaux!

The whole trip started as expected with our taxi (and Driver Patrick) being on time and as arranged for us by Pierre-Jean. When we arrived, and entered the building and climbed 64 stairs (fourth floor) to find an absolutely wonderful room .. Guess some people would have found the stairs a bit much, but, wow, what a room. We couldn't fault it to be honest.
Pierre-Jean came over to make sure everything was OK and left us to enjoy our break, knowing that we can contact him at anytime.
I could write loads more, but in summary, the room we had was wonderful and the surrounding area, Cathedral, bars, restaurants, all well worth the visit and experience.

Many thanks Pierre-Jean

review_title: Juwel im sehr schönen Quartier Chartrons...
review_text: Die charmante Unterkunft bei CHEZ DUPONTS ist ideal gelegen im ruhigen und gerade sehr trendigen Quartier Chartorns, zu Fuss erreicht man die sehenswerten Orte, kann aber auch gut im Quartier verweilen mit seinen Plätzen und kleinen Gassen, schräg gegenüber eine tolle kleine Boulangerie und natürlich im Haus die Brasserie mit guter Karte und tollem Essen. Die Zimmer sind individuell und geschmackvoll eingerichtet, gut ausgestattet mit Kühlschrank, Teekocher, Mikrowelle, Kaffeemaschine. Wir fanden es super unkompliziert, sehr charmant und überaus freundlich beim Empfang durch Pierre-Jean. Hatten das Fenwick-Zimmer. Bei einem erneuten Besuch in Bordeaux logieren wir sehr gerne wieder hier! Tolle Empfehlung!

Nous avons tout aimé: le quartier, la chambre belle, décorée avec goût, spacieuse, propre, avec machine à café. Literie impeccable. Nous sommes comme chez nous au calme. Le quartier est charmant et le gérant de très bons conseils pour visiter Bordeaux et les alentours. L'endroit où séjourner absolument.

Nous sommes venus découvrir la ville de Bordeaux le temps d'un week-end en amoureux. Nous avons découvert chez Dupont par hasard, et le site internet, les avis attrayants ainsi que des prix raisonnables (offre promotionnelle) nous ont poussé à réserver. 
Que dire ? Un emplacement parfait, un accueil simple, rapide mais tellement agréable. Pierre-Jean fut disponible et très accueillant. Tout était simple et sans prise de tête (remise des clefs, horaires de départ et d'arrivé souples, communication avec le gérant..). 
Nous avons logé dans la chambre Salmide et nous en sommes tombés amoureux. Une chambre sous les toits Bordelais, bercée par la lumière de l'église via les fenêtres de notre toit et par l'odeur des viennoiseries de la boulangerie d'en bas. 

Nous laissons ce commentaires deux mois après notre visite, car nous avons toujours cette chambre en tête.. Si nous revenons à Bordeaux, Une Chambre Chez Dupont sera l'une des principales raisons de notre visite !

My friend and I booked this accommodation for two nights. 
We were collected by Patrick from airport for 50 euros. Patrick was on time and met us with a warm welcome. Very comfortable car for journey to accommodation. 
The accommodation was a large apartment. It was ideal for our stay being clean and comfortable. 
We were given instructions prior as to how to enter stair and access our key. Pierre was very warm and friendly when we met up with him. Keen to make sure that everything was satisfactory.

Chambre très bien décorée, spacieuse, élégante et très confortable. Idéalement située dans le quartier des Chartrons, à deux pas d'un parking souterrain. Très pratique d'accès. Check in pratique et simple. A tester absolument!

J'ai dormi une nuit chez Dupont dans la chambre Placide . 
Décoration soignée et de très bon goût, de la pierre, des couleurs chaudes, literie de qualité, à noter wc et sdb séparés : ce qui est appréciable et rare sur une petite surface.
Le parking de la cité du vin à proximité et l'attrait du quartier des charrons finissent de faire de cette adresse une très jolie halte à recommander à vos " très bons amis only"!!

J ai séjourné une nuit chez Dupont après une soirée de travail dans le restaurant éponyme. Excellente communication avec le gérant,  qui m'a proposé pour le même tarif un surclassement dans l'une de leur plus belles chambres. Tout y était parfait, décoration et ambiance cosy , charme des pierres bordelaise, parquet qui craque comme on aime, cafetiere nespreso dosettes, thé, madeleines de Commercy et gateaux a dispostion ainsi que jus d'orange et eau à disposition également. Literie extremement confortable. Enfin emplacement idéal dans un des quartiers les plus sympas/bobo/arty de Bordeaux. Je reviendrai des que possible!

Honestly seemed like a homeless shelter. Blood stains on sheets, only a sheet and thin blanket provided, room HVAC didn’t work, weed smell everywhere, and people loitering throughout hallways. Can’t believe I paid to stay here.

review_text:
The Little National Hotel tries to market itself as an affordable luxurious hotel, and I can see why... however, it has a few drawbacks. In saying that, the hotel is still rather nice. The bed and the pillows are the best I have experienced from a hotel in Canberra. The small lounge/library area is a nice feature as a common area for guests to hang out or do work. The room layout also feels very spacious for such a small room with the use of mirrors and thoughtful planning.

Now, the drawbacks of the hotel:

Firstly, the elevator from the hotel carport doesn't serve as guest access to their hotel floor. Rather, you have to go outside and in through the main entrance to access the correct elevator.

Secondly, the TV in the room didn't offer any streaming services at the time. I asked reception about this, and they said it's because they are currently in the process of changing the operating system. To me, it's a bit of a letdown when one of the main features of the room is having the TV right at the end of the bed.

Thirdly, I requested a late checkout, which was approved by the hotel. However, my access card was deactivated before my aporoved leave time without me being notified. So when I loaded my car, when I went back to get my last bag, I couldn't enter my room.

Would I stay here again? Possibly, but it won't be my first option when visiting Canberra.
management_response:
Dear guest,
Thank you for taking the time to write a review.  We appreciate your comments and am sorry to hear you were disappointed with the access to the hotel.  As the hotel has 7 floors of parking and the hotel on 2 levels there is no access available from the carpark.  You do have to make the 30 second walk to reception unfortunately.  
Due to the hotel migrating to a new property management system we did have technical issues for the first couple of days which have now been resolved.
Regards Guest Services

review_text: We have stayed here several times, unfortunately this is most likely our last. It's convenient, affordable and has a restaurant / lounge with live entertainment. Although the Karaoke is gone on Saturday nights the band was good.  The food however I could still taste the grease the next day.  Please have someone change the grease in that kitchen!  The French fries and onion rings and chicken fingers were black and had that weird aftertaste (indicating old grease) and the bartender(s) had friends they were serving and I sincerely doubt they were paying guests.  I saw a waterglass filled with kaluha go to one gent sitting by the bar tucked away in a dark corner

My profession is residential housekeeping so I have an eye for that kind of detail. Overall the bathroom looked pretty clean. A few specs here and there but no grime or hair. The number one things they should focus on is dusting. Especially base boards, vents/heaters, behind TVs, and all glass.  Side note, bartenders were not very welcoming.

Room is average. TV doesn’t have a lot of channels and no hand soap in bathroom, bathroom door doesn’t lock. Bed is comfortable and the room is relatively clean. Check in took a long time but the guy was nice. Nothing that would deter away from a second overnight stay.

We enjoyed the pool and hot tub, check in was easy. They accommodated us with extra blankets. 
The heater in the room was LOUD, like sleeping with your head in a dryer loud. And people were slamming doors and yelling in the hall allll night long. I know this isn’t exactly the hotel’s fault, but it was really a horrible night between the heater running and the constant people coming and going. Next time we will pay a little more for a nicer place. You get what you pay for!

The room was your average, standard hotel room. It wasn’t overly clean. We even found a long, stiff staple in the carpeting. Fortunately, neither of us stepped on it! 
It is winter in Maine and they had only one light blanket on the bed...odd. We had to request additional blanket for both beds. The heater was too noisy to run it all night long and not everyone wants to sleep with the room temp at 68...
The evening crew for check-in was not very personable. There were extremely noisy guests in our hallway, banging on doors, hollering at all hours of the night and early morning. When we mentioned it at check-out, it was like it wasn’t a big deal and nothing was offered to make it “right”...not even a proper apology. 
Overall...I’ve stayed at better, for less money.

Needed a hotel on our road trip home. Excellent service. Room was updated,spotless and comfortable. Great location to freeway and some food outlets. TV did not have MSNBC and free breakfast not available but those were our only disappointments with the hotel.

review_title: Location type Airbnb, mauvais rapport qualité prix
review_text: Les chambres de chez dupont relèvent clairement de la location d'appartements de type Airbnb. Pas de la chambre d'hôtes. Pas de lieux en commun, pas de petits déjeuners, et pas d'hôte...(une communication par texto pendant les trois jours). habitués réguliers des hébergements en chambres d'hôtes, nous avons passé deux nuits dans la suite Albert pitres au 3ieme. Un bon tiers de la surface ne devrait pas être déclaré habitable faute de pouvoir s'y tenir debout. Une suite qui nécessiterait un bon lifting: Moisissures sur les ouvrants, papier peint qui se décolle dans la salle de bain (pas de mosaïques...), peintures à reprendre. Et un bon nettoyage pour supprimer les toiles d'araignée et la poussière. Odeurs d'eau usée permanente dans la chambre, masquées par Des bâtonnets de parfum d'ambiance. Présence de petits gâteaux sympa s'ils n'étaient périmés depuis plus de deux mois!!! Bref, pas un standing qui corresponde ET DE LOIN aux 165€ payés pour la nuit.  Pour autant un super emplacement et une literie très correcte.
management_response:
Mr Emmanuel G,
Merci d'avoir laissé votre avis suite à votre séjour dans la chambre Albert Pitres. Tous les avis sont bons à prendre, bons ou mauvais, car ils forcent à se remettre en question si la prestation n'a pas été au niveau. 
Certains aspects que vous avez abordés n'ont pas été au niveau de la qualité de prestation que nous souhaitons proposer, c'est vrai, et j'en prends la responsabilité. Mais il convient également de rectifier certains points avancés dans votre avis.
Oui cette chambre est mansardée et une partie est basse mais la surface totale fait quand même 50m2, je doute que vous ayez passé votre séjour accroupi !
Oui en effet elle nécessite un bon lifting, nous en sommes conscient et nous avons prévu des travaux cet hiver.
Oui il y avait des gateaux dont la date était périmé et nous en sommes sincèrement désolé, c'est un grosse erreur de notre part.
Au niveau des odeurs, cela arrive si le syphon de la douche est vide (comme partout d'ailleurs). Cela a du être rectifié dès la douche d'après.
Concernant le tarif de 165€ par nuit, vous oubliez de mentionner que vous avez séjourné dans cette chambre à 3, que c'était votre souhait de n'avoir qu'une seule chambre à 3 (et non un double + 1 simple) et de fait qu'il y avait un lit d'appoint en supplément à 30€ la nuit (135€ + 30€ pour le lit) !

Mais par contre NON effectivement nous ne sommes pas une maison d'hôtes, nous ne faisons pas le petit déjeuner et nous n'avons pas d'espace commun. Nous ne l'avons jamais prétendu. C'est indiqué nulle part sur notre site internet et c'est également rappelé dans les emails échangés avant votre arrivée.
Je pense qu'à ce niveau là, cela s'apparente à une erreur de casting en sélectionnant notre établissement si vous souhaitiez une maison d'hôtes !
Concernant l'hôte, en l'occurence moi en qualité de responsable et ayant mon bureau situé à 20 mètres de votre chambre (nous avons 10 chambres dans 3 immeubles), effectivement je n'étais pas présent lors de votre arrivée le dimanche soir à 19h. Vous étiez au courant et je vous avais envoyé toute la procédure pour accéder à la chambre de façon autonome.
Cependant vous oubliez de préciser que dès le lendemain matin j'ai pris contact avec vous pour vous rencontrer au plus vite mais vous étiez déjà parti. J'ai essayer de frapper à maintes reprises à votre porte l'après midi, sans succès. 
Et il conviendra de dire aussi que vous êtes parti très rapidement le lendemain matin, sans essayer de prendre contact avec nous (nous étions sur place) et surtout sans payer !
Heureusement j'ai pu utiliser le numéro de carte bancaire fourni à la reservation.

Alors oui il y a eu des loupés et nous ne nous cachons pas. Mais je pense que vous vous êtes braqué devant cette situation. Il suffisait peut être de nous faire part de cela pendant votre séjour au lieu de nous éviter (pour ensuite dire qu'il n'y avait personne). Nous aurions consentis à un geste commerciale, à un gratuité après constatation de nos erreurs voir à un changement de chambre.
Notre exigence est importante Chez Dupont, que ce soit dans nos chambres ou à notre restaurant, en témoigne les centaines d'avis positifs. Si malheureusement vous n'êtes pas satisfait, encore faut il nous en faire part pendant le séjour et une solution peut toujours être trouvée très rapidement.

A bon entendeur.
Cordialement,

review_title: Nice location but camping could definitely be better
review_text:
The campsite is centrally located towards the area du verdon and only 30min drive from the st croix lake. The village a short walk away is cozy and picturesque, there are regular markets during the day and in the evening. From the campsite there is plenty to do and a trip to the sea at one of the nice places of the cote a zur is also doable in a travel time of about 1.5 hours.
As for the campsite itself, it offers pitches divided into two. A location is a bit more in the woods and offers less privacy. The other locations are a bit larger and offer more privacy. The pool is clean and beautiful. The plumbing is old, but more annoying that this is not cleaned properly and not regularly. 1x pd is really too little in high season, cobwebs everywhere, always a dirty toilet as well as the sinks and showers. The restaurant we experienced only once open, the rest of the two weeks closed. The pizza nights are takeaway nights, where the owner looks at you strangely and makes a comment “in your dreams” when you ask for
Ordered a pizza at 9:30 while the plate says until 10:00. Earlier we ordered pizza and had to wait 1,5h for it, after which we also had to wait a good 20min for the pizza at the pick-up time. 
The go-karts were off the chains and were only made after a few days (after we did this ourselves).
Several times had tried but flew off again and again) In addition, pets are allowed on the campsite, no problem, but the two dogs of the owners are constantly running loose, over your pitch and peeing everywhere.
As far as I am concerned, a campsite with a good location, but Service, hygiene and courtesy are far from being found. On the other hand, the two girls of the animation are friendly.
management_response:
Bonjour,
Merci d’avoir pris le temps de partager votre avis. Nous sommes heureux que vous ayez apprécié l’emplacement du camping, sa proximité avec le village et les nombreuses possibilités d’activités dans la région du Verdon et sur la Côte d’Azur.
Cependant, nous souhaitons apporter quelques précisions importantes :
- 🗺️ Localisation : Le lac de Sainte-Croix (Bauduen) est situé à seulement 15 minutes en voiture du camping, et non 30 minutes comme mentionné. Cette proximité est l’un des atouts majeurs de notre site.
- 🚿 Sanitaires : Nous regrettons que vous ayez eu une perception négative à ce sujet. En dehors du 10 août où nous avons relavé les sanitaires une 2ème fois le midi, les sanitaires ont été régulièrement nettoyés et maintenus dans un état très satisfaisant, comme en témoignent de nombreux autres vacanciers. Il est important de rappeler que la propreté dépend aussi du respect des lieux par chacun, et nous avons eu la chance d’accueillir une clientèle globalement très respectueuse.
- 🍽️ Restauration : Le restaurant est ouvert tous les jours sauf le mercredi. Le vendredi et samedi soir, nous proposons une carte variée incluant des pizzas, et le lundi une soirée moules-frites. Les autres jours, des pizzas à emporter sont disponibles. La fréquentation peut varier, mais l’offre est bien présente et adaptée aux envies de chacun. De plus, le village accessible à pied en 5 minutes propose plusieurs options de restauration pour tous les budgets.
Nous comprenons que chacun puisse avoir des attentes différentes, mais nous tenons à souligner que notre équipe met tout en œuvre pour offrir un séjour agréable et authentique à nos vacanciers. Nous restons à l’écoute pour continuer à nous améliorer, tout en valorisant les nombreux aspects positifs de notre camping et de son environnement.
Bien cordialement,

Anne et Philippe

review_title: Elegante sitemazione nel quartiere degli antiquari
review_text: Una elegante casa in pietra del Settecento nel bel quartiere di Chartrons, ricco di negozi di antiquariato e localini, a 50 metri dalla passeggiata sul fiume Garonne e 15 minuti a piedi dal cuore del centro storico (qui siamo un po' a nord). Dall'aeroporto: linea 1, scendere alla fermata Palais de Justice (non ha senso arrivare fino alla stazione) e qui prendere il 4 o il 15 (fermata Paul Doumer, a 50 mt.dalla casa). Se arrivate dopo le 18, non troverete il gentile proprietario ad accogliervi ma vi verranno fornite istruzioni per accedere alla vostra camera. La stanza Seignoret era molto ampia, ben arredata, accogliente e pulitissima. Letto molto comodo e bel bagno con ampia doccia e doppio lavello. La colazione non è inclusa ma c'è un frigobar con acqua e succhi, macchina per caffè e tea, dolcetti confezionati. Inoltre, una convenzione con una caffetteria nella rue Notre-Dame (a 20 metri) che offre buoni prodotti da forni sfornati freschi al mattino. A disposizione cartine della città, guide e informazioni turistiche. Non do il massimo dei voti perché la domenica non rifanno le camere, le finestre non sono ben isolanti acusticamente (e vista l'ottima qualità della ristrutturazione dovrebbero esserlo, anche se la zona di notte è abbastanza tranquilla!) e in bagno mancavano shampoo e cuffia doccia. Comunque un ottimo indirizzo!

Soggiorno di 3 notti più che sufficiente per visitare la bella Bordeaux e St. Emilion. Camera grande, pulita, arredata con gusto, con vista sulla bella chiesa di Saint Louis le cui campane vengono silenziate di notte, quindi nessun problema per il sonno. Bagno bello e spazioso ma non adatto a persone con poca confidenza perché la doccia è praticamente a vista in camera. Non offre colazione, ma solo un servizio di free mini bar con caffè nespresso, acqua, thè, succhi e dolcetti confezionati. Comodissima la posizione sia per arrivare dall'aeroporto (bus 1 fino alla stazione e da qui linea C ), sia per raggiungere a piedi il centro con una piacevole passeggiata di 10 minuti. La Garonna è a 4 minuti a piedi. Bordeaux si gira tutta a piedi con tranquillità in una giornata. Gestore disponibile e molto cortese, a richiesta organizza escursioni e fornisce suggerimenti su vari argomenti. Non do il massimo dei voti perché la cameriera che rifaceva la stanza non ha mai rimpiazzato i prodotti da bagno. L'abbiamo segnalato al check out e si sono scusati. Forse avremmo dovuto dirlo già dopo la prima notte, ma...una supervisione alle camere ogni tanto da parte dei gestori credo sia necessaria! Consigliato.

review_title: Great Quaint B&B in Heart of Neighborhood!
review_text: I wasn't sure about this hotel before we arrived because we had 3 different rooms in 2 buildings but I was pleasantly surprised.  Our rooms were adorable-all different.  We had a suite, an apartment and a smaller room with high beam ceilings.  We had to accommodate 7 people so these all worked perfectly.  Pierre, the owner, had corresponded with me giving me instructions and setting up excursions prior to our arrival.  Our rooms were cleaned daily.  Love that they have nespresso makers in room along with cakes, cookies, tea, juices, water.  We ate breakfast at the bakery next door and loved it.  For 5 euros, you got oj, latte and a pastry-pastries so yummy.  We at dinner at the restaurant, Chez Dupont-so cute.  The shrimp appetizer was delicious, steak frites yummy, fish good and my parents enjoyed the veal.  The best part about the meal was the profiteroles for dessert.  Best ever.  I promised my kids they could get them the following night but the restaurant was closed when we stopped by.  Loved that we were in a neighborhood with all the locals away from the hustle and bustle of the city but the river and city were right around corner so we walked there at night.  There's a car four market around corner and lots of other good restaurants (we ate at a really good Italian spot around the corner from hotel).  Pierre was out of town so his associate Mathieu took over and he was great.  He helped us plan a visit to St. Emillioin which was so great-a wonderful medieval town with great restaurants recommended by Pierre or Mathieu.  We will definitely be back to this wonderful spot with so much character.  Thanks Pierre and Mathieu.

Poor first impression, the guy didn't pick us up at the airport as planned. No worries though, we took a cab for the same price. Actually, we never really spoke to any management. The code to the front door and the little box with the room key worked. The room was large compared to our experience of french hotel rooms for the same price. No hazzle, very pleasant. Breakfast at any nearby cafè and a Carrefour halfway down the street. Short walk to the promenade and tram.

We booked two rooms and stayed 2 nights. Both rooms was colourful, very clean and comfy. I felt we were a little away from where we went each day but in saying that our location was extremely pleasant and quiet.

Chambre Placide: superbe. Au 1er étage. Élégant avec une touche de contemporain. Belle couleur vert/bleu émeraude (c'est nouveau au nuancier) sur le mur face à la fenêtre et sur la tête de lit en cuir. Authenticité avec les belles pierres de calcaire et le plancher. Une touche de cabinet de curiosité. A 100m de la station P Doumer: ligne C qui emmène directement à la gare St Jean. Dans le quartier superbe des Chartrons : certes bobo mais aussi beau tt court. A 2 pas des quais. A gauche, la cité du Vin. A droite, le centre ville. A 5 mn du CAPC et du jardin botanique.
Accueil souriant et efficace de Mathieu.

We booked two rooms here and had a fabulous time. All the rooms are differently furnished, are quirky and extremely comfortable and the bathrooms felt brand new. The location is excellent and central and you can go everywhere by foot. This is our second stay in Bordeaux and we will definitely return. We had a wonderful stay!

Dans le délicieux quartier des Chartrons, Chez Dupont propose de grandes chambres décalées au niveau de la déco "vintage" mais charmantes et très bien équipées (produits salle de bains très complets, mini frigo à notre disposition et rempli d’eau et de jus de fruits, machine à café,...Le seul (léger) inconvénient est une petite odeur désagréable à chaque fois que nous rentrons dans la chambre, qu'on oublie au bout de quelques minutes cependant. Attention, il n'y a pas de petit déjeuner (pas gênant pour autant).

Great room. Light, spacious and comfortable with air-conditioning and tea and coffee making facilities plus an office corner. Above a great restaurant, with service at hand (room made up each day), in a lovely village type atmosphere of town with a cafe and bakery two doors down for a great breakfast with superbe pastries. Short walking distance to the river and comfortable walking distance to the City du Vin which is a must visit and to the ancient quarters of town, all heaving with busy restaurants for all tastes.

There was no fridge or microwave. The beds are extremely small. There is a restaurant attached which I think made me sick. The service was good but the overall quality was very lacking.  Needless to say we won’t be visiting this place again

For $90 I left my car there 12 days and spent the night after my flight back...oh, and the ride to the jetport!  win win. Great benefit if you are gone for a week or more and you need a room.  I've used the Ramada and their services twice already and would do so again next time.

Overall great place, recommend over airbnb type places

review_text: On arrival Staff on Reception Desk were friendly and efficient. Our room was large, clean, warm with comfy beds and plenty of towels. An excellent base to explore the Portland area. Would definitely stay again.

review_title: Park and fly we were last ones to be picked up
review_text: We called the Ramada twice for pick up. All the other people from our flight had been picked up by other hotels and friends. We were the last ones there waited 45 min, the airport was actually locking the doors behind us. No sorry or anything.

review_text: Enjoyed our two-night stay there. Swimming pool and hot tub were great! It was a clean hotel. The restaurant was good size and the breakfast restaurant close to it was handy. Good parking spot that was close to our room. Staff were friendly.

We have stayed a few times for a park and fly. It’s the best in value and location in the greater Portland area or even Boston area. The hotel shuttle drivers are wonderful and will take you or pick you up promptly. Even if you are flying out of Boston the train or bus station is no problem. The hotel will shuttle you.
Great Find!!!!

This hotel offers a terrific bargain for their park, fly, sleep!  We left our car for 3 weeks!  Not only that, the hotel has updated it's rooms and has a great exercise room and pool.  We plan to use this hotel for our next vacation in March 2020.

Room 314 was full of smoke in spite of claiming 100 percent smoke free hotel..
Front desk employees were indifferent.
Drunk guests tried to break into our room at 2AM from connecting door.
Manager never showed up on our request the following morning.
management_response:
Please accept my apologies for the issues you experienced during your stay. We are a smoke free facility and while the vast majority of guests adhere to that policy, there are the occasional few who do not – we do have procedures for dealing with those people as well as any smoke smell. If you had called the front desk, we would have been happy to find another room for you.  

We called the guests in the room that adjoined yours after you contacted the front desk – they were not trying to break into your room, they had just open the adjoining door from their room to see what was there. In fact, there are two locks, one is a 1 inch deadbolt lock on the each of the adjoining doors – neither of which can be accessed from the other room.  However, I am sorry that those guests disturbed you at that hour.  I hope that you will give us the opportunity to show you our usual hospitality in the future.

We take reports of poor service and communication very seriously and will use your comments during our regular training in an effort to avoid similar issues in the future.
