We are committed to guest satisfaction and appreciate you taking time to review your experience. We hope that you will give us another opportunity to show you our usual hospitality.

review_text: We stayed here on our fall foliage road trip in September. The hotel is clean and the staff is friendly. My husband enjoyed the fitness center. It was a short drive to downtown Portland and there are a lot of restaurant choices nearby.

The staff closed my crossover trunk door which I left open.  Very thoughtful. The bathroom was spotless!   The shower water temperature was perfect.  Had a king size bed and it was very comfortable.   Coffee was available in the morning.

review_title: Good value with above average service and amenities.
review_text:
We stayed for five nights.  Our double room was spacious (with a requested fridge/microwave) with comfortable bed mattresses; a desk, table and chairs and ample dresser drawers.  The bathroom tub/shower had ample water pressure and hot water and there were two sinks - handy for two people getting ready in the morning.  No continental breakfast included but the attached First Light brunch/breakfast restaurant served above average food with lots of hot coffee.  There is also an attached dinner restaurant and separate bar.  The bar is a little on the higher price side.
The rooms are very quiet because neighboring room noise was minimal - little pass through sounds made it between the between walls.  Just one night, our room smoke alarm started beeping due to a dead battery but the night desk person fixed it in a jiffy.
All of the employees were very helpful.  No complaints for this moderately priced room and would stay here again.

We had a lovely room in this hotel, it was immaculately clean and included some lovely touches like cakes and biscuits to go with our coffee, and fruit juice in the fridge. The hotel is situated in a quiet location but only ten minutes from the centre and a couple of minutes from the river. Don't miss the restaurant attached to the hotel and some of the bars and cafes in the neighbourhood.....but watch out as many are not open on a Sunday or Monday

review_title: Great boutique hotel in a lovely location
review_text:
We stayed at Chez Dupont for two nights...

The welcome we were given was fantastic, Mr Cassagne was a fantastic host, able to provide recommendations for places to visit, eat and taste the fantastic wines of Bordeaux.

The room was large, light and airy with all the facilities you could want, clean, tidy and comfortable.

The recommended cafe less than a minutes walk from Chez Dupont was fantastic for breakfast, the coffee & tea facilities in the room were sufficient.

Although about a 15 minute walk from the centre on town I would highly recommend staying at Chez Dupont, it's in a lovely area with easy to access all of Bordeaux's main attractions.

If I visit Bordeaux again I would not consider staying elsewhere.

Thank you Pierre for a lovely room to stay in during our visit to Bordeaux. 
Chambre Chez Dupont is in a great position and easy to get to. We caught the tram from the front of  Gare Saint Jean, pink C line to stop Place Paul Doumer, 120 mtrs to Chez Dupont, also 100mtrs to the riverfront and the B line tram. Only 15min walk along the river to the Mirror Water. 
Plenty of choices for food close by. We loved our room and loved Bordeaux. 
It is a beautiful city that is very easy to get around. We would recommend to anyone to stay at Une Chambre Chez Dupont.
Roslyn & Graham 
Sunshine Coast, Australia

We've just had a fantastic stay at CHEZ DUPONT. The rooms are on (du)point and like nothing we've stayed in before. Definitely recommend if you are after something special and a bit different. The round bed in our room was incredibly comfortable and we slept so well. The location is beautiful with lovely coffee shops, little boutiques and a church to look out on to! Thank you Pierre!
management_response:

Owner Pierre-Jean goes out of his way to make you feel welcome and by giving tips of where to visit, the best restaurants and ways to get around. He also contacts you before your visit to enquire if you have any requirements or tours/airport pick-ups that need booking.
I cannot fault our stay in any way, we would definitely stay there again.

review_text:
Infelizmente tivemos uma péssima primeira impressão do hotel.
Um funcionário que não quis se identificar (quando perguntamos qual era o nome dele, ele se negou a falar e do que notamos é o gerente do hotel) dificultou nossa estadia e foi diversas vezes rude e grosseiro.

A reserva ainda não estava cancelada e ele cobrou uma tarifa balcão nos onerando 213 euros. A reserva de 5 diárias foi feita a 80 Euros por dia e fomos cobrados 119 Euros por diária, 39 euros a mais por dia em nossa estadia. Se não pagasse, ficaria sem hotel.
Não teve a menor paciência ou educação para conversar e disse que estava com dor de cabeça e nas costas e não ia perder tempo explicando.
O hotel em si é bom, a localização é ótima e a cama confortável, apesar do quarto ser muito pequeno.
Muito insatisfeita com esse funcionário que não deveria trabalhar com atendimento ao público.

Sra,

Gostaríamos de responder ao seu comentário.

A sua reserva efectuada na booking.com com o seu cartão de crédito foi recusada até às 20h00 do dia da sua chegada e estava ciente do problema com este cartão de crédito sem nos informar, apesar das mensagens em booking.com.

Portanto, cancelamos sua reserva com o acordo da booking.com.

Você chegou sem uma reserva válida e você mesmo verificou que seus dois cartões não tinham fundos suficientes.

Você ligou para a Booking.com, o que provou que estávamos certos.

O preço proposto não poderia ser o mesmo de março de 2021, data da sua reserva, porque estávamos quase lotados

Cumprimentos
O diretor

Le quartier est particulièrement agréable, il est aisé d'aller chiner chez les antiquaires, flâner dans ce quartier typiquement bordelais, ou gambader sur les quais situés à proximité. La rue est animée, et offre un choix de restaurants trendy.

It took several days (another story), but without him we might never have gotten it back.  This hotel is one of the most charming in Bordeaux, and is in a real neighborhood, not a tourist area.  It is quiet at night, near the tram, and also near a beautiful square with excellent restaurants.  The bistrot Chez Dupont, which shares the building with the hotel is wonderful, but M. Cassagne has many other good recommendations.  We have stayed here twice and will stay again when we come to Bordeaux.

I have stayed here many times as this hotel has a great Park and Fly program, but the rooms are also well appointed for the price. Good hot showers, plenty of room in the bathrooms, comfortable beds and good WiFi. I would appreciate an electrical outlet at the desk, but other than that, I feel very good recommending this Ramada Inn.

We were very pleased with our two night stay at the Ramada.  Rooms were clean, the price was very moderate (especially compared to other Portland hotels), Didn't miss the usual free breakfast; we much preferred going on our own.  Room was very quiet, even though we were on the first floor.

Stayed for 3 days on a solo trip to Portland. It was one of the cheaper options in the area and I found it to be pretty good. Rooms are small but comfortable, location is about 10-15 mins away from downtown Portland. My only critique is the cleanliness left a lot to be desired. Trash was left on the balcony from the previous room occupant, there was a broken large fingernail(not mine) on the carpet. But again, for the price I paid I would stay again. Overall a decent stay. Will probably return on my next trip to Portland.

We stayed here for 2 nights after we booked through Priceline. We were pleasantly surprised. The room was huge,  beds were comfortable and  a good location. Easy ride into downtown without the expense of staying in a downtown hotel. We would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Portland.

The Ramada Plaza is just on the outskirts of Portland which is a little inconvenient if you with to make frequent visits into the city but if you are planning any travelling around the area it's perfect as it's located right next to the I95 meaning everything is nice and easy to get too, the rooms are a nice size and include a microwave and fridge should you want to use them, the hotel also has a pool and gym if you want to use them, the staff in the hotel were excellent.

Loved the access to the outside.  Rooms were big like 1960 rooms.  The dining room was in serious need of some decor.  The music was awful and service was lacking. The furnishings were nice just needed some feel good. The menu could use some help.

The Ramada is located somewhat out of the main business and downtown districts.  Because of this, its location was ideal for travel on the Interstate routes.  The rooms were exceptionally large and comfortable.

Hit or miss. Stayed here for two nights and got a nice clean room on the first floor. Returned a week later for one night and was given a room on the third floor. This room was in disrepair. management_response: Merci pour cet avis formidable et merci également d'avoir pris le temps de répondre :) Nous sommes ravis que la région ainsi que les activités proposées dans le camping vous aient plu ! Cela a été un plaisir de vous rencontrer ! L'équipe et la direction vous souhaitent une bonne continuation et nous espérons vous revoir bientôt !

review_text: Great location! Close to the village of Aups and shops, close to Lake Sainte Croix and the Gorges du Verdon. Rental (Natura) very clean with a nice terrace but the child room is a little small (not recommended for 3 children). The pool is clean and nice. A small campsite where you feel good!
management_response:
Merci pour cet avis constructif :) 
Nous prenons note de cette remarque.
Nous sommes également ravis de vous avoir eu dans notre camping et espérons vous revoir très bientôt !

review_text: We are satisfied with our week at the Oasis, the setting remains always nice the welcome and the services are well there, the rental always as nickel the pool with its small changes is nice (maybe more umbrella) the restaurant is cool.we enjoy the holidays Oasis soon
management_response:
Merci d'avoir pris le temps de nous laisser un avis.
Nous sommes ravis que vous ayez passé un bon séjour dans notre camping.
Nous espérons que cela vous a donné une nouvelle fois envie de revenir :) 
À très bientôt peut-être !

review_title: Summer holidays 2024 on the campsite L'Oasis du Verdon
review_text: This is the third time we spent our summer holidays on the campsite L'Oasis du Verdon. A haven of peace. The campsite is well maintained and cared for. The rentals are clean and well equipped. We will definitely go back. Thanks to all the camping team and a very special cuckoo to Molly, the four-legged mascot of the campsite.
management_response:
Nous vous remercions vivement pour cet excellent avis et pour vos compliments sur notre camping, son entretien et sur le ménage des hébergements. Nous transmettons votre coucou à Molly avec une caresse qu'elle sera apprécier à sa juste valeur!
Au plaisir de vous revoir si vous en avez l'occasion.

review_text:
A friendly welcome and well cared for camping with clean facilities.
A short walk from the lively village centre and near to the Verdon Gorge and several interesting villages
management_response:
Dear Philip and Maureen,
It was so nice to see you again in our campsite this year. It was a real pleasure to welcome you and share a part of your holidays.
Keep safe to meet you again next year if you have the opportunity to cometo France again.

review_text:
A cozy small, quiet campsite within walking distance of Aups, beautifully located near lac st croix and 1 hour from the Mediterranean sea. Very friendly owners (and dog). We stayed in a premium VIP chalet, very nice luxury chalet, fenced terrace, airvo,...
We had a super stay and definitely recommend this
management_response: We thank you very much for your good review. We are very happy you liked your PREMIUM chalet VIP. Hope to see you again in our  campsite if you have the opportunity again ! Have a nice summer !

review_text: Excellent welcome, perfect accommodation and magnificent region. Perfect and exotic stay. Charming hosts and good advice
management_response: Un très grand merci pour votre excellent avis qui nous touche directement ! Nous sommes très heureux que vous ayez apprécie votre séjour chez nous au camping et que vous ayez profité pleinement de notre magnifique région des Gorges du Verdon et du Lac de Sainte-Croix. au plaisir de vous revoir si l'occasion se présente !

review_text:
J’ai reserve a l’hôtel alhambra pour deux jours en couple. Chambre très moderne accueil parfait
petits déjeuners servis dans le jardin verdoyant très belle décoration beaucoup de plantes c’est très rare dans un établissement  à Paris. Le personnel est à l’écoute et arrangeant et surtout de  bon conseil.
Je reviendrai et je le recommande
management_response:
Bonjour,
Merci d'avoir pris le temps de laisser une note positive suite à votre récent séjour à l'Hôtel Alhambra Paris
! Au plaisir de vous accueillir de nouveau !
A bientôt à l'hôtel Alhambra!

review_title: Merveilleux accueil !! Une équipe hyper bienveillante et un patron au top !!
review_text:
Chambre très propre et confortable ! Literie impecc. Petit déjeuner extra et pas cher pour le centre de Paris !! Un extérieur trop mignon et calme !! Petite dédicace pour le patron qui nous a recommandé un resto trop bon, un endroit à visiter tt près de l'hôtel et des explications pour prendre le métro ... ect ...  BREF LE TOP !!!
Je retournerai sans problème ds ce petit paradis !!
management_response:
Chère Vanessa,

Que c’est agréable de lire que votre séjour en groupe fut « S.U.P.E.R » !!

Vos doux mots ne cessent de réchauffer le cœur de notre équipe et votre satisfaction est notre plus grande fierté !

Nous espérons vous voir pousser à nouveau, les portes d’e l'hotel Alhambra..

Le Directeur

review_text:
Nous avons eu un très bon accueil de la part du patron. 
Les chambres sont propres avec une salle de bain moderne. 
Nous avons particulièrement apprécié le patio fleuri , un havre de paix  où nous avons pu nous poser pour profiter du soleil et papoter entre amis. 

Une mention + + + pour le patron qui nous a conseillé un
bon resto, Le Centenaire situé à 2 minutes de l’hôtel.
Celui-ci nous a également conseillé nos visites du dimanche qui nous ont permis de finir notre séjour en beauté. La situation de l’hôtel est parfaite, proche du Marais, du métro, des restos et bars pour passer un excellent séjour. 

Nous avons trouvé notre hôtel pour nos futurs séjours à Paris.
management_response:
Chère Isabelle,
Merci beaucoup pour votre joli message.
Cela a été un vrai plaisir pour nous de vous accueillir et que notre jardin vous ai plus.
Nous espérons vous revoir très vite .
Cordialement
Le Directeur

review_text:
l'accueil a l'arrivée a été désastreux. le fait que je sois un client booking m'a été fermement reproché jusqu'à vouloir m'interdire que ma compagne me rejoigne le we ! je suis très souvent à l'hotel : jamais vu ca ... a ce sujet, alors que le prix pour 2 n'était que de 4 euros plus cher sur booking, il m'a fallu débourser 46€ pour ajouter une personne, alors que je pensais m'arranger avec l'accueil à mon arrivée ne pouvant faire cette distinction lors de ma réservation. J'ai accepté pour trouver une solution avec la seule personne commerçante de l'hotel, les autres pas de regard, de bonjour , de merci, de stp... étonnant dans un métier de service en 2021. plutôt l'impression d'avoir a faire avec des gardiens de prison qui surveillent l'entrée comme un pénitencier. j'imagine la réponse rassurante qu'il y aura derrière mon commentaire mais pas envie de ca à l'hotel.
dommage sinon chambres et jardins agréables.
management_response:
Monsieur, 
Suite à votre commentaire suite au séjour dans notre Hotel, nous tenons à préciser que la chambre réservée pour 4 nuits était une single avec un prix en promotion de -35%. Vous avez voulu changer cette réservation en une double en ne payant que 5 €/ en supplément. Nous avons dû vous expliquer que votre réservation était non modifiable , non remboursable et non annulable. Le montant du supplément est du domaine de l'hotel et non de vous. De plus, vous pensiez que le petit déjeuner était inclus dans le tarif initial. Cordialement Le Directeur

review_text:
Chambre spacieuse et surtout grand jardin.
Personnel de qualité et l'écoute.
Nous reviendrons prochainement à l'hôtel Alhambra pour une prochaine visite à Paris.
Petite mention spéciale pour le réceptionniste.
management_response:
Cher Alain,
Merci pour votre nuit passée au sein de notre établissement.
Merci pour vos quelques mots qui ont ravi l'ensemble de notre personnel.
Nous espérons vous retrouver à Alhambra et son jardin lors de votre prochaine venue à Paris.
Cordialement
La Directeur

review_text:
Pasamos una semana en París y nos alojamos en el Hotel Alhambra. El personal nos atendió muy amablemente, la habitación era acogedora y estaba muy limpia. La cama era excelente, con unas sábanas suaves y agradables. El baño estupendo, amplio y bien ventilado. 

Si volvemos a París, repetiremos sin duda.
management_response:
Querida Pilar,
Muchas gracias por tu lindo mensaje.
Fue un verdadero placer para nosotros darte la bienvenida y que nuestro jardín te tenga más.
Esperamos verte de nuevo muy pronto.
Atentamente
El director

review_title: Buen hotel, limpio, bien ubicado,silenciosos, con A/C.
review_text: Le daríamos una puntuación de 4 sobre 5, ya que cumplió con las expectativas pero no contamos con agua,hielo o cafetera en los cuartos. Buena ubicación y muy silencioso. Customer Service podría ser un poco más amable, pero cumplió las expectativas para lo que reservamos. Es muy limpio y dea fácil acceso.
management_response:
Hola carlos
Gracias por tomarse el tiempo para dejar una nota después de su estadía en París y estoy encantado de leer que disfrutó de su estadía con nosotros y especialmente del jardín de flores. Esperando poder darle la bienvenida nuevamente, le deseamos un gran día,
Tuyo, el director

review_text: Hôtel conforme aux photos et chambre très propre, salle de bain à l'italienne moderne. Personnel sympathique et à l'écoute, emplacement parfait à deux pas de la place de la République et des métros. Dommage de devoir laisser la carte de sa chambre à la réception lorsqu'on part en balade ou en soirée.
management_response:
Bonjour Morgane,
Je vous remercie d'avoir pris le temps de laisser une note suite à votre séjour parisien et je suis ravie de lire que vous avez apprécié votre séjour chez nous et surtout le jardin fleuri. 
Nous demandons de laisser la carte à la réception pour des mesures sécurités car sinon toute personne personne pourrait accéder aux chambres sans avoir à se présenter.
Dans l'attente de vous accueillir de nouveau, nous vous souhaitons une excellente journée,
Bien à vous, Le directeur

review_text:
L’Accueil a été très chaleureux. La propreté est impeccable et effectuée tous les jours. 
De notre chambre nous avons eu une vue magnifique avec vue sur le jardin dans un écrin de verdure. 
Le petit  déjeuner est complet et bien fourni. 
Je recommande fortement cette hôtel.
management_response:
Chère Marie Josée,

L'équipe de l'hôtel Alhambra vous remercie de tout cœur pour votre merveilleux retour.
Nous sommes sincèrement ravis que vous ayez autant apprécié votre séjour dans notre établissement!
C'est avec grande impatience que nous espérons vous recevoir de nouveau très prochainement!
Avec nos salutations les plus sincères,
Le Directeur

review_text: Modern furnished and clean room, good beds.  Clean towels every day if desired.  Nice that there was air conditioning.  Hair dryer in the room, stored in the linen closet.  Very friendly staff.  After checking out we could have the suitcases stored at the reception and still enjoy Paris!
management_response:
Dear Arianne,
Thank you for your feed back following your stay at the Alhambra Hotel.
We are happy to read that everything was ok and you loved the confort of the room.
We are delighted that the services and confort have thrilled you.
Hope to see you again very soon
The Manager.

review_text:
Une Chambre Chez Dupont is an amazing guest house in a superb location.  Our room Elisee was a large room, and furnished to a high standard.  The bed really comfortable, with a great skylight view of church tower.  
Pierre couldn't have ben more helpful. nothing was too much trouble.  A wonderful stay.

Nous avons passé 3 nuits dans la chambre STEPHEN.
L'accueil est vraiment super, d'excellents conseils pour les visites et les restaurants!!
La chambre était très spacieuse et confortable.
Nous y retournerons avec plaisir ;)

Très beau studio confortable avec des attentions bien décoré avec goût, avec une cuisine, pratique des commerces proche de l'immeuble boulangerie et supérette. tram à 5 minutes à pied pour rejoindre le centre ville, beau parc public à 10 minutes propriétaire chaleureux

Très satisfait de la chambre, pour nous il s'agissait de la Fenwick. Le gérant est aux petits soins avec nous, très agréable. Pour un couple c'était très bien. Les seuls petits reproches que je pourrais faire porteraient sur la hauteur du plafond dans la salle d'eau pour les personnes de grande taille comme moi, et surtout pour le défaut d'isolation du bruit, qu'il vienne des escaliers vers la chambre, ou l'inverse, ce qui brise quelque peu l'intimité.

Des chambres confortables dans un endroit plein de charme. La deco est soignée, le quartier adorable. C'est l'endroit idéal pour séjourner en couple ou pour un voyage d'affaires. Et le propriétaire est charmant!

review_title: superbe appartement-nid d'amour en plein quartier romantique !
review_text: Grand appartement 2 pièces tout équipé tout confort, propre , cosy, chaleureux , superbement placé , très calme ...bref parfait pour un délicieux séjour en couple à Bordeaux , et d'un accueil irréprochable !!

Emplacement central. Jolies attentions dans la chambre. Contact au TOP avec l'équipe. La literie est de très bonne qualité ainsi que les sanitaires. Prix imbattable pour le quartier. En bref : tout était parfait !

Je recommande +++.

Nous quittons à peine Bordeaux et déjà elle nous manque! Cette ville chargée d histoire est superbe. Nous avons pu en profiter pleinement à pied, en bus, en tramway depuis notre Chambre chez Dupont idéalement située dans le quartier des Chartrons à 2 pas des quais. La chambre Stephen sous les toits nous a enchantés. Murs en pierre, poutres apparentes, velux, parquet et lit géant... Si romantique! Merci à Pierre-Jean pour son accueil et ses bons plans restos. Mention ++ à la table "Chez Dupont"... bravo et merci!

Chambres spacieuses et très propres, très cosy, salle de bain impeccable, service parfait, literie nickel, vraiment parfait, très bien situé quartier top, le directeur est très sympa, tout est bien pensé, en cas à disposition, service très attentionné et tout est bien pense :)

We had a fantastic stay at Chez DuPont. Mr. Cassagne was very friendly and helpful. He booked a restaurant and our wine tours which were excellent. Would recommend Chez Dupont to all my friends and family.

The whole hotel had a stale smell. The room was not clean - I found multiple pieces of food and other items on the floor from prior guests. There was hair on the bedspread and in the bathroom. I stayed for a week and watched as the soap ring on the counter progressively grew from the bar soap because it was never once cleaned up. Housekeeping would either leave dirty towels that were left on the floor/in tub to be replaced or take them and not leave replacements. The fitness center shouldn't be called a fitness center - none of the machines worked (there are 2 treadmills, one looks to be about 50 years old, neither worked), there aren't any dumbbells or kettle bells, there is one resistance machine and it hits the ceiling when you try to re-position it. Do yourself a favor and stay somewhere else.
management_response: On behalf of our entire team, I would like to apologize for failing to meet your expectations and our usual standards. Your satisfaction is important to us and we will be using the feedback you provided to make improvements to ensure we offer an exceptional experience for our guests in the future.

review_text: Very convenient to highway. Room was very clean and comfortable. Service was excellent. Nice having a bar and restaurant on premises. Internet service and tv was excellent. Bed was extremely comfortable. Would definitely stay again

review_title: a really nice,clean,hotel. Good Staff, good location
review_text:
had two rooms booked,one for one night,one for two nights,both rooms next to each other. Ready for our 3 pm sign in.rooms very clean. xtra towels as requested. four pillows each bed. sheets,clean,crisp. no dust in rooms anywhere.bathrooms,clean.
only 1 complaint. it is a large hotel and they have just one elevator and we were on the 3rd floor. However never had to wait for the elevator at any time.  2 restaurants in this hotel and both were great.
Lunch,dinner was Seasons Grill, very nice food,good menu,prices were fine. quality of food,very good.  For Breakfast,lunch is the Egg & I. a great,large,place with outstanding breakfasts at really low prices. quick service,food is hot and fresh. Servers are really nice so you do not have to look for a place for breakfast. It was so good I saw many of the same faces every morning .  All in all a very good place to stay.  Rt 95 is just up one block so easy on and off. also just about 5 miles to the wharf shopping area. Aprox 8 min. to get there.
get directions from the front desk.   This is a good family place, with a nice pool indoors and a well equiped gym area.  Full bar in the lounge area. Specials on drinks.  Had a great time here and so will be back again.

By far, the cleanest, nicest Ramada I've ever been in.  Excellent cleaning staff.  I love the little balconies.  It is so nice to be able to drink my morning coffee out on that balcony.  I'll be staying here agin.

Ramada Plaza is such a great deal for us!   We like to travel and our trips usually begin at Ramada Plaza.  The accommodations are excellent, and being able to leave our car there rather than the airport is a great money saver.

Blood on the sheets. Called to get new ones they could only give me top sheets. light fixtures Literally broken. Trim missing, hair stuck in the front of the bed frame. Toe nail clippings in the corner. Will never stay here again. If I wasn’t Flying out at 4a.m I would leave and find a better hotel. Oh huge black spider chilling at our room door. Seriously find another place to stay
management_response: Please accept my apologies for the housekeeping issues you experienced during your stay. That is certainly unusual and not up to our normal standards. I have reviewed your comments with our housekeeping staff in an effort to avoid similar issues in the future. I hope that you will give us the opportunity to show you our usual standards if you stay in the Portland area again.

review_text: Enjoyed our stay. Staff polite, pool and hot tub were good. 200 characters is too much and I don't have anything else to say. Beds nice, pillows nice. Tv small. But I would stay there again. Lobby nice with big fireplace

Had a great experience allowed us early check in and the shuttle service to the airport was great...food in the attached restaurant was very good...rooms clean and very comfortable we had a very nice stay and will definitely visit again

Extra amenities are available. However, if you need any extra amenities (towels, etc.), go to the front desk and get them yourself. We called for extra towels, waited an hour, and had to go get them ourself anyway.  There were cleaning carts in the hallway, but we never saw any staff near them. There was entertainment at the bar both nights of our stay. The bar was packed, but mostly because it was small and there were a lot of people there. The band was fun and interactive with the crowd. The bar staff was very friendly, but the service at the bar was slow as there was only one bartender. Once a table was available it wasn’t bussed well or often. There was a restaurant, The Egg & I, attached to the hotel  that provides breakfast and lunch as well as the hotel restaurant Seasons. However, the only continental breakfast items available are coffee and tea in the lobby and there are coffee/tea makers in each room. There are snacks available in the hotel, but the snacks that are available are vending machine snacks only. The pool area was clean and spacious and well maintained.

Nothing bad to say.  beds were great and I always appreciate nice linen. Very good restaurants nearby, convenient to the airport.  Better than I expected. Some road noise but any noise at all is more than I have at home
Good campsite welcome and pleasant service. Small downside, the bed is a little low and the bedding is the minimum.
management_response: Merci beaucoup pour votre très bon avis. Nous sommes désolés pour la hauteur de la literie qui est livrée avec l'hébergement. Il semble d'après votre expérience que la hauteur de cette literie soit inférieure à votre hauteur de literie habituel ! Nous espérons pour autant que vous avez apprécié notre belle région des Gorges du Verdon et du Lac de Sainte Croix !

review_text: We spent a family reunion weekend at the Verdon Oasis campsite. Everything was there to make it perfect, the magnificent and very natural setting, the comfortable accommodation and the pleasant and warm welcome. I recommend this place.
management_response: Merci beaucoup pour cet excellent avis et pour votre recommandation. Nous avons eu beaucoup de plaisir à vous recevoir toute votre famille et ce sera avec une grande joie que nous vous reverrons si vous le souhaitez ! Merci pour vos petits mots dans les bungalows, petits messages qui nous ont vraiment touchés. Nous vous souhaitons un bel été !

review_text: Very pleasant place and very well appointed in the bungalows. An equally pleasant and friendly welcome with an adorable team. Perfect campsite, a haven of peace. Thank you for this comfort! We will definitely come back next year. THANK YOU
management_response: Nous vous remercions très sincèrement pour votre excellent avis sur notre camping, ses agencements et la qualité de ces bungalows ! Au plaisir de vous revoir l'année prochaine si vous en avez l'occasion. Bel été à vous et encore merci pour votre recommandation !

review_text:
Ideal campsite for a family stay.
Excellent welcome from Anne and Philippe, who run their campsite perfectly, listening to customers, available and extremely kind.
The campsite is quiet, clean, and the facilities as well as the bungalows are well maintained.
The atmosphere is warm and friendly.
We had a very pleasant stay with the family, and we will surely come back.
We recommend this address with our eyes closed!
management_response: Un très grand merci pour cet excellent avis qui nous va droit au cœur ! C'est en recevant ces compliments que nous savons pourquoi nous aimons notre métier ! Nous sommes heureux que vous ayez apprécié l'atmosphère de notre camping, nos installations et nos bungalows ainsi que notre disponibilité. C'est toujours un immense plaisir pour nous de pouvoir apporter à nos clients des conseils de visite, d'échanger avec eux sur leurs vacances. Encore merci pour votre recommandation !

review_text: Thanks to Anne Phillips and Molly for their warm and caring welcome. A pleasure to discover this magnificent region and no matter the weather!😉
management_response: Un grand merci pour votre avis et votre excellente note ! Nous sommes ravis de savoir que vous avez passé un excellent séjour et serons ravis de vous revoir si l'occasion se présente. Molly sera ravie également ! 🤩 Encore merci pour votre recommandation et peut-être à bientôt ! 😉

review_text:
Very friendly welcome from the owners, good advice on activities, great little Provençal market on Wednesday mornings easily accessible on foot from the campsite.
Quiet swimming pool in September so tranquility ++, very pleasant aperitif on the terrace in the evening.
The plus: Molly, the campsite dog that our 15-month-old granddaughter was a fan of! We will come back with pleasure!
management_response:
Merci pour cet avis formidable.
Nous sommes ravis que vous ayez passé un bon séjour et espérons vous revoir très bientôt !

review_text: Superb campsite with lots of charm and a very good relaxed atmosphere. An impeccable welcome from both the owners and the team with lots of wise advice for our visits and discovery of the region. And very nice facilities in the campsite. We feel good there. We would recommend it and hope to return one day. Good end of season to all.
management_response: Nous vous remercions pour cet excellent avis et vos commentaires nous touchent véritablement. Nous faisons le maximum pour offrir à nos clients un beau camping où les clients peuvent se sentir bien. Nous soignons notre accueil avec toute notre équipe du 1er jour en passant par le pot d'accueil, les soirées d'animation, le célèbre tournoi de pétanque de l'Oasis du Verdon organisé par Philippe tous les mardis, les soirées dansantes dans une ambiance familiale, sans oublier la chasse au trésor nocturne pour les enfants, les soirées musicales avec différents partenaires et les activités pour les adolescents le soir! Encore merci pour votre recommandation et nous espérons vous revoir une autre année avec grand plaisir !

review_title: Go there, it's a magical place
review_text:
I had a great time, the campsite is well equipped, great swimming pool, quality restaurant at super reasonable prices.
The boss Philippe makes great cocktails and he is very nice
Anne the boss takes great care of these customers,
The region is magnificent
I will come back without problem and I highly recommend it.
management_response: Merci beaucoup pour cet excellent avis et mille mercis pour ces compliments qui nous vont droit au cœur ! Nous sommes heureux d'avoir contribué à rendre votre séjour des plus agréables et nous serons ravis de vous revoir si vous en avez l'occasion ! Encore merci pour votre recommandation et peut-être à l'année prochaine !

review_text: Great stay in a tent on a well-shaded location fortunately! Clean sanitary facilities. Nice entertainment. Good welcome and team of seasonal workers available and friendly. Swimming pool aging but very clean. Next time bring our parasol
management_response: Un grand merci pour votre excellent avis et votre recommandation. Au plaisir de vous retrouver au camping l'année prochaine si l'occasions se présente pour vous. Nous transmettons vos compliments à notre équipe de saisonniers. Belle rentrée à vous !

review_text: Excellent camping stay in a lodge with a beautiful covered terrace. Very nice home. We like this type of campsite on a human scale, with some entertainment but quite quiet in the evening. The region is magnificent. We recommend 200%
management_response: Nous vous remercions pour votre excellent avis. Nous sommes heureux que vous ayez apprécié votre NATURA VIP et le côté familial et convivial de notre camping. Nous serons ravis de vous revoir si vous en avez l'occasion ! Nous vous souhaitons une belle rentrée !

review_text: Modern and great amenities, excellent customer service, within walking distance to Parliament House.  Common rooms for work, reading and bar with tea and coffee facilities with refreshments for purchase was also very convenient.
management_response:
Dear Nick,

Thank you for sharing you experience with us. I am glad to read that you had a fantastic stay with us and that you our team was able to enhance your experience with their costumer service. 

It was a pleasure to host you and we look forward to welcoming you back soon.

Kind regards,
Diego Espinoza

review_text:
I have stayed in little National  4 times , it’s getting worst and worst , I don’t see myself coming back for the 5th visit .

The first experience was great, and I returned for a second stay , it became my favourite hotel in Canberra , both of which were pre-Covid.

My third visit was in 2022, after Covid, and the hotel was experiencing a staff shortage. As a result, my room was not cleaned, and it was so dirty that the staff offered me a credit, which I accepted.

During my fourth visit, it was the worst experience at LN , it started from bookings , I called to make a booking and I was tossed between reception and reservation team . Upon arrival , I found the staff were so unfriendly and untrained , no greeting and not making eye contact with customers as they walked by.

While I am not comparing this hotel to other hotels , I am disappointed that it is not as good as it used to be.

Likes:
- Convenient location
- Powered black-out blinds and sheers
- Well-maintained building
- Lovely lounge and library

Dislikes:
- Unable to stream YouTube and Netflix to play on tv
- Poor customer service
- poor wifi connection , required to log in regularly
management_response:
Hi Matthew

I'm sorry to hear this stay didn't meet the expectations from your previous reservations. Your comments have been shared with the team for following up however, it is disappointing to read you felt your experience lacked customer service. This is something our dedicated team pride themselves on delivering. We do have a number of new starters on our team and I can see one of our trainees checked you in. 

It is great to read you enjoy the library and lounge areas, perfect places for working or relaxing from.

Unfortunately, Chrome casting is currently unavailable at LNHC due to the app being removed by Samsung. This is something we are working through with our IT department and hope to have a resolution. Your comments about Wifi are unusual for the hotel as we have removed any need to continually log in. After an initial log in, you should be able to browse complimentary for the duration of your stay.  I will share your feedback with our IT Manager to ensure that is still the case. 

We appreciate all feedback to ensure we can continually improve and I do hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back to experience LNHC as per your first stay with us.
